It's been just under 20 hours since everyone on Earth pooped their pants, and people still roam their damaged homes with disbelief, and loss. Rick?

Some [Kenny lies dead with rats nibbling on him] crapped themselves to death. And still others ...ruined perfectly good pairs of pants. Title: Towelie
Line: [walks in with a basket of laundry] Are you guys still playing that video game?

Title: Towelie
Line: Yeah. Hey Mom, Cartman found a bloody cotton thing in the bathroom.

Title: Towelie
Line: [holds it up] Look. [Sharon gasps and drops the laundry. Cartman unravels it] But I don't think it's for usin', I think it's just for lookin' through. [looks through it]

Title: Towelie
Line: Eric, put that down!

Title: Towelie
Line: Why?

Title: Towelie
Line: Just go put it back in the trashcan!

Title: Towelie
Line: [inspects it] Hey, it's like all bloody. It might be alive.

Title: Towelie
Line: No that... that came from me; just put it away.

Title: Towelie
Line: This came out of you?? You just left it in the trashcan?! [hick accent] You shouldn'ta done that. He's just a boih. Poor little feller.

Title: Towelie
Line: [looks up at his mom] What is it, Mom?

Title: Towelie
Line: Yeah, what it is, Mrs. Marsh?

Title: Towelie
Line: Boys, that a... feminine thing. Alright, it's a personal, woman thing. [game play stops and the boys look at her] I tell you what: If you'll just drop the whole thing right now, I'll buy you that new video game console you've been wanting.

Title: Towelie
Line: The 2001 Okama GameSphere?

Title: Towelie
Line: Sure.

Title: Towelie
Line: Cool!

Title: Towelie
Line: Wow, this is like finding trashcan gold, you guiys!

Title: Towelie
Line: Luau's Toys, day, later. A banner reading "WE HAVE GAMESPHERE" hangs over the window, and the console itself is in the window display.

Title: Towelie
Line: There it is. The Okama GameSphere. [the game console is shown, along with two controllers and several boxes containing the console]

Title: Towelie
Line: Dude, it's got a hundred twenty eight gigahertz D-RAM.

Title: Towelie
Line: What's that?

Title: Towelie
Line: Don't know, but it kicks ass. [they watch as Sharon buys the console from Mr. Harris and he wraps it up and delivers it to her] Wow, dude, you're the luckiest kid in South Park.

Title: Towelie
Line: Hey, this is all of ours. I'm the one who found Stan's aborted brother in the trashcan and blackmailed his mom into getting the GameSphere. [the boys turn away from the window]

Title: Towelie
Line: Alright, alright, but you guys gotta see if you can sleep over for the rest of the weekend. [checks his watch.] It's Saturday at 2:30 - that means we have... 39 hours to play GameSphere until school on Monday!

Title: Towelie
Line: (Woohoo!)

Title: Towelie
Line: Awesome! [suddenly remembers] Oh, crap.

Title: Towelie
Line: What?

Title: Towelie
Line: I'm supposed to go to the lake with my family tomorrow and swim and play in the stupid sun.

Title: Towelie
Line: Dude, we got GameSphere.

Title: Towelie
Line: I know, I know. Well, look: I'll stay over anyway so I can play for... eighteen hours, and then I'll go to the lake. [a strange character walks up next to them]

Title: Towelie
Line: Don't forget to bring a towel. [it's a walking, talking towel]

Title: Towelie
Line: What?

Title: Towelie
Line: When you get out of the water you need to dry off right away to avoid catchin' a cold. That's why Towelie says, "Don't forget to bring a towel."

Title: Towelie
Line: ...O-kay.

Title: Towelie
Line: Thanks, Towelie.

Title: Towelie
Line: [after a few moments of silence] Do you wanna get high?

Title: Towelie
Line: No. [Towelie looks for a few moments, then walks away]

Title: Towelie
Line: Anyway, that will give me plenty of time playing video games.

Title: Towelie
Line: Kyle, I think you underestimate Okama GameSphere.

Title: Towelie
Line: Here you go, boys. [Stan takes the shopping box and the boys take off]

Title: Towelie
Line: AAAAAA.

Title: Towelie
Line: Stan's house, later. In the living room, Kyle finishes connecting the GameSphere to the back of the TV

Title: Towelie
Line: Okay, turn it on.

Title: Towelie
Line: "Okama GameSphere"!

Title: Towelie
Line: Whoa!

Title: Towelie
Line: [the game title comes up] Thirst For BLOOD!

Title: Towelie
Line: Oh yeah, Thirst for Blood. Bring it.

Title: Towelie
Line: Oh, this is so cool.

Title: Towelie
Line: Bring it, bring it! [on the TV two monsters fight each other. The one on the right attacks the other with a chainsaw. "Oh!"]

Title: Towelie
Line: Stan's house, night. The boys have been playing for hours. Around them are empty boxes of Cheesy Poofs and cans of Zoop soda. On the sofa is a bag of chips. Stan's parents walk up to the boys.

Title: Towelie
Line: Goodnight, boys. Don't stay up too late.

Title: Towelie
Line: G'night Mom, thanks for GameSphere.

Title: Towelie
Line: [slowly slides into a hick accent] Yeah, but you still shouldn'ta done that. 'E's just a boih.

Title: Towelie
Line: What?

Title: Towelie
Line: Nothing. Come on, Randy. [whisks him off to bed. From the TV: "Twenty kills."]

Title: Towelie
Line: Stan's house, Sunday morning, dawn. The boys have stayed up all night playing video games. Kyle is on the phone with his parents.

Title: Towelie
Line: Yeahyeah, Mom. I-I can't go to the lake. No, S-stan's having emotional problems and I need to help see him through it. He's got- [to Cartman] wha-what is it?

Title: Towelie
Line: Date-rape psychosis.

Title: Towelie
Line: Date-rape something. Yeah. Okay. I will. Okay, thanks, Mon. [hangs up] I don't have to go outside!

Title: Towelie
Line: Awesome!

Title: Towelie
Line: She said it's fine, but that I still have to go to baseball practice tonight..

Title: Towelie
Line: Oh, yeah, we got baseball practice today. God damnit!

Title: Towelie
Line: We shouldn't have this many responsibilities! We're children!

Title: Towelie
Line: Well, it's alright. We can still play for [looks at his watch] six more hours, and then we'll go play baseball.

Title: Towelie
Line: [walks in from nowhere] Don't forget to bring a towel.

Title: Towelie
Line: Uh no.

Title: Towelie
Line: When you're playin' sports, the sweat can get in your face. That's why Towelie says, "Always keep an extra towel in your duffel bag."

Title: Towelie
Line: Okay, we will.

Title: Towelie
Line: [raises its arms in victory] Alright! [lowers them, then after some moments] Do you wanna get high?

Title: Towelie
Line: No we don't wanna get high!

Title: Towelie
Line: Okay... You sure?

Title: Towelie
Line: Yes! Go away, you stupid towel! [Towelie goes away]

Title: Towelie
Line: Oh, dude! Did you see that? I cut off your face and ate it!

Title: Towelie
Line: That's... so... cool!

Title: Towelie
Line: Stan's house, later... The boys have repositioned themselves and look half-asleep from all the game play. Doughnuts and ice cream appear - a cone is on the rug with its ice cream melting. Sharon walks up to them again.

Title: Towelie
Line: Okay, boys, that's it. You have to go now.

Title: Towelie
Line: No no, it's okay, Mom. We c-we can't go to baseball practice 'cause Kyle has cancer.

Title: Towelie
Line: No, Stanley, it's Monday morning. You have to go to school.

Title: Towelie
Line: It's Monday?

Title: Towelie
Line: Oh, uh, I'm sick.

Title: Towelie
Line: Me too.

Title: Towelie
Line: No, you're not sick. Now get to school. [disconnects the console from the TV] All of you.

Title: Towelie
Line: But Mom...

Title: Towelie
Line: Go!

Title: Towelie
Line: Aagh!

Title: Towelie
Line: Bus stop, moments later. The boys are now waiting for the bus.

Title: Towelie
Line: Can't believe we have to go to school!

Title: Towelie
Line: Yeah, real life is so boring and stupid.

Title: Towelie
Line: We just have to try and make the day go as fast as possible so we can get back to GameSphere. [a green car pulls up in front of them. Two soldiers are in it]

Title: Towelie
Line: Hello, boys, how are you?

Title: Towelie
Line: Fine.

Title: Towelie
Line: Say, boys, this may sound a little ...odd, but... have you see a ...talking ...towel around anywhere.

Title: Towelie
Line: What? You mean Towelie? [the two soldier look alarmed. The passenger quickly gets on the radio]

Title: Towelie
Line: Echo, this is Garrett. I've got a code 5 at... [checks his map] Park County, Colorado! Repeat! Code 5, Park County, Colorado! [the men look at the boys]

Title: Towelie
Line: What, dude? [the driver steps on the gas and the car peels away. The passenger soldier looks out the window and back at the boys.]

Title: Towelie
Line: This is gonna be one looong-ass day. [Ms. Crabtree pulls up and the boys get on the bus.]

Title: Towelie
Line: Stan's house, Monday afternoon. The boys arrive there from the bus stop

Title: Towelie
Line: That was the longest day of school ever!

Title: Towelie
Line: Come on, hurry. I bet we can get to level 29! [the boys burst in and head for the television]

Title: Towelie
Line: Stan's house, living room. The boys stand in from of the television

Title: Towelie
Line: Where is it?

Title: Towelie
Line: It... it was right here.

Title: Towelie
Line: Where the hell is it??

Title: Towelie
Line: Come on, man, this isn't funny! [Kenny, Kyle, and Cartman look around and behind the TV] I need my fix! [the phone rings, and Stan goes to answer it.]

Title: Towelie
Line: Hello?

Title: Towelie
Line: If you ever wanna see your Okama GameSphere again, you will bring us the towel. [the boys gather to wait for Stan]

Title: Towelie
Line: What? Who-who is this?

Title: Towelie
Line: Just get the towel and meet us at the gas station outside of town. Or else! [in the background: "Okama GameSphere!"]

Title: Towelie
Line: Don't hurt it! [Click. Stan then hangs up]

Title: Towelie
Line: What? [Stan turns around]

Title: Towelie
Line: They've taken it. They've taken our Okama GameSphere.

Title: Towelie
Line: [in disbelief, backs up.] No! ...No!

Title: Towelie
Line: Uh-uh-uh what do you mean "they've taken it"? Oh, this isn't happening! This isn't happening!!

Title: Towelie
Line: South Park, sunset. The boys walk down Main Street.

Title: Towelie
Line: Towelie!

Title: Towelie
Line: Hey, towel!

Title: Towelie
Line: Where the hell is he?

Title: Towelie
Line: (I don't know. Where could it be?)

Title: Towelie
Line: I don't know. They guy on the phone thought we had Towelie, so now we gotta find him.

Title: Towelie
Line: What has this world come to? Where people can just... take your Okama GameSphere.

Title: Towelie
Line: Hey maybe we'd better do a towel call. [the others stop, and he calls out in one direction] Gebaayybeh! [then in another] Gebaayybeh!

Title: Towelie
Line: That's a towel call?

Title: Towelie
Line: This is hopeless. We're never gonna find him.

Title: Towelie
Line: Hey, wait a minute. Towelie always showed up to give us towel advice when we'd said something about water.

Title: Towelie
Line: Hey yeah. [goes into the street and clears his throat] Well guys, let's go to the swimming pool! [looks around. So do the others] Aaah. Let's go take a shower! [all look around] Let's go waterskiing!

Title: Towelie
Line: [walks up] Don't forget to bring a towel.

Title: Towelie
Line: There he is!

Title: Towelie
Line: Be sure to bring a towel so you don't get aaall wet. [Stan walks over angrily and takes Towelie's left hand, and pulls him along].

Title: Towelie
Line: Come on, dude! [the others follow]

Title: Towelie
Line: Where are we goin'?

Title: Towelie
Line: Just come on! It's getting dark.

Title: Towelie
Line: Are we gonna get high?

Title: Towelie
Line: Outskirts of South Park, night. A full moon shines down on the boys as they reach the gas station

Title: Towelie
Line: Are you sure this is where they said to be?

Title: Towelie
Line: They said the gas station outside of town.

Title: Towelie
Line: Well, I'm gonna get a little high. [A high-powered light comes on]

Title: Towelie
Line: Hold it! [ten men stand in the light. Some of them wear red berets]

Title: Towelie
Line: Who is that? [squints his eyes and blocks the light. Towelie does the same]

Title: Towelie
Line: Step... away... from the towel! [the boys do so, and an official steps forth]

Title: Towelie
Line: There you are, towel. We've been looking all over for you.

Title: Towelie
Line: If you ever go to a hotel, be sure to bring your own towel.

Title: Towelie
Line: It isn't safe for you out here, towel. There are people out here to mean to harm you.

Title: Towelie
Line: 'Scuse me, can we have our Okama GameSphere back? We just wanna play video games.

Title: Towelie
Line: Your what?

Title: Towelie
Line: Agh! Look, dude, we're on level 24, about to cross into the Caverns of Madness!

Title: Towelie
Line: I don't know what you're talking about.

Title: Towelie
Line: You called us and said if we brought the towel you'd give us our video game back.

Title: Towelie
Line: Omigod! [shrieks] IT"S A TRAP!! [gunfire strikes him and kills him. Behind the boys soldiers pop up in the hills and continue firing]

Title: Towelie
Line: Cover! Cover! [the officials and their personal security force fire back, and the light is knocked out]

Title: Towelie
Line: Goddamnit, what now?!

Title: Towelie
Line: Run, towel! [a grenade lands between two guards and blows up, shredding them to bits. The boys just look on]

Title: Towelie
Line: [disinterested] Agh. Come on, they've gotta have our video game around here somewhere. [leads the others away]

Title: Towelie
Line: Where's the towel?!

Title: Towelie
Line: It can't be far! [two more soldiers come up, and others move along behind them] Alvarez, you and Mitchell sweep left!

Title: Towelie
Line: [coughs up blood. The boys arrive] Hurry! You must get the towel back to Tynacorp!

Title: Towelie
Line: [grabs the guard by the lapels and throttles him] Where is our Okama GameSphere?

Title: Towelie
Line: Get the towel home [cough] They will explain everything. Please, hurry! [coughs up blood once more, and dies]

Title: Towelie
Line: Aw, God-damnit!

Title: Towelie
Line: Do you know where he's talking about, Towelie?

Title: Towelie
Line: What? Oh yeah, back at the base. It's a long ways away.

Title: Towelie
Line: Alright, we're gonna have to use this truck. Come on, guys. [they go for the truck. From a distance in a woods nearby, a commander looks at the troop movements]

Title: Towelie
Line: Well?

Title: Towelie
Line: They've gone, sir. It's like they've vanished out of thin air.

Title: Towelie
Line: Damnit! I knew those boys were protecting that towel. [gets pensive] They must have some unexplainable bond with it.

Title: Towelie
Line: Perhaps they're telepathically linked to the towel, sir, like E.T. [the commander looks at him annoyed, and he leaves]

Title: Towelie
Line: It could already be anywhere, hiding out again. No, the time for being nice is over. We must instigate... Plan B.

Title: Towelie
Line: You mean...?

Title: Towelie
Line: Yes. [camera zooms in] Destroy all towels within a thousand mile radius. [fade to black]

Title: Towelie
Line: A desert, later that night. The truck rolls along... Stan steers, Kyle, Towelie, and Cartman ride along. Kenny mans the pedals

Title: Towelie
Line: Are we getting close?

Title: Towelie
Line: I think so.

Title: Towelie
Line: A little more gas, Kenny. [Kenny presses down on the gas pedal]

Title: Towelie
Line: How long has it been since you've been back there.

Title: Towelie
Line: I've been wanderin' around on my own for the past few weeks. You know, helpin' people out with towel safety and proper towel use. It's important.

Title: Towelie
Line: No it isn't.

Title: Towelie
Line: Is!

Title: Towelie
Line: No it isn't.

Title: Towelie
Line: Is! Wait, turn down here. It's down this dirt road.

Title: Towelie
Line: Brake, Kenny, brake. [Kenny brakes, and Stan steers the truck to the right to go down the dirt road. Towelie moves to the window]

Title: Towelie
Line: Egh!

Title: Towelie
Line: M-maybe it's down that dirt road.

Title: Towelie
Line: [sighs] Dude, don't you remember where it is?

Title: Towelie
Line: I can't remember, it all looks the same. Hold on, let me get high. [pulls out a joint...] then I'll remember where it is. [lights the joint and puffs deeply. The boys watch him as his eyes get bloodshot.]

Title: Towelie
Line: Alright, so where is it?

Title: Towelie
Line: Where's what?

Title: Towelie
Line: Agh!

Title: Towelie
Line: The base where you're from and where our Okama GameSphere is! [Towelie simply snorts]

Title: Towelie
Line: Alright, that does it! Brake angrily, Kenny! [Kenny brakes angrily and the truck jerks to a stop] Now listen, Towelie, we've just about had it with you!

Title: Towelie
Line: Well calm down.

Title: Towelie
Line: That's it! [takes the joint] You're not getting high again until we have our Okama GameSphere back!

Title: Towelie
Line: That's my last joint, asshole!

Title: Towelie
Line: I don't care! You'd better remember where your base is!

Title: Towelie
Line: Oh man, why is everyone riding me today? God-damnit.

Title: Towelie
Line: A purple house, night. Inside, in the restroom, a woman washes her hands and face, then pulls a towel out of its rack to dry herself

Title: Towelie
Line: Kevin? Don't forget to wrap the potato salad in aluminum foil. [some strange sounds are heard outside the door] Kevin, is that you?

Title: Towelie
Line: Harris! Reach bang and clear!

Title: Towelie
Line: Hello? [the bathroom door flies open and five soldiers pour in, firing away] WAAH! [she falls to the ground quick] Ohmigod! Oh no! Ohmigod! [she covers her head]

Title: Towelie
Line: Alright, it's clear! It's clear! [the soldiers leave the restroom. The woman gets up and checks herself for bullet wounds and finds none. She turns to see the wall behind her. The towels on their rack are shot through with holes. She blinks, confused]

Title: Towelie
Line: a backyard. Mrs. Tweak pulls down some clothes she's had drying on clotheslines. As she nears the towels, three soldiers rush in and start firing away at them

Title: Towelie
Line: HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!! [Mrs. Tweak leans out of the way, watching her towels get shot up.]

Title: Towelie
Line: Let's go let's go! [The soldiers finish their job and walk away. Mrs. Tweak straightens up]

Title: Towelie
Line: A men's gym shower, night. Mr. Garrison is in the shower with two other men. He finishes and wraps a white towel with blue stripes around his waist, then walks towards his locker

Title: Towelie
Line: Get it!

Title: Towelie
Line: What the? [two soldiers rush over and make him face the lockers. One of them pulls off his towel]

Title: Towelie
Line: Throw it down! [the soldier throws it down]

Title: Towelie
Line: Oh alright, have your way with me if you must! Go on, fulfill you sick pleasures! [the soldier stabs at the towel twice, then directs another soldier to fire away at it. The other soldier shoots at it while the other two watch]

Title: Towelie
Line: Alright, let's go! [the soldiers leave]

Title: Towelie
Line: Huh where are you goin'?

Title: Towelie
Line: The truck the boys are driving pulls up in front of a gleaming glass building with "TYNACORP" above the entrance, and the boys pour out with Towelie

Title: Towelie
Line: This is where you came from?

Title: Towelie
Line: Yeah, I think so. [gets woozy] Oh man.

Title: Towelie
Line: What?

Title: Towelie
Line: I'm so high right now. I have no idea what's goin' on. [the group goes around the fountain and goes inside]

Title: Towelie
Line: Tynacorp, inside. The boys walk down a long passageway

Title: Towelie
Line: Welcome home, Smart Towel RG-400.

Title: Towelie
Line: Ah hi, is this where our Okama GameSphere is?

Title: Towelie
Line: We're missing out on some quality video game time right now.

Title: Towelie
Line: Thank you for bringing him to us, boys. You see, this is not an ordinary towel. He is the RG-400 Smart Towel, designed with a computer chip inside the terry cloth

Title: Towelie
Line: We don't care.

Title: Towelie
Line: You see, here at Tynacorp, our goal was to make the perfect towel. A towel that would sense how wet or dry the user's skin was and fluff itself accordingly.

Title: Towelie
Line: Dude, we don't care.

Title: Towelie
Line: Towelie was our greatest success. Smart enough to beat the average human at chess and absorbent enough to soak up even the toughest spills. But then one day, Towelie got high and just sort of wandered off.

Title: Towelie
Line: We... don't... care.

Title: Towelie
Line: All we wanna know is, who has our Okama GameSphere?

Title: Towelie
Line: Ah yes, your video game. I'm afraid that what we all experienced was a trap. They called you and said to bring the towel, and then they called us and said they were bringing Towelie back. Their plan was to wipe us all out with one fell swoop.

Title: Towelie
Line: Who's they?

Title: Towelie
Line: Why, the military. You see, after Towelie got high and wandered off from here, the military got a hold of him. They wanted to turn Towelie into a weapon of mass destruction.

Title: Towelie
Line: [dismissive] Don't care, don't care, don't care.

Title: Towelie
Line: Towelie was at their base for months as they tried to copy his TNA. But then, one day, Towelie got high and just sort of wandered off. Again.

Title: Towelie
Line: Goddamnit! Can we please... just get back to playing our video game, PLEASE?!

Title: Towelie
Line: I'm afraid not. Because your Okama GameSphere is at "their" base.

Title: Towelie
Line: Can you tell us where "that" is, please?

Title: Towelie
Line: You mean to go right into their base? [thinks] Of course. The entry code should still be in Towelie's memory banks. You could sneak him in there and recover his TNA. Great plan.

Title: Towelie
Line: Secret Government Base, night. Inside, various military officials man a command center. Two soldiers walk up to the commander and salute him

Title: Towelie
Line: Sir! Sergeant Masters and Boll are reporting, sir!

Title: Towelie
Line: Ah yes. [salutes back, and all three men lower their arms] Tell me, Marine, did you accomplish your primary goal?

Title: Towelie
Line: Sir yes sir! All towels have been destroyed! The Smart Towel is no doubt eliminated.

Title: Towelie
Line: Ahh. And you're... quite sure of this. [the two sergeants look at each other]

Title: Towelie
Line: Eh yes sir, there isn't a towel left within a hundred miles.

Title: Towelie
Line: Hmm... [taps his pointer on the strategic map] So perhaps, then, you can explain to me why we just got footage of the towel returning to Tynacorp?!

Title: Towelie
Line: Oo we...

Title: Towelie
Line: He must have outsmarted us, sir.

Title: Towelie
Line: Well I'm through playing hide and seek! We've got no other choice! Prepare to blow up all of Colorado!

Title: Towelie
Line: The night sky. Clouds float by overhead, past the full moon. A helicopter flies into the sky and the camera follows it. Two officials prepare the boys for dives into the military base as the research leader talks

Title: Towelie
Line: In a moment we will be over the base. This is the only way in. Any attempts on the ground would be easily spotted by guard posts.

Title: Towelie
Line: Okay.

Title: Towelie
Line: [rolls up to Towelie] I hate to send you back in there, Towelie, but only you have their security system in your memory banks.

Title: Towelie
Line: That's alright. It's always good to bring a towel.

Title: Towelie
Line: Good luck, boys. The fate of the world is depending on you.

Title: Towelie
Line: We're not doing it for the world, we're doing it for our video game. God, are you deaf?

Title: Towelie
Line: Alright, boys. When you drop from the plane, cover and roll. Got it?

Title: Towelie
Line: Yeah. [the boys join Towelie and all go to jump from the helicopter]

Title: Towelie
Line: Go go go go! [one after the other, the four boys and Towelie jump off, and then the helicopter leaves. Stan is the first to pull his parachute string, and the others follow. Soon they're all next to each other, floating down. Stan sighs]

Title: Towelie
Line: Dude, I figured it out.

Title: Towelie
Line: What?

Title: Towelie
Line: If we can go in, and get the GameSphere in 30 minutes, we could still be back at your house playing video games by midnight!

Title: Towelie
Line: So that'd be, like what, eight hours we could play before school?

Title: Towelie
Line: Seven and a half.

Title: Towelie
Line: [getting impatient] Hurry up, stupid parachute!

Title: Towelie
Line: Secret Government Base, night. The boys land silently and start walking

Title: Towelie
Line: Alright, I think we go over there. [the Secret Government Base entrance is shown with Towelie and the boys approaching the gate]

Title: Towelie
Line: [at the security entry pad] Let's see. [types in some numbers] No. [touches his lips with his right index finger, trying to figure out what to type next]

Title: Towelie
Line: Come on, Towelie! The guy said you have the security system in your memory banks.

Title: Towelie
Line: Hey it's been a long time!

Title: Towelie
Line: You just have no long-term memory 'cause you get high all the time!

Title: Towelie
Line: [faces Cartman] Don't preach to me, fatso!

Title: Towelie
Line: I can preach to you all I want, 'cause you're stupid!

Title: Towelie
Line: You're stupid!

Title: Towelie
Line: Yeah, and you're a towel!

Title: Towelie
Line: You're a towel! [Cartman has nothing more to say, and Towelie hops off the box towards the boys] Just let me get high. I know I can remember if I get high.

Title: Towelie

Title: Asspen
Line: My God, can you believe those people?!

Line: I have to do this, okay? I have to!

Line: Alright, well, if you gotta get good at somethin' really fast, there's only one way to do it. Come on!

Title: Asspen
Line: The day is approaching to give it your best You've got to reach your prime! Title: Asspen
Line: Aspen Heaven meeting room, day. Two officers are present with the two salesmen and the six parents.

Title: Asspen
Line: All the ad said was that we had to attend a thirty-minute meeting, right, and- and it's been a day and a half! These guys won't let us leave!

Title: Asspen
Line: That's not true, officers, we said they could leave at any time.

Title: Asspen
Line: All right, let me see if I got this straight. You two gentlemen are offering part-time limited liability [suddenly animated] ownership in one of your fabulous condos for the one-time price of eight thousand dollars?!

Line: That's right!

Line: Sounds to me like if anybody should be arrested it should be you people for passin' up such a great deal!

Line: Oh, Jesus.

Title: Asspen
Line: The powder is fresh and the stage is set for Tad versus Stan on the K-13!

Line: K-13 peak. Tad and Stan are ready to ski.

Title: Asspen
Line: This time you're not just gonna lose, you're gonna die!

Title: Asspen
Line: I can't lose another friend. First Kenny and now Stan? All I'm gonna have left are you two douches. [Cartman gives him an angry look]

Title: Asspen
Line: Ready. Set. Go! [the crowd cheers and Tad takes off. Stan begins to ski]

Title: Asspen
Line: Pizza... pizza... pizza...

Line: Come on, Stan! [Tad is shown zipping down the hill, Stan is still at the summit making his way down]

Title: Asspen
Line: [stops near a tree] Haha. [pulls out a small saw hidden in the back side of his jacket] This should slow down Darsh a bit! [goes to the tree and starts sawing it off at the base. Stan has gone down the mountain some more]

Title: Asspen

Line: [stops and looks up the hill, then leaves. He returns with a bucket of sand and pours it out]Let's see what some sand does to your speed, Darsh! [leaves. Stan continues his run. [tosses the bucket away and leaves]

Title: Asspen
Line: [as the crowd cheers] The race is half over and Tad is still out in the lead! [Stan is moving along nicely. Tad stops further down and pushes a large cage of hamsters onto the slope]

Line: Heh, when Darsh skis by here, I'll let all these hamsters go. That should distract him just long enough for me to win the race!

Line: [walks in] Oh, Tad.

Line: [walks up to Stan] Stan, I was wrong about you. Would you like to go out again? [Stan looks at her incredulously]

Line: No! Line: Sometimes.

Line: Yes.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Yeah, I had the minestrone over here. [Butters laughs at his own cleverness. The diners look at him]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: I am Professor Chaos, and now, this puny world uh will bow down to me! [cackles once again and runs out of the restaurant. The diners resume their eating after a few seconds.]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Montage 1 - A Day At The Amusement Park.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [voice over a scene of all the kids walking down Main Street at the amusement park] So today we went to the amusement park with all our possible friends. [cut to Stan seated on a green sofa under a spotlight] It was a really fun time. We rode all the rides and everyone got along great.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [on a blue sofa] I think the person that stood out most at the amusement park was Jimmy. [cut to Jimmy entertaining Stan, Kyle, Cartman, Dougie, Clyde, and Craig]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [cut to Jimmy on a dark green sofa] Well, the, the reason I think I would make the perfect foreh- friend, is that I love telling jokes. You know, who doesn't like to laugh?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [seated on a cyan sofa] Tweek. Now there's an interesting choice. Tweek has a lot of qualities that I look for in a friend.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [sipping coffee, shaking violently] What if they don't pick me? What if they get us all, man! I mean, Christ! If they can get to the Pentagon, then they can get to us all, man! Aaaa!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [a shot of the kids on the mine track ride, DogPoo in front with Cartman. Cut to the dirty boy who resembles Pigpen seated on a red sofa] I think I deserve to take Kenny's place the most, because, I've been hanging around these guys for like five years and I never get to say or do anything.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: ...Yeah, I've only seen that kid in class, but he never does anything. He's more like a prop. [takes a sip of ZOOP soda]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [a shot of Kyle, Cartman, Tweek, and Towelie in a spinning teacup] Towelie is a tough choice because, [cut to Kyle talking] even though I can see how always having a towel around can come in handy, he's just always so high.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [17 in towel years] Man, I really hope I win, because... wait... what is this again? I have no idea what's goin' on.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: We decided to get some one-on-one time with Jimmy and ride the log ride. [cut to the log ride] The great thing was that, because Jimmy's crippled, we got to go to the front of the line. [the boys are escorted to the first car, cut back to Cartman] That was definitely big points for Jimmy, you know, but, but then we got to the ride itself, and...

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [back at the ride. Stan, Kyle, and Cartman climb into the log] Hey, I-I'm gonna need some help getting in the log, fellas.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: O! Shut her down. Someone needs assistance.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [the boys look at Jimmy] Oh, really? [turns to his note pad] That's gonna cost some points. [writes down some numbers as Jimmy is helped into the log.]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [on the sofa] But right now I'd say if we're gonna have a retard for a friend, I, I have to pick Timmy. Because Timmy doesn't tell lame jokes.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [cut to log ride. The boys are about to slide down the track] Boy, isn't this great fellas? Are we great pals or what?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [voice over a scene of all the kids walking down Main Street at the amusement park] One thing for sure: picking our new friend isn't gonna be easy.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: South Park, day. Butters is still dressed as Professor Chaos, still walking down the street. A dog walks across the street and Butters stops next to it.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Kneel. Kneel before Professor Chaos! [the dog slowly kneels and Butters walks off cackling at his success]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Butters' house, later. He makes it to his room and locks the door. He cackles again.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Ah, the look on their faces when they got the wrong soup. I love bringing chaos! [walks up to his dresser drawer and messes up some shirts in there, then closes the drawer and laughs] And that's only the beginning! [laughs evilly]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Cartman's backyard, day. All the kids are seated as they were yesterday. A box of roses sits on stage.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: All right, everyone. It was a tough decision, but based on our time with you all at the amusement park, we have whittled our choices down to ten. [Kyle goes off to get the box of roses] If you receive a rose, please stay. If you don't, get the fudge out. [Kyle returns with the roses and sets them down] Kyle, will you announce the people we want to stay?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [holds up a rose for every kid he calls] Token. [Token approaches, gets his rose and goes back to his seat] Clyde. [Clyde goes for his rose] Craig. [Craig goes for his rose] Timmy.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Timmih! [goes for his rose]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh man! This is too much pressure!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Pip. [Pip smiles and goes for his rose] Jimmy. [Jimmy goes for his rose] Jason. [a new boy with high forehead, goes for his rose] Towelie. [Towelie goes for his rose] Luigi. [Luigi goes for his rose].

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Just one more rose left, Kyle. Who does it go to?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Tweek.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Aaarr! [goes for his rose]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: All right, the rest of you, thanks for coming. Get the fudge out! [the others moan and leave their seats]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [incredulous] I didn't make the cut?? Oh God, I didn't make the cut??

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: I didn't even get a chance to have them get to know me!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: All right, congratulations to those of you selected to stay. In the end, one of you will be the new Kenny. [the camera pans over the remaining candidates] Good luck.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: South Park, morning. Butters' house, kitchen. Linda is preparing some breakfast and Butters comes in confidently.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Good morning, Butters.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [takes a a seat at the table] It certainly is, Mother. Did ya hear about what's been goin' on? Some horrible new supervillain made somebody get the wrong soup order at Bennigan's.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: No, [Butters blanches] I didn't hear about that.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Yeh, you didn't? [leaves his seat and walks to the living room]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Butters' house, living room. Butters walks up to Chris, who is on the sofa reading the newspaper.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Uh Dad, can I uh can I see the newspaper real quick?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [lowers the newspaper] Why sure, Butters. I was just about to get some breakfast. [hands the paper to Butters, who sets it down on the floor and looks for headlines. The front page doesn't offer anything he's looking for, so he turns the page.]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [getting mad] Nothing. [turns the next page] Nothing! [closes the paper and stands up] It's the liberal media! They're keeping the stories of my deeds covered up, so as not to cause a panic. Well, I guess it's time to step it up a notch! [makes two fists signaling his stepped-up efforts]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: The bus stop, later. Stan, Kyle and Cartman stand with Craig. Scene music plays.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Okay, next? [signals for Craig to leave. Craig walks away and Token comes in to take his place. Scene music plays. A few moments for the boys to get a feel for Token]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: This looks pretty good.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Yeah, it's not bad. Next? [Signals for Token to leave. Token walks away and Timmy rides in to take his place. Scene music plays.]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Timmay!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Next?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: South Park Elementary, day. Most of the class is present. Stan, Kyle, and Cartman stand at the front of the class. On the chalkboard is the times table for 4.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Okay, so now we're gonna see how you all work as a friend during classtime. Your performances will be judged primarily on how you help us cheat and give us answers. So good luck, everybody.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [entering] Sit down, boys.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Alrighty then. [the boys take their seats]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: All right, children, before we get started, has anybody seen the eraser for the chalkboard? [a shot of the class, then of Butters. A sneer comes to his face as he laughs to himself. The room darkens around him and a shadow appears on the lower part of his face] It probably got knocked on the floor somewhere. Can you all just please look around your desks for it? [the kids drop from their seats and look around. The sneer is back on Butters' face and the shadow returns]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [thinking] Yes. Look around for your precious eraser. You won't find it. That eraser's in my back yard, buried three feet below the surface of the earth. [a shot of Butters using a shovel to bury the eraser] And do you even suspect me?? No! Now we shall all see how you all like your dear chalkboard without an eraser. [Butters' desk moves around so the camera can see the kids looking for the eraser] And information, it just keeps pilin' up and pilin' up, until your minuscule brains can take it no longer! [the times table floats behind Butters and gets all jumbled up as he speaks, finally ending in a kid whose brains blow out of his head]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: No? Oh, oh well. Never mind. I've got a backup one in the desk. [opens a drawer, takes out an eraser and erases the times table on the board] Okay, today children, we're gonna learn about multiplying times five.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [thwarted, begins to think again. The people around him take on their picture-negative counterparts] So! You all think that you can outsmart Professor Chaos, do you?!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Now, whenever we multiply a number times five, the result is going to end in a zero or a five.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Ms. Choksondik?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [turns around] What is it, Butters?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Ah, I need to go to the bathroom. R-really bad.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh alright Butters. Take the bathroom pass and go. [Butters gets off his seat and heads for the door. He takes the pass from the pegboard] Okay, so for instance, children-

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [opens the door, then looks back] Alright. I'm goin' to the bathroom now. If anybody needs me, ah that's where I'll be.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Just go, Butters. [Butters smiles and leaves] Okay, so for instance, five times one is... what, Eric?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Uh, what's the question again?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [holds out the five fingers on her right hand] Five... times... [holds out the index finger on her left hand] one.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Five times one is of course...

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [minus Cartman, Stan, and Kyle] Five.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Five. [the door opens and Professor Chaos appears]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [enters cackling] The time for fun and games is over, feeble-minded fools! [approaches Ms. Choksondik]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Who are you?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: I am Professor Chaos! Bringer of destruction and maker of doom! Those who do not know me yet shall know me very soon, for the hour of Chaos ih-is at hand! [turns, takes the other eraser, and walks out cackling, closing the door. The class just looks at the door]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Hey! That kid took my last eraser! [heads for the door] Come back here, kid! [as she reaches the door, it opens and Butters enters]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh! Ah, I'm back from the bathroom. Ah I really let one go in there.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Butters, did you see another little kid run out of here?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Why yes, I did. But he pushed me down and I scraped my elbow. [raises his right elbow] Go on and look at it. It's scraped. Look. [as Ms. Choksondik looks at the elbow, the shadow and sneer return to Butters' face. He begins to think] Yeesss. Go on and see the red mark on my elbow, the red mark I made myself to throw you off Professor Chaos's trail.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: It looks fine, Butters. [rises and addresses the class] Okay, hold on and stay here, children. [leaves the classroom. Butters sneers again]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: South Park Elementary, later. Recess. The kids are at play. Stan, Kyle, Cartman, and Craig are standing together.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: You're such a fatass, Cartman!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh yeah?! Well, you're a stupid Jew!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Shut up, fatass! [silence. They look at Craig and the anger fades from their faces as they wait for him to respond]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh, aaaah, well you guys are dumb.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [escorts Craig away] Okay, Craig, interesting choice. Powerful stuff there, Craig. Thank you very much. [Craig leaves]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Butters' house, night. Butters is at his desk working with his hamster set.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: It is almost ...complete. The creation of my minions who will assist me in bringing terror to the world. [puts glue on some aluminum, puts the aluminum on a hamster] There we go. [the hamsters will be armored, as he is. He places the hamster back in the cage] Ye-ess, my minions of, of chaos. [the hamsters begin to make noise] Shhh. Night now, night now my lovelies. Your time to bring dest-struction will come very soon. [the door opens and Butters quickly throws a blanket over his hamster cage] Aaahhh!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [Linda walks in and towards his desk] Butters, a note for you was left on the front door.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: A note?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Here you go. [gives it to him and walks out] And wash your hands after you touch those hamsters - you'll get AIDS. [exits and closes the door]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Okay, Mom. [takes a look at the envelope, spins around in his chair, and opens the envelope. He reads the letter within: "I know who you are. The South Park Docks. 7:30. Tonight"] So. Someone has discovered my horrible secret. This could be a trap set by the FBI. Oh, I'll be at the docks, precious FBI! But it is I who'll have the trap set for you! Come, my minions! [pulls off the blanket] We haven't much time!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Cartman's backyard, night. Stan, Kyle and Cartman are on stage for the next round of elimination.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: All right, everyone, the time has come for us to narrow the list down from ten to six. But first, let us just say that the people who we didn't pick were only not picked because they totally sucked balls. Kyle?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: They're not going to pick me. I just know they're not.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: O-oh Jesus! Aaah I can't take it!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [as before, holds up a rose for every name] Token.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: All right! [goes for his rose]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Timmy.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Timmay! [goes for his rose]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Tweek. [Tweek goes for his rose] Pip.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Really? I don't believe it. [goes for his rose]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Towelie.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: What?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Just one more rose, Kyle.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Jimmy.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh boy! Oh thank God! [goes for his rose]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: All right, those with roses will move on to the swimsuit and talent competition. The rest of you, get the fudge out! [Craig, Clyde, Jason, and Luigi leave]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [turns and looks at Cartman] This whole thing is stupid! You don't pick people you wanna be with by making it into a game!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Ooooooo, somebody's a sore loser! Clyde, I believe I said, "get the fudge out!" Which means, kiss mah fudgin' ass, go fudge yourself, fudge ya, get the fudge out, Clyde!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: South Park docks, night. Under a red moon, Butters sneaks along the docks, making sure no one sees him. He creeps from box to box and peeks out from behind one. Another face peeks out from behind a box at the other end of the docks. This face is younger, with glasses.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [steps out] Hey Butters.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [drops his guard and steps out] Oh, hey Dougie. [gets into character] Oh I mean, my name is Professor Chaos.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: I saw you change in the school bathroom. You stole that eraser in your class.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Very well. You called out Professor Chaos, and you also called out, eh your own demise! [pulls out two hamsters from his pockets and sets them down] Go now, my minions. Go and take this, this foolish mortal down! [the hamsters head back towards shore] Aw minions, naw, not that way. He- [turns to see them leave] come back minions.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: I'm, not trying to call you out, Professor Chaos. I want to join you.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Join me?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Yeah I want to join you in your conquest of destruction.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: But why?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [approaching] I'm an outcast, too. A frail child cast aside by society. I want to follow you and... whatever you're doing.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Uh very well. You shall be my accomplice in evil. Together, we shall bring the world to its knees! A-and make all those who banished us from society run... red.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Do I get a neato costume made out of aluminum foil, too?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Well sure you do. Ah I am professor, and you shall be my general. From now on you are General... Disarray.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: General Disarray.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Now let us go look for my minions! [softly] They ran away here, now to find 'em... [the new villainous duo search the docks for the hamsters]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Montage 2 - The Swimsuit And Talent Competition. Stan, Kyle, and Cartman sit on the chairs in the audience. The six remaining candidates are on stage.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [a shot of him on a sofa] The swimsuit competition really gave us a fresh look at some of the candidates. [a shot of the three boys making comments during judging. Cartman takes notes]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [on a sofa] Well, I don't think I did too well in the... bathing suit competition. But I can't wait for the talent show competition. That'll really be my chance to... shine. [cut to Cartman's house den for the competition. Jimmy's doing his comedy routine] Wow, what a terrific audience. So anyway, a guy walks into a buh- ...A guy walks into a b- ...buh... [a shot of the three boys getting bored] A guy walks into a guy walks into a [goes into a sing-song mode] babuh ba-a-a, uh- [next, Towelie playing an electric guitar - "Stairway To Heaven" - but messes up]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Okay wait... [starts over, but messes up. The boys are bored again] No, no wait. [tries again]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Next please.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [takes the mic] Well, what am I supposed to do?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Anything that'll impress us, Token.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: If you were our friend, how would you keep us entertained?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Aaaah. Oh, I know. [takes his shirt and ties it into a knot between his breasts, then begins to shake his butt, giving the impression of a hula girl]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Very nice. [takes notes]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: I like it. [takes notes]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [back to recap] Well Token was a definite winner of the talent show. But then we decided to take everyone to a baseball game, to see how we got along there.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Coors Field in Denver. The game is underway. A shot of the field.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: There goes a hit to left field, and Foley's going to score.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: The bleachers. Stan, Kyle, Cartman, and Pip sit and watch the game.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Woohoo!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Yeah! Isn't this great?!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [making his way down the steps] Drinks! Get your drinks here.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Eho! Yes. Can I have some tea, please?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: You don't drink tea at a baseball game, you French piece of crap!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh, very well. Just some crumpets, then.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: All right, that does it! Pip, get the fudge out! Next! [Pip leaves his seat and Token comes in]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Okay, let's try this. [a shot of the field. The Jumbotron at center field loses focus and glimpses of Professor Chaos are seen]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Hey, what's wrong with the Jumbotron?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: People of Earth! Your meaningless lives are about to end! I am Professor Chaos, [Dougie comes into view] and this is my partner ih-in evil, General Disarray! In the past few days I have rained terror down upon the society that shunned me! And now it is time for my final Labor of Loathing! I am going to... flood... the world!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Flood the world?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: My God!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [grabs onto someone] I don't wanna die, [screams] I DON'T WANNA DIE!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh yes. Every living creature and every sacred building will soon be under leagues and leagues of cold and dark water. And there is nothing you can do to stop me! General Disarray, begin the flooding of Earth! [Dougie goes to the faucet by the porch and turns it on, then brings the hose to Butters. Butters addresses the world] You brought this upon yourselves! You made the outcasts of the world! Now watch! Watch as your precious planet drowns! Watch! [points at the pool of water now forming on the ground. The crowd watches in silence]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Dear Christ, who will save us?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: We have very little time to live. How, how shall we spend our last hours on earth? [the crowd stops and reflects...]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Yeah! All right! [everyone takes off their clothes and celebrates in their underwear]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Butters' house, day. Butters and Dougie are in the back yard watching their puddle grow and grow.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Our reign of terror is complete! Our tur- turmoil has now come full circle! [the two of them watch the hose yield its water, seemingly slowly] Hey, is the hose on full, General Disarray? [Dougie goes to look, then returns]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: It's on all the way.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh. Alright then. Nothing to do now but watch the world die! [cackles and dances around, then resumes watching the puddle grow. Day fades to night] Boy, this sure is takin' a long time.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Stan's house, dining room. The three boys sit at the table with pictures of the six candidates. They discuss their findings.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Okay, so how do we all feel about Towelie as our new friend? [holds up Towelie's picture]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: I think Towelie is awesome.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Towelie is cool, but he gets stoned all the time. You can't really rely on him for anything.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [weary] Oh, this is giving me a headache.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Eh now, [pounds the table with his fist] come on, you guys, we can't take this decision lightly. Whoever we pick is going to be the person we do everything with from now on.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [acquiescing] You're right. Well now, how about Timmy? [holds up Timmy's picture] He's quiet and he takes direction well. Really the perfect friend.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Yeah, but Timmy can be really self-centered.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: How about Token? [holds up Token's picture]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Token's a smartass.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: So? You're a smartass!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Yeah. Do we really need another one?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Good point. [Stan sets the picture down. A door opens]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [approaches the table] Hey fellas. I was just in the neighborhood and I thought I'd stop by to s-gif- gift basket.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [disgusted] Oh, thanks Jimmy.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: There's some chocolates and lih-liquorice, and some games and peh- pencils inside.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: That's great.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Cool.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Yeah well, I guess I'll be seeing you, you friends later. [leaves]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Alright Jimmy, see ya. [the door closes]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Suckup.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Butters' house, next day, backyard. The pool has covered much of the yard. General Disarray jumps in the water as Professor Chaos looks on passively on the porch.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Not long now, General Disarray, and... our horrible plan will be complete.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Hey, do you think maybe we should build a boat? You know, like a little raft or something, so that when the world floods you and me and the minions can live?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh yeah. I hadn't thought o' that. That's a pretty good idea. I'll go get a hammer. [the sound of vehicles screeching to a stop outside the yard] Hey, who is that? [on the street, two Water Department vans come to a stop. Four men, two from each van, step out and get their tools. They enter the yard and approach the hose]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Is this it?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Yeah, two thirteen, that's the one. [Worker 1 proceeds to close the faucet]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Heeyyy, what are you doin'? [Worker 1 finishes and the workers leave, climb into their vans, and drive off. Professor Chaos and General Disarray look on in sad disbelief. Suddenly, Butters flares up] Aaaah! You may have won this time! But I will be back!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: What do we do now?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [softly, pensive] Well I had another idea of how to kill the world, but I thought it was... almost too horrible to e- to even speak of, but- [with anger growing] but now they have left me with no other choice!

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Cartman's backyard, day. Stan, Kyle, and Cartman are on stage while the candidates sit in the audience. Pip is missing.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Well, this is it. We have made our final decision and one of you is who we will be spending our childhood with, as our new friend. [the camera pans across the audience, showing the candidates close-up]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Oh puh please. Oh, Oh God... please. [Timmy just grins. Kyle draws the last rose from the box.]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Four friends, just one rose. The moment of truth is here. Kyle? Who does the rose go to? [another shot of the candidates]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: A hilltop, later. Butters reaches the top of a hill carrying a box, with a red sky above him. He sets the box down.

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: This is it, General Disarray. My final solution. [cut to a view of the town from said hill. ]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: [catches up] What evil plot do you have this time, Professor Chaos?

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Simple, my dear general. We are going to tear down the Earth's precious atmosphere! Oh yes! My latest plan will melt the polar ice caps, a-and burn all the world with the, with the... hu- sun's harmful rays! [reaches into the box and withdraws a spray can] Say goodbye to your... precious ozone and hello to chaos! [begins spraying away. The can empties without discernible effect, and Butters tosses it down] Okay, hand me another one, General Disarray. [Dougie reaches in the box and takes out three cans. He gives one to Butters and keeps the other two. Butters quickly opens the can and sprays away, cackling all the while. Dougie opens his two cans and begins spraying as well, cackling along with Butters. The camera begins to zoom out]

Title: Professor Chaos
Line: Will Professor Chaos's latest plot succeed and be the final undoing of Earth? [a shot of Stan, Cartman, Kyle, and the fourth boy under a blanket, all in Stan's living room] And which boy has been chosen to be the replacement for Kenny?
