Line: The blackjack table. Gerald sits alone fiddling with some chips. Randy returns from somewhere with a cup of coins.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: How's it goin', Gerald?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [nervous, fidgeting] Ohh, not so good.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah, I know what you mean. I'm down three hundred bucks.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah. I'm down twenty-six thousand.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah, well, maybe we should- ...wait. Twenty-six thousand dollars??

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: I forgot to tell you, ah I have a gambling problem.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Gerald, twenty-six thousand-!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Sshhhh! I have to win it back before Sheila finds out!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Where did you get that kind of money??

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: The casino gave me credit! I put the house up as collateral! But I still have this ten-dollar chip.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Dealer, twenty one. [takes the last chip] Sorry.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [collapses on the table] That's it. I'm destitute. [leaps up and grabs Randy] Loan me money! You've gotta have money in the cup! [grabs the cup and tries to wrest it from Randy] Wha- what's in the cup?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [keeps the cup] Just six quarters!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [sits down and mopes] Oh God. Oh Jesus.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Thank you for playing at Three Feathers. May your life be filled with the song of the sparrow.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [bolts upright again] Oh, shove the song of the sparrow up your ass!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Three Bears Casino, sometime later. Randy and Gerald sit on a bench next to some slot machines. Gerald's head hangs low.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: How am I going to tell my family? [raises his head] How do I tell them that tomorrow, we have to ...pack up our things and ...get out of the house? [Sheila and Sharon show up in the background with the boys.]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: There's daddy!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [hangs his head] Oh, Jesus. [the boys and the women arrive.]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Where have you guys been? We've been looking all over.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah. Come on, Dad, this place sucks. I wanna go.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [raises his head] What, What did you say?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: I said I wanna leave.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [shifts gears and stands] Oh, you wanna leave, huh?! Okay, fine, Kyle, when we get home, we'll just pack up our things, load them in the car, and we'll leave! [Sheila and Kyle are baffled]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: What?? No, no, I mean, I-

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: No, no, no, if you wanna leave South Park, fine! Tomorrow we're leaving!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Gerald, what are you talking about?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Oh, you heard him, Sheila! Kyle wants to leave! Our nice old house doesn't interest Kyle anymore! Well I'm calling a moving company right now! [leaves]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Well, you shouldn't be such a dick, dude. [Kyle remains baffled, even as he looks at Cartman]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [walks up to Randy] What's wrong with Gerald?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: He... he lost his house to the Native Americans.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: What?? But don't the Native Americans know he has nowhere else to go?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: They don't care. [the camera rises and focuses on a window behind them]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: The casino office. Chief Runs with Premise looks out over the floor.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Look at them! Small-minded idiots pouring their life-savings away!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Their cash flows out of them like diarrhea from the buffalo.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [wearing glasses] Yes, but we have milked these simple mountain folk almost dry. If we really want to see cash flow, we need to bring in city-people from Denver.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [turns around] Yeessss. It is time for us to implement our plan. [walks over to an easel on which sits a map of Colorado, with a new highway drawn on it between the casino and Denver] A superhighway, built from Denver right to our casino!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: And what do we do about the small town of South Park that lies in the highway's way?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [holding up large stacks of bills] Simple. We buy it, and we demolish it! Ha ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Ha ha ha ha!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: South Park Elementary, next day. A town meeting is being held in the gym. Mayor McDaniels sits at a table with four aides, two on either side of her.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: And that's really all I can tell you. The town of South Park is going to be leveled, in order to make way for a twelve-lane superhighway.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [rises] But how can they do that?!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: The Native Americans have purchased the land out from under us. Tomorrow, they're buying the last of what they need to have complete ownership.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [rises] Well can't we stop them? Let's call the bank.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: The Native Americans bought the bank.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Oh my God.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Now, look, it isn't all horrible. The Native Americans are offering you retail values on your homes.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: No, screw that! We'll just pool our money together and buy the town ourselves! [the town clamors in agreement]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [rises] Yeah! Let the South Park people own South Park! [the town clamors in agreement]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: How much do we have to raise, Mayor?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Three hundred thousand dollars. [the town thinks, then grumbles]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Ohhh, never mind. [sits down]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: The town library. Nine boys sit in front of it: Timmy, Jimmy, Tweek, Butters, Stan, Kyle, Cartman, Kenny, and Alex.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: How can they do that, huh? How can they make us all move away?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Because they're rich, greedy-ass Indians!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [correcting] Native Americans. [Stan rises and walks away from the building]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Our whole town, gone. We'd had such great times here. [begins to reminisce]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: The scenes are as follows: Zombies destroy the town as the boys walk through in their Halloween costumes. Trapper Keeper grabs a phone booth as it reaches mammoth dimensions. The townsfolk fight the mutant turkeys. Christopher Reeve throws a truck at some people, and they dive out of the way. The giant fireworks snake demolishes the town. The Geldon causes havoc on the Drew Carey Show as the Knights of Standards and Practices watch. The pirate ghost ship fires off a cannon shot and the townsfolk dive out of the way. Some of them are killed on impact. The pro-war and anti-war factions fight over the Iraq war. The town reenacts the Civil War Mr. Hankey summons up massive amounts of crap in order to get rid of the Hollywood gliterati Mecha-Streisand fights off Ultura Marutin and Megara Poatia.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [stops reminiscing, turns around, and walks back to the boys] We can't let them do it, you guys! We have to find a way to stop those Native Americans!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah, this is our town!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We shouldn't have to make a bunch of new friends somewhere else. We're a team!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: That's right!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah, ahh, that's right!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah, we're a team!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We just gotta figure out a way to raise three hundred thousand dollars! [the boys start thinking]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [rises and moves to the sidewalk] Wait a minute! I've got it, you guys! We can get Kyle infected with AIDS! And then start a charity organization that we steal money from! Come on, let's go! [trots off excitedly. The other boys just watch him leave. Cartman returns a few seconds later] No? We can't give Kyle AIDS?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We need something that'll get us money tomorrow!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Hey, I know! How about a dog parade? [smiles]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Dog parade?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah! We dress up all our dogs in little outfits, and parade them down the street. [closes his eyes and beams] It'll be so adorable!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: How do we make three hundred thousand dollars doing that?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Oh... Uh well, we could sell tickets to our moms and dads.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Our moms and dads are the ones who need money, Butters!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Oh... [the boys go back to thinking]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Maybe give Kyle AIDS, huh? Lookin' a little better now.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: South Park, later on, day. The Broflovski house is shown, and a massive bulldozer rolls up to knock it down. A large chunk of it is torn off by the scoop.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Oh, Gerald, I, I can't watch!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [walks up to the Chief] How can you do this to people?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We're sorry. But if we do not build a superhighway, our casino might stop seeing profits.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: There's more to life than profits!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Well like what?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Well like, you know, Slurpees and stuff. [more of the house is torn down]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Well, come on, honey, I guess we should start packing up our things as well.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah. [begins to wave] So long, South Park.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Mom! Dad! We figured out a way we could raise three hundred thousand dollars!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: A dog parade? [smiles in anticipation]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: No!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Stan, we've all tried to raise money, but we only raise ten thousand dollars, and the deadline is tomorrow.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: I know. So how about we take the ten thousand dollars back to the Indian casino? Tell them, Kyle!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [opens a book he's carrying and reads] The odds on a single number in roulette are thirty-five to one. [looks up and closes the book] That means, with a ten thousand dollar bet, you win three hundred and fifty thousand.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Boys, that's ridiculous.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Look, we- we've got nothing to lose.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: What do you guys think?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: It's a long shot.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah. [turns around and makes fists with determination] But it's the only shot we've got to save our town.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Three Feathers Casino, that night. The townsfolk are there once more.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [reading from a newspaper] The residents of South Park had hoped to raise three hundred thousand dollars. but in the end managed to raise only ten. The loss of their town may be imminent for the poor people of South Park. [fakes sadness] Awww, I think I'm going to cwy.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: HA ha ha ha! HA ha ha ha!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: The doors open and the townsfolk surge in. Randy carries a large amount of yellow chips.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: All right, boys. You're gonna have to wait here. [the adults begin to move past the boys]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Dad. [Randy turns around] Good luck.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: It's in God's hand now. [turns around and moves forward] Stand aside, everyone! [the adults move towards the roulette table. The Chief notices a change in atmosphere and rises to see what's going on from his office.]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: What are they doing?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We're gonna try and beat you at your own game, Chief Runs With Premise! Ten thousand dollars! [sets the yellow chips down] On thirty one black! [moves the chips towards the number. Everyone gasps. The dealer takes the chips and puts them away, substituting some blue chips for the yellow ones.]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Impossible!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [begins to wish hard] Come on! Come on! [the dealer starts the wheel and tosses the ball in the opposite direction. Everyone looks on in anticipation. The ball slows down and settles in on thirty one black.]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Thirty one. Black. [the town erupts with joy]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah! All right! Woohoo! Oh we did it! We did it! Oh my God! Oh this is amazing!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: No... NOOO! [The boys cheer. Cartman and Kenny hug]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: South Park is saved. [the dealer adds more blue chips to the amount bet]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We have plenty enough to save our town now!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah! But wait. [the rush of winning gets to him] Three hundred and fifty thousand dollars. That means if we won again, it will be twelve and a quarter million! [the people gasp a bit at the possibility]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We can save the town and be super-rich!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Oh hell yeah! Let it ride!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Let it ride!!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Woohoo! Yeah! [they stay with thirty one black, and the dealer spins again]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: What the hell are they doing??

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Let's go thirty one! Let's see it! [the ball bounces around and settles in on two red.]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Two, red. You lose.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: AWWWWWWW!!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Dammit!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [satisfied with this result] Hmmm! [walks off]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: They, they had it! They freakin' had it!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: The road. The Marshes drive home in their car. Randy drives, Sharon sits on the passenger side. Stan sits between Shelly and Grandpa in the back seat.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: You totally had it! You had enough to save the town and then some.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Stan? Okay? You just don't understand the fine points of gambling. You're never supposed to stop when you're on a winning streak.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: A winning streak??!! You played one game!!!!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Stan? Okay?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: What???

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: All right? Stan? Okay?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: You people just got greedy, like the Native Americans! [Randy brakes the car angrily]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [menacingly] Hey, mister!! We're not like them, all right?! [turns and faces Stan] Now, we may have pie in the sky dreams once in a while, but we aren't the ones kicking people out of their homes! So don't you compare us to those cold-hearted, money-grubbing, evil stinky Indians! [turns back to the wheel] I'm sorry, Native Americans.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: South Park, next day. A "SOLD" sign is placed above the town sign, indicating that the town, indeed, has been sold. At South Park Elementary, the residents stand in long lines waiting for the checks being offered for their homes.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [facing Mr. Garrison] There you are, sir. There's the check for your home. Just sign here, and here.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [signing] Well, this is it, Mr. Slave. We're officially homeless.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [sobbing] Jesus! Jesus Christ!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [walks up to Randy, who is in line with the others] Dad, what are you doing?! Don't take their dirty money!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Stanley, we don't have a choice. The Native Americans own South Park now. We have to take what they'll give us for our homes.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: There you go. Have a nice day. [hands a check to Liane, who turns around and walks off with it]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [walks with his friends to a clearing where he could be heard] Come on, you guys! This is our town!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: It's over, Stanley. What else can we do?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We can stay. And fight.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah! When the Indians come to tear up our town, we kick 'em in the nuts!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: (Yeah!)

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah! They don't own our town! We do!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: I'm sorry, boys. You just don't understand economics.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: It'll be okay, boys, we'll just... move to the next town over.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Oh sure. Until the Native Americans decide they want that land, too! What if the Native Americans just keep building their casinos and their highways uh, until we have nowhere else to go?? We have to stand up to them now! [the adults look back helplessly] Rrrgh! Forget it! Come on, you guys! [the boys leave. Cartman stays behind.]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: You're all a bunch of God-damned pussies! [follows his friends them out. The adults just watch]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: South Park, day. Moments later, a train of bulldozers roll down into town. Runs with Premise, riding on the lead bulldozer, looks happy until he sees the boys standing abreast on the street, blocking the way.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Get out of our way.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: No! We won't let you destroy our town!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Boys. It isn't your town anymore.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Just because you have a piece of paper saying you own it doesn't make it yours. We grew up here. Our parents grew up here. We shop at that Wal-Mart, and eat at that Chili's. We take fish from the streams and bread them and freeze them to make fish sticks. This is not just a town, it is our way of life.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Well your way of life is about to change, little boys. Now move! [points the way to the side of the street]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: You can't just roll into places and take people's lives away!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: And what are four little boys going to do to stop us, huh? [the boys stand unsure, but a sound rises up behind them. Townsfolk appear in mass and walk down the street.]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We are strong No one can tell us we're wrong [Stan looks behind him, smiles, then looks up to his left. People now appear on the roofs of the buildings as well as on the street.] Searching our hearts for so lohh-oo-ohh-oo-ong [Stan looks at the roofs on the other side of the street, smiling.] All of us knowing... [The boys grin] Love Is A Battlefield

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: This land is not for sale.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Dammit! I thought you said they were dealt with!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: They were!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Sorry, Charlies! You can just keep your filthy bastard Indian money!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Filthy bastard Native American money!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Uh oh, right, huh. Sorry about that.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: This isn't over! [he and the others get into their bulldozers and pull out of town]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We'll never give up! You bastards!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yeah! South Park is ours.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: But, what do we do now? I mean, we can't just stand here and block their way forever.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We can stand here as long as it takes. [no one moves. The scene stays for a few seconds, then...]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Three Feathers Casino, night. Chief Runs with Premise looks over the casino floor from his office.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: What is the state of our people?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Last night I spoke with the spirit of the bear, and Bear said that if we do not build our highway soon, our investors may soon sell off their shares of the new casino.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yes, and Eagle says the cumulative shared market loss on the revenue of the new casino drops fifteen percent every day.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Then we must force the South Park people off their petty land.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: But they are determined and proud. And the spirit of the wind has stated that if we use force, it could be a publicity nightmare, further hurting our net assets.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: I already have a plan how we can force them off their land... sneakily. [begins to move off] We're going to give them... [stops in front of a wall] blankets. [three of them are shown]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Blankets?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Yes. We will present the blankets as a peace offering. But what the round-eyes will not know is that the blankets are infected with SARS. [his fellow tribespeople look at each other] They will all get SARS! And then SARS will run through their town like a buffalo. Now I need your help getting the SARS onto the blankets. [everyone puts on their little white face masks] Okay, bring them in!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [The office doors open and several naked Chinese men are brought in] Let's see how South Park deals with this! [he picks up one of the men and rubs him on a blanket. The Chinese man looks at him bewildered] Everyone grab a Chinese person and rub them on a blanket. [other elders pick up the other Chinese them and carry them over to other blankets hanging on the wall] Make sure you rub them all over. Get the SARS nice and deep in there. [the Chinese men grumble at their treatment]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: South Park, next day. The deadline has arrived.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Tom, I'm standing in chilly South Park, Colorado, where the residents are entering the third day of their sit-in to try and stop Native Americans from building a superhighway through their town. The temperature is low, but spirits are pretty low, too. [a Three Casinos Humvee rolls into town and four elders, including Runs with Premise, exit the vehicle]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [looking on suspiciously, huddled with his family] What do they want?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: We're not moving, ass-faces!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [walks up to Mr. Garrison with a blanket] Free blanket? [presents it to him] Though I know we have differences, we believe that a compromise can be reached. In the meantime, it hurts us to see you all on television sitting in the cold. Will you not take this offering as a gesture of good-will?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: You had me at "free blanket." [Runs with Premise nods and Garrison takes the blanket and opens it. Runs with Premise moves on to other townsfolk and the other elders join in, passing out blankets to the townsfolk.]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Free blanket? Free blanket? Free blanket...

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Tom, it now looks as if the Native Americans are handing out blankets as a sign of good-will towards the South Park people. What an incredible display of compassion. I certainly hope there's nothing sinister behind it.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [walks up to Randy] Please. As a token of good faith.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: You... understand if I'm a little wary of trusting you.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: It is only a blanket, Mister Marsh.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Well, thanks. [takes the blanket and opens it up. The Chief walks away]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Oh. You're welcome.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: South Park, day, later. People are anywhere from asleep to sick.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [leaning to his left] Tom, it's Tuesday morning now, and the outbreak of SARS in South Park has reached epic proportions. [coughs twice and sniffs] The entire town has been quarantined by the federal government, nobody allowed in our out, which means, nobody can come to our aid. [sniffs twice] It appears this town, and this reporter, are done for. Coming up next, choosing the right hair conditioner. What you don't know about hair care products could be costing you a bundle.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Randy has taken ill and now lies under a lean-to. Sharon sits on one side of the lean-to, Shelly on the other. Stan walks up to his dad with a can of beer in his hand. Randy coughs.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: It's all right, dad.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: How's your... mother?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [looks over] She's hanging in there. [looks at Randy again] Here, drink some beer. [Randy turns his head aside a bit so he can take a sip, then resets his head]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: It's cool on my tongue.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: You're gonna be all right.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Stanley, listen to me. I have SARS. There's only a ninety-eight percent chance that I will live.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: No, Dad, NO.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Listen, Stan. SARS is destroying our people. The Native Americans put it in the blankets they gave us. [coughs and sniffs] Soon there will be only ninety-eight percent of us left. [runs out of air, then turns aside and breathes in. His voice turns raspy]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: What can I do?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: You... must find a cure for SARS, son. And save our people.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Cure SARS? Aw, Jesus!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: The spirit of middle-class white people is strong in you, son. Seek out the wise man in Bellow Creek. Now go. GO! [Stan steps away, then runs. Randy relaxes and lays down]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Bellocreek Trailer Park. Stan approaches it and enters. He walks up to a trailer and knocks on the door.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [answers the door] What?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Hey, my name's Stan, and I was-

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Your coming was foretold to me. You've come to save our people. Come in. [steps aside and Stan enters] Watch the cats.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Uh so, do you know how to cure SARS?

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Me?? Huh, no. I am just a guide. Sit down.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [Stan sits down on a bucket seat from a car. Beer bottles litter the trailer floor. The walls are dingy. An open doorway reveals the man's bedroom, which shows a cross hanging on the opposite wall. A poster of a swimsuit model posing on a car hangs on the living room wall. The man sits on the couch].

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: You must find the answer yourself, by taking an inward journey. [picks up a can of paint thinner and pours it into a brown paper bag]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: An inward journey? That sounds kinda gay.

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Let the voices of our ancestors show you the way. [offers the bag to Stan] Breathe. Breathe from the bag of visions. [Stan takes the bag, looks at it, then takes a deep breath from it]

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: [disgusted] Ah! Oh, dude!

Title: Red Man's Greed
Line: Three Feathers Casino, night. Chief Runs with Premise holds a meeting in his second-story office.

Line: You have to let us in! [a few hours later and all the seniors are sprawled out on the snow. One of them is still trying to crawl. A few more hours and all movement has stopped]

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: All right everyone, area secure. Collect their weapons and free the hostages. [walks up to the boys] That was a great strategy, boys. You may very well have saved this entire country. [Randy and Sharon arrive rubbing their eyes. Gerald and Sheila arrive also]

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: Whoa-ho-ho-ooh, what happened? Is it over?

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: Everything is fine. Control of the town is back to you folks.

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: [two soldiers escort his fatigued self away] Country Kitchen... wha-what happened?

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: [one of two escorting Marvin] Sir, what should we do with this one?

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: It's up to the townspeople.

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: Well, I think he learned his lesson. Huh? Don't you feel silly now, Dad? I think somebody owes us all an apology. Yes he does.

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: Oh, stop it, Dad! This is partly your fault!

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: Huh?

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: Look, all Grandpa wants is not to be talked to like a child. I think half of what he was angry about wasn't what you were doing, but how you were doing it.

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: That's right.

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: And Grandpa, you should be proud that you made it through life to be a senior, but you should also realize that, when you're behind the wheel, you're a killing machine.

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: I know. I guess sometimes us seniors need to know when to stop driving so we don't put the responsibility on our families.

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: Well, I think this has been a real learning experience for the Marsh family. People died, but we all grew a little. Let's just go home.

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: Sure. I'll drive.

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: [laughs and goes to wheel Marvin off] That's our Grandpa. [both men and Sharon laugh]

Title: Grey Dawn
Line: [to his friends] Dude, I hate my family. [looks down embarrassed and walks away]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Stan's house, day. Stan, Kenny, and Cartman watch TV from the couch. Cartman is eating a bowl of chips.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Dude, I wonder where Kyle is.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Maybe he caught a disease and died. That'd be so awesome.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Dude that's not funny. You shouldn't joke about that.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: (Yeah.)

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Who's joking? [a door opens and closes offscreen]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [enters excitedly, his arms up in the air] You guys! You guys! I have awesome news!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: You have AIDS?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: No. This Saturday, for my birthday, my Mom says she's takin' me to Casa Bonita, in Denver, and I get to invite three friends!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [stands up] Wow! Casa Bonita?!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [stands up] (Woo-hoo!)

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [stands up] What's Casa Bonita?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Dude, haven't you ever been there?! It's a big Mexican restaurant where they have, like, cliff jumpers and Black Bart's Cave and [holds out his hand wide] all kinds of stuff!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: It's like the Disneyland of Mexican restaurants.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: This Saturday! Awesome! [begins to sing to "La Cucaracha"] Casa Bonita! Casa Bonita! Food and fun in a festive atmosphere. [begins to snap his fingers] Casa Bonita!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Who said I'm inviting you? [this freezes Cartman for a few seconds]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: You... your Mom said you could take three friends.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Yes. Three friends. You're not my friend.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Wuh ih uh... Weh come on, Kyle, who the hell else are you gonna take besides Stan and Kenny?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I'm gonna take Butters. He invited me to his birthday party last month, so I owe him one.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Butters?! You're gonna take THAT butt hole?! Why?!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Because Butters isn't a total dick to me!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I have never been a dick to you.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [rolls his eyes] Oh please! All you ever do is call me names and rip on me for being Jewish!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Kyle, when have I ever ripped on you for being a Jew?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [thinks back and counts the number of times Cartman has ripped on him for being a Jew][in the playground. Craig is there instead of Kenny] Oh yeah?! Well you're a stupid Jew![in the playground, by the school's back doors] You're a Jew![in Cartman's room. Cartman is wearing a crown] Shut your God-damned Jew mouth![at Kyle's house, on the front steps] Good job, Jew![singing the Dreidel song with Kyle's family and Stan] Jew...[leaving his seat in class] Shut up, Jew![at Cartman's house, with outfits] You're Jewish!![seated on a curb with the other boys] Dude, he's Jewish![staking out a house] Jew![on Nightline, seated next to Stan] Jew![in Cartman's dining room] Jew![at the side of a road, with Tweek and with their parents] Jew![next to stacks of lumber, as Kyle is about to whack him] Jew![at a barn, through a hole on the roof] Jew![Stan's room. Kyle reads a Bible] Jew?![At the Costa Rican rainforest, during practice] "I told you Jewish people don't have rhythm." "Fuck off, Cartman!"

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [Cartman thinks back as well] Okay, except maybe for that one time.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: You've always been a dick to me, Cartman, and I'm not inviting you. [turns and walks away, but Cartman stays close]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Kyle, you don't understand! Casa Bonita is my most favorite place [Kyle turns around] in the whole world. I'll just, I'll just die if you don't take me! Please! [holds his hands together in a sign of pleading]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [crosses his arms and avoids Cartman's eyes] Sorry, my mind's made up.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [turns irate and flips him off] Well fuck you, Kyle!! I don't wanna go to your faggy birthday party anyway! I'd rather hang out at home than have to be around you and your Jew mom for a day! [shoves the middle finger close to Kyle's face] Kiss my balls, asshole!!! [turns and walks away. The front door opens, closes, and opens again. Cartman returns and apologizes] Dude, I totally didn't mean that, Kyle. I really really wanna go to Casa Bonita. I'm sorry we had that fight just now. You know, I mean, I said some things, you said some things, but, I think it was good and we-we've moved past it.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [clearly annoyed now] I'm not inviting you to Casa Bonita.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [turns irate and flips him off again] Well fuck you, Kyle!! I hope you die! I hope you fucking die!! [turns and walks away. The front door opens, then closes]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Cartman's house, night. Cartman sleeps...

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Casa Bonita! Come on, you guys! [waves them on. Next scene is him getting a large platter of food] Oh, awesome!! [next scene is him waving his friends to a cave] Come on, you guys! Black Bart's Cave! [next scene is him by a waterfall] Wow, cliff divers! [a cliff diver takes a dive from the top of the waterfall. Next scene is Cartman on his third dish] More sopapillas, please! [next scene has him dancing in front of a low stage, on which a mariachi quartet plays its songs. An image of Kyle floats through his dream]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I'm not inviting you, Cartman. You can't go.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [with more foods on his plates, the dream dissolves. He's pulled up and away] No! Noooo! [he's pulled out of Casa Bonita and floats away] Casa Bonita! Noooo! [startled out of his dream] AAAAH!! [catches his breath] Oh... God-damnit, I have to get invited to go! I'm just gonna have to start being nice to Kyle!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Kyle's house, next day. Cartman approaches the front door in a nice sweater and rings the bell. Kyle answers.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [looking quite presentable] Hi Kyle. [smiles]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [studies Cartman a bit, but isn't impressed] That isn't it, Cartman.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: What isn't it?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: That's not being nice! That's just putting on a nice sweater!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: ...I don't understand the difference.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I know you don't. [steps back and slams the door on Cartman's face]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: South Park Elementary, day. The kids head for class: Bill, Craig, Wendy, then Jimmy. Cartman enters and rounds the corner, sees Jimmy and runs up to him.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Jimmy! Hey Jimmy, wait up! [Annie and Red walk by at the far end of the hall. Jimmy stops] Dude, uh I need your help on something.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well, sure, Eric. W-w-what seems to be the p-p-p-problem?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well, everybody likes you, Jimmy, a-and you seem to be really good with people, so, I was wondering if you could tell me, how "do" you act nice to people?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well, the best thing is not to act nice, Eric. Uh, the best thing is to be genuinely nice.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Okay, so how do you act genuinely nice to people?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well, Eric, pah part of being nice is just making people smile and laugh. The best way to do that is by telling a fan-tastic joke or a humorous anti-d- ant'duhh ...anecdote.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Like what?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well, like, try this one on for size: Knock knock.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Who's there?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Ing-mar ...Bergman. [Cartman jumps, but not because of the joke. Kyle approaches them from the other end of the hall.] Now you say, "Ingmar Bergman who?" [Cartman quickly punches Jimmy in the face]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Take that, Jimmy! [strikes him again, and Jimmy falls away] And that! And don't you ever talk bad about Kyle again! [Kyle stops by and looks. Cartman glances at him] Kyle is my friend! And if you say you had sex with his mom one more time, I'm gonna really let you have it! You hear me?! [looks at Kyle] Oh, Kyle. Hey.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Do you really think that beating up a handicapped kid is being nice? [turns and walks on his way]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Uh... [turns and runs towards Kyle] He-hey Kyle! Knock knock. [follows him around the corner] Knock knock, Kyle!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: The school cafeteria. Cartman is looking at a picture. A tear wells up in his left eye. The picture's frame reads "I Had A Good Time at CASA BONITA," and the picture within is one of Cartman, his mom, and the mariachis in the background. He hears Kyle's excited voice.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Yeah, Casa Bonita, this Saturday! [approaches a table with Kenny, Stan, and Butters]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Wow, that's gonna be so fun!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Yeah, it'll be awesome. Just the four of us.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: (Yeah!) [Cartman sits at his own table, alone.]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: The school hall, the bell rings. Red and Annie walk one way, Kyle and Craig the opposite way. Keven opens up his locker. Kyle stops at his locker, and Cartman walks up.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Hey Kyle.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well what?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: How are you going to try to get invited to Casa Bonita this time?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I'm not, Kyle. I know you already told Butters he could go.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Oh. Well... yeah. I, I did.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: So, fine, Kyle, but honestly, I never meant to make you feel like you didn't matter at all to me. I know we argue all the time and I give you tons of crap, but we've also been through a, a lot together, and... maybe that alone doesn't make us friends, but it makes us something. So, ...whatever, you know, just... ah I hope... things will be cool.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I'm still not inviting you to Casa Bonita.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I know, Kyle. I'll see ya later. [turns and walks away]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Eh... hey, Cartman? [Cartman turns around] You really don't care that you can't go?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I care, sure, but I hope it doesn't mean you and me and Stan and Kenny can't hang out anymore.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: That's exactly what I wanted to hear from you all along. Ah uh I still have to take Butters, but... I hope things can be cool too.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Good.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: And, and hey, if for some reason Butters can't go to Casa Bonita, you can take his place.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Sweet, whatever. [walks on, then mouths to himself] Bingo!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Cartman's house, Friday night. Cartman leads Butters into his bedroom.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: What's this all about, Eric?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [leads him to a telescope, then turns] Butters, can you keep a secret?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well, sure I can!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: For the past five days I've been looking out into space for a school project. This morning, at 3:45 a.m. I... caught first sight of something terrible.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Nnn-how terrible?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: A meteor. A meteor the size of Wyoming, heading right for earth.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: What?? [begins rubbing his hands together nervously]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Now look, ah I could be wrong. I ...pray that I'm wrong, but, I just want you to take a look and... see what you think. [backs up and looks through the eyepiece] Do you see anything?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I just see stars. [Cartman hops onto a chair and fishes in his left jacket pocket. He pulls out a wad of junk hanging from a string]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Keep looking. Sometimes it takes your eyes a minute to adjust.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Nope, uh I don't see any... [Cartman holds up the wad against the objective lens] Oh wait. Oh my God! I see it. I see it! It's a meteor! Oh my God!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Oh my God! Does it look like it's getting closer? [Butters looks through again and Cartman holds up the wad, moving it closer to the objective lens.]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: It is! It is getting closer! Oh my God!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Oh my God! That meteor is the size of Wyoming and it's on a collision course for Earth.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: When do you think uh it'll get here?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I, I don't know, I, have to do some calculations. [heads for his desk and pulls out a calculator] 10 to the power of 1 base 9 divided by pi plus 5 minus 3. Oh Jesus.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: What??

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: According to my calculations, that meteor is going to hit Earth in less than four hours.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Oh, you mean we're gonna die?!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: No! No, Butters, we are going to live! Do you hear me?! We are going to live! We just... We've gotta find a bomb shelter!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Wha...? Where is there a bomb shelter??

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Stan's Uncle Jimbo! He has a bomb shelter in his backyard! Come on, Butters! Hurry! [heads out the door]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: AAAAHH! [follows him out]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Jimbo's house. Cartman and Butters head for the bomb shelter.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Oh Jeez!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Here we go! The bomb shelter's down here! [opens the shelter's lid]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [enters and climbs down the ladder within] Oh God! Oh Jesus! [Cartman watches him, then follows him down the ladder]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [reaches the shelter floor] All right, we should be safe in here. This dried food and water should last us for weeks.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: But what about everyone else? I have to tell my parents so they can come here, too.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: No! Butters! I can't let you risk it. I'll go up and get the others.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Are you sure?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [looks away] I'm not sure of anything anymore. [turns and climbs up the ladder. He makes it out and looks down] Now Butters, listen: No matter what happens, no matter what you hear, do not come out! If I don't make it back in time with the others, then it will be up to you to repopulate the Earth.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: But I'm the only one down here. What am I supposed to repopulate with?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well, you know, with your wiener. [Butters just stares back] Just stay down here until you hear word from me. And... pray, Butters... pray for all mankind. [leaves and closes the lid, then locks it]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [in darkness] Oh God, oh God!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Kyle's house, Saturday night. Stan and Kenny are dressed in stripes, Sheila waits in a fur coat, Kyle is in his Sunday best checking his watch.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Where is Butters? We were supposed to leave here forty minutes ago.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well I think we better just go without him, Kyle. It's getting late.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Yeah, screw him. Let's go. [the door bell rings and Kyle looks at the door] Oh, finally! [walks to get the door, but sees Cartman instead]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [bearing a gift] Happy Birthday, Kyle. I just wanted to stop by and give you your present.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Oh. Thanks, dude.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Hope you have a good one. See you later. [turns around and walks toward the street]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Oh wait. Cartman.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Yes?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Uh Butters didn't show. You wanna go to Casa Bonita with us?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [enters the house] Butters didn't show? I I can't believe it. Uh are you sure you told him the right time and everything?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I told him 5:30 and we gotta get going. You in?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Well I... really would need to go home first and get my... Weh no no, I guess I have everything I need. Oh, okay, sure.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: All right, let's go.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [heads for the front door] Okay, boys. Get in the car.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [gets excited] Casa Bonita, here we come! Casa Bonita! Casa Bonita!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [finds Butters' parents approaching] Oh, hello Chris, Linda.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [misty-eyed. Linda sobs silently] Hello everyone. Have any of you seen our son?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Butters was supposed to go with us to Casa Bonita tonight.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: We know, but... he hasn't been home since last night. The police have been looking everywhere, but... [Linda cries audibly] Well, thank you. Uh, please, let us know if you find out anything. [they leave. Linda is sobbing hard]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Oh Butters!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Aw dude, weak.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [lowers his head and walks towards the front door] Yeah. Man, that sucks about Butters. [brightens up] Well, let's get going, shall we?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Nah. Dude, I c-I can't go to have a birthday party while Butters is missing.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Yeah, it's kinda weird.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [a little stunned] Ee-yeah yeah. I think you're right, but, on the other hand, I think Butters would want us to go. You know Butters...

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Nah, I can't. We should help look for him.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Yeah.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: That's very good of you, boys. We can postpone Casa Bonita until next Saturday.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Next Saturday?? I'll never be able to keep Butters in the... [catches himself and waits for a reaction. None comes] In the... depths of my heart for that long. I sure hope he... turns up before then.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Dude, we should check over at Stark's Pond. Butters always hangs out over there. [exits]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Yeah. And then we can try the football field. [exits]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I'll drive you boys. [exits]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [left alone] Oh, God-damnit! How am I gonna keep Butters down in that bomb shelter for a whole week?!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: South Park, Sunday. In front of the police station, Officer Barbrady stands by while one of his men issues the report to the crowd standing before the dais.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: All right, folks, this is the little boy we're looking for: [holds up a picture of Butters] Leopold Stotch, also known as Butters. He's been missing for two days and was last seen at the school. Let's go find him.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: The bomb shelter. Butters has found the light switch and is enjoying the rations stored on the shelves along the wall.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [reading some directions] "Dried food rations. Add water to feed flavored square..." [the lid opens up above him] Hello? [rises and looks up] Hello??

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [suddenly looks in, looking terribly roughed up] Butters!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [jumps back, startled] Hwaaaah!!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Butters! Oh God, it was... It was horrible!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Wuh, wait, well, what happened??

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [faking fatigue] The meteor... struck the Earth sooner than I predicted. There was no time... no time...

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: What about my parents. Did you see them?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: There was mass confusion! Pa... panic! People were crawling all over each other in the streets! It was... awful! When it hit, millions were evaporated instantly. The rest of us... walking around in a... cloud of... toxic... radiation. [coughs]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [heads for the ladder and begins to climb] Oh my God, let me see!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: No Butters!! If you come up, you'll get infected too! You best wait for the radiation level to go down. Probably... next week sometime. After Saturday. Ugh...

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [off the ladder] How many survivors are there? You should all come down here.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: We can't come down there, or else, we'll contaminate you, Butters. No... we just have to survive the best we can. [strains a bit, like he's gonna cough]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Wow... Eric, I can never thank you enough for everything you've done for me.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Thank me by living, Butters. Live. And... rebuild. [coughs] I've got to go. Remember, wait one week for the toxic levels to go down. On Saturday. [moves off] G-goodbye! [locks the lid down once again] All right. Just six days, Butters. Sit tight.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Police station, night. News 4 is covering another announcement by the police.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Tom, it has now been three days since the Stotch child has gone missing. Townspeople continue to search, but hope... is dwindling.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: All right, folks. I wanna thank you for all your efforts. Three days is a long time, but we've got to keep going if we're gonna find him.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [not spoken, he's thinking this while Yates speaks.] Heh you're not going to find him. Not until after Saturday when I go to Casa Bonita. [closes his eyes and begins anticipating. Three images come up. The first is of his waitress bringing him food, the second is of him dancing before a mariachi band, the third is of the cliff divers. He begins to dance while he daydream]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Many times in cases like these a child can trap themselves. It is important that we spread our search to duct pipes, wells, and bomb shelters. [Cartman's dance is rudely interrupted by this]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: What what what?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: I say we need to move the search to ducts, wells, and bomb shelters. Let's move out, people! Every second counts! [the crowd breaks up and begins the search]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: UUuuugh!! [runs off]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: But if you leave me now, you'll take away the biggest part of me.Oo-oo-ooooo-oo girl, baby please don't go. Eh,Oo-oo-ooooo-oo girl. [the shelter lid opens again] Eric? [rises and looks up the shaft] Eric, is that you?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: [scrambling down the ladder] Oh God! They're coming! They're coming! We gotta get out of here! They're coming this way!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Who's coming this way?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: The cannibals! Don't you know? The meteor destroyed all of society, Butters. Now Earth is ruled by packs of wild humans gone mad! Those of us who survived are now being hunted by flesh-starved cannibals!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Oh God! I hate cannibals!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: They're coming this way! I can hear them coming. They'll find you down here for sure. And when they do, they'll eat you alive.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Noooo!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: We've gotta get you out of here! Come on! Oh oh no wait, I forgot! The toxic radiation! Hey wait! We can use this box! [picks it up and promptly drops it over Butters so Butters can't see a thing.] There we go. This should keep you protected from the toxins.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: But I can't see nothin'.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Believe me, Butters, you don't wanna see what's up there. Now come on. I'll guide you to a safer location. [guides him to the ladder and nudges him up] There you go. Two more steps and you're at the top. [Butters climbs out] Good.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Are we out in the destruction?

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Yes. There's nothing but smoldering bodies all around you. Burnt out buildings, and what used to be our town.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Aw man.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: All right, this way, Butters. Just follow the sound of my voice. [walks off. Butters follows]

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: An open field, night. Butters and Cartman are walking through the field behind a row of houses, far enough away so that no sound can reach them.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Right now we're walking by what used to be people's houses, now just smoldering burnt piles of rubble.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Huh... Oh, it's terrible.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: We're coming now to the crater where the meteor hit. A hole in the Earth over two miles in diameter.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Whoa!

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: The old gas station.

Title: Casa Bonita
Line: Here we are at the old gas station. It survived a lot of the impact. We might be safe here. [steps to the other side and begins making noises, then steps back] Oh my God!

Title: Casa Bonita

M'kay, and uh, eh, what? [sniffs] What the? [turns around] Holy shit! M'kay?! [the fire alarm goes off and the school empties out the front door. Mr. Garrison, Mr. Adler, Ms. Choise, and Mr. Slave are all seen]

Title: Butt Out
Line: Oh! Jesus Christ! [time-lapse a few hours. The school has been gutted by the flames and firefighters clean up. Police are present for crowd control. Mr. Mackey is none too pleased]

Title: Butt Out
Line: ...Whoops.

Title: Butt Out
Line: The Principal's office, Only the door and the desk remain. The bookshelves are burnt up except for the bottom shelf. The cabinets are charred. The desk is charred and two of its legs are burnt off.

Title: Butt Out
Line: [seated behind her desk] Well, you boys have certainly done it this time!

Title: Butt Out
Line: We're sorry.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Not as sorry as you're going to be when your parents get here! Ah, here they come now. [sure enough, their parents can be seen approaching through the ruins]

Title: Butt Out
Line: Oh God... [looks down. One of the parents knocks.]

Title: Butt Out
Line: Come on in. [Randy opens the door and the parents enter]

Title: Butt Out
Line: Stanley, what did you do this time?!

Title: Butt Out
Line: You'd better brace yourself, parents. The boys were caught... smoking!

Title: Butt Out
Line: Smoking?

Title: Butt Out
Line: No, it can't be! My son is not a filthy smoker! [begins to sob. Randy holds her]

Line: Mom... [Randy holds her tight] Dad, it was just a-

Line: I don't have a son!

Line: Eric, you've done a lot of horrible things in your life, but smoking? You're grounded for three weeks!

Line: Three weeks?! Are you fucking kidding me?

Line: Haven't you boys heard anything about how harmful smoking is to you and those around you?

Line: Of course they haven't, because the tobacco companies have gotten to them first. This is really their fault.

Title: Butt Out
Line: [seizing the opportunity] Yeah. This is really their fault.

Title: Butt Out
Line: No matter how much money the anti-smoking groups spend, the tobacco companies are there to fill our children's heads with lies and propaganda that make them wanna smoke.

Title: Butt Out
Line: [agreeing] Yeah, huh? [launches into a small demonstration] It-it's like the tobacco companies have control of my mind- No. Must. Fight it. Tobacco companies... making me want to smoke. Ah!

Title: Butt Out
Line: Oh my goodness, I had no idea. [kneels next to him] Are you okay, sweetie?

Title: Butt Out
Line: Well, those God-damned tobacco companies aren't gonna have control over MY kid! I say we bring them down!

Title: Butt Out
Line: We need the help of the greatest anti-smoking celebrity that ever lived. Rob Reiner.

Title: Butt Out
Line: [to Stan] Who's Rob Reiner?

Title: Butt Out
Line: Rob Reiner's Smoke Stoppers, day. A blue skyscraper flanked by two taller blue towers, with the Hollywood sign in the background. Inside, Rob Reiner speaks to four executives, but he's facing the window. He's reading from some papers.

Title: Butt Out
Line: [breathless, dabs his forehead] I don't understand it. I pushed a law for higher taxes on cigarettes, I lobbied to get images of cigarettes removed from movies and art, I forced smokers out of bars and parks, but still I get letters from parents saying their kids are doin' it. [puts the papers on the desk, unwraps a triple cheeseburger, starts eating it, and sits down at his desk] Apparently, people still don't understand how bad smoking people is for them. Don't they know how dangerous it is to their health? [dabs his forehead] Don't they know the hazard of second-hand smoke?

Title: Butt Out
Line: According to the letter, sir, the town has a tobacco company quite near them.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Yeah, that must be it. [dabs his forehead] The tobacco companies, with their millions of dollars and their slick desks and fancy buildings, [the camera pulls out to show the slick desk and fancy building Reiner is in. Reiner dabs his forehead again] they're the ones making music wanna smoke! [dabs his forehead again, opens another triple cheeseburger and begins munching on that] They're the ones hurting our nation's health! I will not stand by and see the children of America corrupted by those bastards! [dabs his forehead] This is war!!

Title: Butt Out
Line: South Park City Hall, day. People have gathered to greet Reiner when he arrives, and some people have signs saying the same thing as the banner. Other signs say "THANKS ROB!!", "Welcome MEATHEAD!" and "Give 'em hell REINER!" Stan and friends wait by the front door.

Title: Butt Out
Line: You guys, maybe we should come clean right now and tell everyone that it wasn't the tobacco companies that made us want to smoke.

Title: Butt Out
Line: What??

Line: Why? It's perfect. If everyone's blaming the tobacco companies, then nobody's blaming us.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Yeah, what's the problem?

Title: Butt Out
Line: Well it's just that, eh, this seems like another one of those times when things are gonna get way out of hands, you know? It's been happening a lot lately. How about this time we just put a stop to it right now?

Title: Butt Out
Line: Dumbass, you don't wanna be grounded for three weeks, do you?

Title: Butt Out
Line: Yeah, don't worry dude. Things aren't gonna get out of hand.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Here he comes! [Two Smoke Stoppers vans and a big rig pull up to City Hall. Rob Reiner follows in a Cadillac, which stops at the walkway leading up to the front door. Reiner opens the door and tries to get out, but he's too big to fit through.]

Title: Butt Out
Line: [after a few grunts] Damnit. [struggles some more, but fails to move any] Butter! [the driver glances back] Butter! [the driver exits the car and walks around the front]

Title: Butt Out
Line: What'd he say?

Title: Butt Out
Line: Butter!! [the driver arrives with a bucket of butter. Rob Reiner grabs a bunch of it and butters himself up. The driver leaves with the butter as Reiner rubs the last of it against the seat of his pants. Reiner struggles once more and pops out of the car, falling to the ground. He stumbles, then rises and stumbles again. This time he stands up and raises his hands in victory. This raises his sweater, and his belly is exposed. He notices this and lowers his sweater. He raises his hands again and his sweater rises. He lowers his hands and walks up to the dais. The mic transmits his breathlessness as he dabs his forehead. His cheeks are rosy from the heat leaving his head] Hello South Park!! [the crowd cheers, the boys look at each other] It is so nice to see an entire town come together to fight for good health! And I'm gonna help ya! [the crowd cheers] These poor innocent children have been seduced into smoking tobacco. So I say, "We fight fire with fire!" We're gonna use these children to bring the tobacco companies down! [someone shoots some confetti in the air and it rains down over everybody.]

Title: Butt Out
Line: Oh no...

Title: Butt Out
Line: The town bar. Reiner sits at a booth with the boys, feverishly eating. A waitress comes up with a platter of cheeseburgers and fries.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Alright kids, here's what we're gonna do. [the waitress replaces a cleared platter with the newly loaded one] We're gonna sneak you into the tobacco company by saying you kids want a tour for a school paper. [begins eating the burgers and dabs his head] Once you're inside, mm, mm, I'm gonna take photos and then we'll publish them, saying that the tobacco company invited you over to seduce you into smoking. Got it?

Title: Butt Out
Line: Got it! [Stan and Kyle look at each other]

Title: Butt Out
Line: But... isn't that, kind of, lying?

Title: Butt Out
Line: Uh, we're just leveling out the playing field. [dabs his forehead] The tobacco companies lie to you about the dangers of smoking. If we're gonna take them down, we've gotta lie right back! [begins to sniff around after detecting cigarette smoke, then focuses in on the source. The boys look as well. The source is a man wearing a Buds Light Beer hat, enjoying a drink and a smoke at the bar] Oh my God! [coughs loudly, but fails to get the man's attention. Line: Excuse me?

Line: [moves on] And so for centuries, tobacco production flourished. Line: That sounds perfectly reasonable.

Title: Butt Out
Line: So with a hidey lidey lidey and a hidey lidey lay We work and we make cigarettes all hidey lidey day So folks can get a breaky from their stressful lidey lives And relaxy with the cigarettes we make all day and night

Title: Butt Out
Line: What??

Title: Butt Out
Line: [looks down at the mayhem] Oh my God!

Title: Butt Out
Line: Hoh boy, that was great, kids.

Line: Those people at the tobacco company all seem really nice.

Title: Butt Out
Line: [walks across the room towards a table laden with burgers] This is how we get rid of smokers. [approaches and grabs a burger] We go state to state and do things like, use bogus studies and make extensive commercials to get the public on our side and force cigarette smokers to stop!

Title: Butt Out
Line: Wow. It's like, it's like, smoking brings a lot of people just a little bit of joy and, and you get to take that away from them. [cuddles up to Reiner] You are so awesome.

Title: Butt Out
Line: [walks up to an employee and hands him the camera. The worker hooks it up to his computer] Here you go Bob. [Explains to the boys] This is Mr. Baffrey. He does all our Photoshop work. [the screen is shown with a picture loading behind a download progress bar] Now, all we have to do is Photoshop cigarettes into your hands! [Baffrey places cigarettes into the boys' hands] And bingo! When this hits the papers the tobacco company is screwed! Hahahaha! [Baffrey joins in the laughter]

Title: Butt Out
Line: But dude, you're making stuff up.

Title: Butt Out
Line: [munching on another burger] You kids need to understand something, okay? Sometimes lying is okay. Like, when you know what's good for people more than they do.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Oh my God, that is what I've always said. [motions to Reiner] I love this guy!

Title: Butt Out
Line: [walks in with a news feed] Mr. Reiner, your bill to have smoking outlawed at bars here didn't pass.

Title: Butt Out
Line: What?! [grabs the news feed the worker was holding] God-damnit, what the hell is wrong with people in this state?!

Title: Butt Out
Line: Apparently, several people here still believe there's no proof second-hand smoke can kill you.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Well they want proof?! All right, we'll give them proof! Boys, I need one of you to act in a commercial for us! We'll shoot it tomorrow!

Title: Butt Out
Line: [eagerly] Wow, a commercial?

Title: Butt Out
Line: And you boys decide which one of you will be best for the part. All right people, we've gotta get moving on the bill to ban smoking in Potsdam! Let's go!

Title: Butt Out
Line: God, he's just the best! [rushes off to follow Reiner] Mr. Reiner, can I get you a muffin? O-or a cold drink, perhaps?

Title: Butt Out
Line: Outside the tent. Stan, Kyle, and Kenny rush out of there and stop some distance away from it.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Guys, I think we should bail out of this right now!

Title: Butt Out
Line: Huh?

Title: Butt Out
Line: This is just startin' to look like another one of those times where it-it's gonna end up with the whole town turning out, it's a big showdown happening, and us havin' to talk about what we learned, and I say we just stop right now, and go play cards or something.

Title: Butt Out
Line: (Well yep, that's what I think.)

Line: Yeah, maybe you're right. [Cartman walks out and catches up to the others]

Line: So, heh gentlemen, looks like only one of us gets to be in the commercial, huh? Who will it be...? Gentlemen, the game is on!

Line: Go ahead. We don't wanna be in their stupid commercial.

Title: Butt Out
Line: [confused] Huh? Oh, I get it, Kyle. That's your Serbian Jew double bluff. Make me think you don't care about being in the commercial so that maybe I won't either. Ooops. didn't work, did it, Kyle?

Title: Butt Out
Line: No, we really want nothing more to do with these people.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Sure you don't, Kyle. Oh, and neither do I. Oh, I know what you're gonna say next. You're gonna say, "How about none of us show up tomorrow to do it?" That's Serbian Jew double bluff and it ain't [poke] gonna [poke] work [poke] on [poke] me [poke] ha [poke] ha [poke] ha [poke]. Only one of us can be in the commercial, gentlemen. The game... is on. [leaves]

Title: Butt Out
Line: Kyle's house, night. Cartman climbs up to the second story and opens a window at the end of the hallway. He carries with him a bunch of lumber, a hammer, and some nails. He approaches Kyle's door and gets to work hammering the lumber in place over the door.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Sorry Kyle, but I'm afraid only one of us will be showing up to do the commercial tomorrow! Hahahaha! Thought you had me with your Serbian Jew double bluff, didn't you?! Line: What are you doing? [Cartman snaps his head around and looks]

Line: [drops his hammer in this awkward moment] Oh... Hello, Kyle. Oh man. Wait, this isn't my house.

Line: Cartman, you go ahead and do the commercial tomorrow. Line: Hahahahahaha! [resumes hammering] Nice try, Kyle! Let's see you try to get through the door now! Haa haa hahahahaha!

Title: Butt Out
Line: [giddily] Heh, okay. [the make-up crew leave]

Title: Butt Out
Line: Let's see how the tobacco companies deal with this. [settles into his director's chair] All right, roll camera. Roll the TelePrompTer. And whenever you're ready, Eric.

Title: Butt Out
Line: Heh, okay, okay. [takes a deep breath, then strikes a somber pose] You know, some people say there's no proof that second-hand smoke kills. Line: And cut! Great! We got it! Wrap it up, people. That was fantastic.

Line: Uh what... what does that mean, "I'll be dead"? Hey, uh what, what was that "dead" part?

Line: Uh, nnno, thanks. I'm not hungry.

Line: [pushes the cupcake away] I'm not eating the cupcake.
