Line: No we didn't, dude! No we didn't! [walks off]

Title: Raisins
Line: South Park Elementary playground, recess or lunch. The camera pans across the playground and settles on two teams of seven players each. A football lies on the ground between the two groups. The group left of the football consists of Stan, Kyle, Cartman, Kenny, Butters, Token, and Clyde. The second includes Craig, Tweek, Kevin, Pip, and three others

Title: Raisins
Line: All right, you guys, it's first down. I'll hike the ball on the third "set hut!" Kyle and Cartman, go deep post out. Kenny, run a slant down the middle. Butters, be ready for the screen.

Title: Raisins
Line: Right. What are we playing again?

Title: Raisins
Line: Football.

Title: Raisins
Line: Got it. [the teams get into position]

Title: Raisins
Line: Okay. 23! [Bebe appears behind him and taps him on the shoulder] Blue, 23! Set hut! Set hut! [Bebe taps him on the shoulder again. Stan turns and looks at her]

Title: Raisins
Line: Wendy breaks up.

Title: Raisins
Line: What? [looks let down]

Title: Raisins
Line: Wendy breaks up with you. [turns to walk away. Stan looks on for a few seconds]

Title: Raisins
Line: [moves forth to hold her up] Oh whoa, wait a minute. [Bebe turns around] What did I do wrong? I haven't even talked to Wendy for weeks. [This gets the other boys' attention]

Title: Raisins
Line: She just doesn't wanna be with you anymore. She said she still wants to be friends. [the other boys turn to see what's going on]

Title: Raisins
Line: What-ever, Bebe! Like Stan really cares! Just get out of our football game, you stupid skank!

Title: Raisins
Line: Fuck you, fatass! You guys are assholes!

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh yeah? Well, at least we have assholes, you dumb girl!

Title: Raisins
Line: Yeh-heah, right!

Title: Raisins
Line: God, you're so stupid! [turns around and walks away]

Title: Raisins
Line: What a whore! [turns around and goes back to the game. The other boys do the same. Stan is too stunned to move]

Title: Raisins
Line: Yeah! Like Stan gives a crap if Wendy breaks up! [The boys get back into their playing positions. A few moments Kyle looks back] Stan? [Clyde looks back, then Cartman]

Title: Raisins
Line: [turns around] Come on, Stan, it's first down still. [Butters looks back, then Kenny. Stan loses heart and walks off slowly, his head hanging low. The other boys look at each other, unsure what to make of that. A montage begins.]

Title: Raisins
Line: Stan is next seen walking onto a small red stone bridge. The next scene has him walking down the middle of a two-lane road in the rain. He stops to take in the moist air. The next scene has him back on the bridge, looking over the creek with his head on his right hand. On the water he sees a reflection of Wendy walk up to him. She's smiling. He brightens as she approaches. He turns to greet her, but there's no one to greet. He looks back at the creek, then turns around and walks off. The next scene has him at a rainy night sitting on the curb in a run-down part of town, under a working street light, with his face buried in his legs, crying. The last scene has him in his room, sitting on the floor by his bed, looking at a picture of Wendy. He gently strokes the picture, which has Wendy holding a daisy and smiling broadly. On the picture are written the words "I love you forever. Wendy." The image fades to black

Title: Raisins
Line: South Park Elementary, day. In the hallway Craig goes to a drinking fountain for a drink of water. Fosse and Dog Poo walk towards the camera. Stan is at the far end watching Wendy open her locker. Stan looks away and walks towards Kyle, who's seated next to his locker reading a book.

Title: Raisins
Line: Kyle, will you talk to Wendy for me?

Title: Raisins
Line: [not looking up] Why?

Title: Raisins
Line: 'Cause I need to know why she broke up.

Title: Raisins
Line: Aw, dude, come on. I gotta do my science homework.

Title: Raisins
Line: [pleading] Dude, please. I might still have a chance to make things work. Please, just go talk to her?

Title: Raisins
Line: [puts his book down and sighs] God damn it! [walks over to Wendy, but avoids eye contact] Wendy, Stan wants to know why you break up. [Wendy turns around]

Title: Raisins
Line: Look, Stan is really nice. I just don't wanna be boyfriend and girlfriend anymore. I've been wanting to break up for a while. but it's, it's nothing against him.

Title: Raisins
Line: 'Kay. [walks back to Stan, but avoids looking at him, as well] She says she's been wantin' to break up for a while, and it's nothing against you.

Title: Raisins
Line: What? That's no answer! [nudges him a bit] Go tell her to be more direct with me.

Title: Raisins
Line: [goes for his books and picks them up] No dude, I'm out. Go talk to her yourself. Be poetic. [walks off. Jimmy appears]

Title: Raisins
Line: Kyle, this is my life. [points at Jimmy] Jimmy!

Title: Raisins
Line: Hey Stan.

Title: Raisins
Line: Jimmy, will you go talk to Wendy for me?

Title: Raisins
Line: For- Forw- Forw-w-w what?

Title: Raisins
Line: Just go talk to her an, and be poetic. Tell her she's my Muse-no! Tell her, [thinks] tell her... [gestures] she's a con-tinuing source of inspiration to me.

Title: Raisins
Line: She's what?

Title: Raisins
Line: She's a continuing source of inspiration to me.

Title: Raisins
Line: ...Okay. [walks over to Wendy] Hey uh-Wen, hey wu-Wendy. [she turns around with her books]

Title: Raisins
Line: Yeah?

Title: Raisins
Line: Stan says you're a cont...[pronouncing as "cunt"] you're a- cont- S-Stan says you're a cont- cont-

Title: Raisins
Line: Well tell Stan to fuck off!! [closes her locker and runs away]

Title: Raisins
Line: -cont- You're a cont-tinuing source of inspiration to him. [his mission done, he returns to Stan]

Title: Raisins
Line: Well?

Title: Raisins
Line: She just- w-walked away, Stan. You're gonna have to face facts. It's over. [hangs his head for emphasis, then walks off]

Title: Raisins
Line: [softly] Over? [walks away dejected. He's next seen in bed, a blanket hung across his window blocking out the outside light. He has his sheets drawn up tight against his chin. A few moments later, Kyle enters with Butters, Cartman, Jimmy and Kenny. Kyle studies his friend.] Jesus...

Title: Raisins
Line: We came over to cheer you up, Stan!

Title: Raisins
Line: [softly, creaking] ...Go away.

Title: Raisins
Line: Stan, you can't keep doing this to yourself. You have to go live.

Title: Raisins
Line: Why? What's the point of living when the only girl I ever loved is gone?

Title: Raisins
Line: God, what a fag!

Title: Raisins
Line: Dude, not now! [Cartman looks down, embarrassed]

Title: Raisins
Line: You guys have no idea how this feels. It's like, you always hear songs about a broken heart and you think it's just a figure of speech? But it's true. My chest hurts. I feel this like, sinking feeling where my heart is. It's broken...

Title: Raisins
Line: Jeez, he's worse than I thought.

Title: Raisins
Line: Well what do we do now?

Title: Raisins
Line: Should I try telling him a fa-fantastic joke?

Title: Raisins
Line: No. We just have to show him that there's other girls out there. I say we take him to Raisins.

Title: Raisins
Line: What's Raisins?

Title: Raisins
Line: Next day, Raisins, a Hooters-like restaurant with al-fresco dining. The boys enter the restaurant, and a pretty little girl in a Raisins outfit walks up. Other girls walk around, all seem to work there

Title: Raisins
Line: Hey guys, welcome to Raisins. Six of you? [smiles and grabs some menus from the counter] Right over here. [leads the boys to their table]

Title: Raisins
Line: [waits at a table] So you guys having a good time today?

Title: Raisins
Line: [Table 1, say, enthralled] Uh huh...

Title: Raisins
Line: [waits at the next table] How about some more fun fries, guys?

Title: Raisins
Line: [Table 2, enthralled] Okay... [the waitress at the other end of the table smiles]

Title: Raisins
Line: [at the same table] Boy, am I glad you guys came in. Everyone here is such a loser, but you guys seem really cool.

Title: Raisins
Line: [leaving them at their table] Here you go, guys. Lexus will be right with you.

Title: Raisins
Line: What do you think, Stan. These girls are pretty cute, huh?

Title: Raisins
Line: Jesus Christ, I think I've died and... gone to... heaven.

Title: Raisins
Line: This place is awesome!

Title: Raisins
Line: How do you know? We haven't even tried the food yet.

Title: Raisins
Line: [with flyaway light brown hair] Hey guys.

Title: Raisins
Line: Whoa!

Title: Raisins
Line: How are we doing this afternoon?

Title: Raisins
Line: Good.

Title: Raisins
Line: I'm so glad you guys came in. Everyone here is such a loser, but you guys seem really cool.

Title: Raisins
Line: [amazed] W-we are.

Title: Raisins
Line: So what can I get you?

Title: Raisins
Line: Okay, um, we're gonna get the zingy tangy wings, and mozzarella tasty tarts [Lexus winks at Butters] and uh, OH, and the bite-size pizzazzas, and a pitcher of lemonade.

Title: Raisins
Line: Great. I'll put your order in right now. [strokes Butters' shoulders, which sends shivers of excitement through his body]

Title: Raisins
Line: You guys! I think our Raisins girl likes me. She, she touched my back when she walked away. Did you see that?

Title: Raisins
Line: [near the kitchen] Raisins, girls! [sends an order along a conveyor to the kitchen staff]

Title: Raisins
Line: Woohoo!

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh Yeah!

Title: Raisins
Line: [farther away] Do it!

Title: Raisins
Line: Hey. Hey, look over there, Stan. That Raisins girl is really cute, huh? [a Raisins girl walks by with long black hair] Why don't you say hi to her? [calls out] Excuse me? [motions for her to come over]

Title: Raisins
Line: [walks back and to the table] Hi guys. My name's Porsche.

Title: Raisins
Line: Hey. Uh, this is Stan.

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh hey cutie. How are you? I love your hat. I used to have a hat juuust like that, except, it was black and it didn't have a puffball on it. Oh my God, my hands are sooo cold. How come people have hands, anyway? Did you ever wonder that? [Stan looks more and more miserable with every word coming out of her mouth.]

Title: Raisins
Line: Some time later, still dining. The Village People's "YMCA" begins to play, and some Raisins girls begin to dance

Title: Raisins
Line: YMCA... [they make the hand signs for the letters. The rest of the diners look over at them and cheer them on] YMCA-A.

Title: Raisins
Line: [really stuffed, with a soiled face] Omigod! You guys... this is the greatest place in the world... [their meals have been served]

Title: Raisins
Line: [still regaling Stan, who hasn't touched his food] Have you ever noticed how much sand there is at the beach? I mean, haven't you ever wondered where all this sand came from? Omigod, this one time, I saw a beetle that was thiiis big. Eeewww!

Title: Raisins
Line: Can we go, please?

Title: Raisins
Line: Okay. Okay, come on you guys. [they all hop off their seats and walk off]

Title: Raisins
Line: Oooh my God, thank you guys sooo much for coming to Raisins! [Butters is last to leave]

Title: Raisins
Line: [sees him and stalls him] Oooh, sweetie, are you leaving?

Title: Raisins
Line: Well, I don't want to, Lexus, but my stupid friends wanna go.

Title: Raisins
Line: Awww, well, when am I gonna get to see you again??

Title: Raisins
Line: When do you wanna see me?

Title: Raisins
Line: [holds on to him] As soon as possible!

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh my God! Here, we left you a tip already, but here is another five dollars. [hands her the bill]

Title: Raisins
Line: Oooh, you are such a sweetie. Come here, youuu! [comes around and gives him a full embrace and hugs him]

Title: Raisins
Line: [hugs her back] Waa... ahaaah... [the other boys arrive at the entrance]

Title: Raisins
Line: Bye, guys! Thanks for coming to Raisins!

Title: Raisins
Line: Well, Stan. Do you feel, uhb- better now?

Title: Raisins
Line: No, dude, I feel worse!

Title: Raisins
Line: Look, we're just trying to show you there's other girls out there.

Title: Raisins
Line: Dude, I don't have time to start over with other girls. I'm nine years old, dude! If I don't work things out with Wendy, I could be alone my whole life!

Title: Raisins
Line: [catches up to the other boys] She wants to see me again! My Raisins girl said she wants to see me again!

Title: Raisins
Line: I can't let Wendy go. This whole time I've been having my friends do all the talking for me. It's time I took control! [turns and opens one of the doors]

Title: Raisins
Line: What are you doing?

Title: Raisins
Line: Something I should have done a long time ago. [walks out the door and into the night]

Title: Raisins
Line: Bebe's house, night. Stan walks towards the front door, looks around, and knocks three times. No response, so he knocks again. The door opens and Bebe appears

Title: Raisins
Line: Bebe, you need to go talk to Wendy for me right now! [Bebe rolls her eyes and sighs] All this time I've been trying to have my friends do all the talking for me! Now I realize I need her friends to do it! Tell her I love her!

Title: Raisins
Line: Stan, why don't you show her you love her? If you really want Wendy back, try doing the most romantic thing you can think of.

Title: Raisins
Line: [thinks] Okay, so what's the most romantic thing I can think of?

Title: Raisins
Line: If you really want a shot at getting her back, stand outside her window, hold a boombox over your head, and play [closes her eyes] Peter Gabriel.

Title: Raisins
Line: Wendy's house, night. Stan stands on the lawn with a boombox, looking up at Wendy's window. He presses the play button and holds up the boombox. Peter Gabriel's "Shock the Monkey" plays from somewhere in the middle. Wendy appears at the window and looks down, her jaw dropping. Stan holds the boombox higher, keeping Wendy's gaze on him. Wendy covers her mouth as Token appears next to her at the window. Stan's jaw drops. Wendy leaves the window. Token unleashes the curtain ties, and the curtains close upon the window

Title: Raisins
Line: Raisins, night, outside. The outside lights turn off. Butters waits outside on the curb with a present. The front door opens and Lexus appears. Butters rises to greet her

Title: Raisins
Line: Okay, Porsche, see you tomorrow. Bye, Mercedes.

Title: Raisins
Line: [approaches] Lexus! [she takes a few steps back]

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh. Oh, hi, sweetie.

Title: Raisins
Line: I waited all night for you to get off work.

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh, really? [takes a few more steps back] Huhunh, that's great. Uhm, Maury...

Title: Raisins
Line: I I just could- I just couldn't stop thinking about you.

Title: Raisins
Line: [a huge bouncer] There a problem?

Title: Raisins
Line: Could you uh just help walk me to my- bike?

Title: Raisins
Line: Right. [steps up behind her and shoves Butters aside. He keeps his arm in place so Butters doesn't get any closer to Lexus]

Title: Raisins
Line: [to Butters] Thanks again for the big tip. You are such a sweetie. Come back and see me real soon, okay? [moves forward, with Maury close behind]

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh wait, Lexus. Jeheez, I almost forgot. Ah I got you this present.

Title: Raisins
Line: [stops and grabs it] Oh wow. Thanks, cutie.

Title: Raisins
Line: It's a little stuffed bear dressed as a rabbit. [tries to get closer, but Maury holds him back]

Title: Raisins
Line: Gosh, that's the nicest gift I've gotten all night. Thank you. [reaches her bike] Well I gotta go, honey. Be sure to come back to Raisins and see me again, okaaay? [unlocks her bike from its post]

Title: Raisins
Line: [tries to get closer, but Maury him back] Well yeah, but, but, hey, [tries to get closer, but Maury him back] hey Lexus? Well I was thinking, well, I was thinking that we should- go do something sometime.

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh gee, that would be great, honey, but I'm reeeally busy this week. Tell you what: you come back to Raisins and then we'll be able to hang out all we want, okay? [Maury helps her on to her bike]

Title: Raisins
Line: O-kay!

Title: Raisins
Line: Bye, cutie!

Title: Raisins
Line: Bye, bye darling! [Maury turns and goes back to the restaurant. Butters holds his hands over his heart] Wow... a real-life relationship.

Title: Raisins
Line: [South Park Elementary, day. All the boys are in various stages of dress. Most of them are in their P.E. uniforms.]

Title: Raisins
Line: [sternly] All right, kids! Out on the gym floor for P.E. class. [the boys break up and head to their lockers. Stan remains on a bench on his back, alone, with just a towel and his hat on]

Title: Raisins
Line: [returns] Come on, Stan. We're gonna play dodgeball.

Title: Raisins
Line: [with emotion in his voice] I can't believe it. She's in love with somebody else.

Title: Raisins
Line: Dude, you need to snap out of this! So Wendy left you for Token. What are you gonna do? Just be miserable your whole life?

Title: Raisins
Line: There's nothing else I can do. She was my whole life.

Title: Raisins
Line: Aw, come on, dude! All you've done for the last four days is mope around! You might as well hang out with those Goth kids who dress in black and talk about pain all the time!

Title: Raisins
Line: Maybe I should. At least they will understand me. Maybe I should hang with the Goth kids.

Title: Raisins
Line: South Park Elementary, loading bay. Stan finds the goth kids.

Title: Raisins
Line: [with black puffy, feathery hair, streaked in red] Life is pain. Life is only pain. [his hair falls over his right eye, he jerks his head back to put it back in place] We're all taught to believe in happy fairytale endings. [his hair falls over his eye, he jerks his head back] But there's only blackness. Dark, depressing loneliness that [his hair falls over his eye, he jerks his head back] eats at your soul.

Title: Raisins
Line: [dressed in something like a tuxedo, sporting a curly pompadour] Who needs that kind of Barbie love, anyway? Everyone's just walking around like a bunch of conformists. Go ahead and wear your business suits so you can make thirty-four thousand dollars a year to buy your condominium. They're all zombies racing to their graves. Love didn't work for my mom and dad. Why should it work for me?

Title: Raisins
Line: My dad is such an asshole. Drunken bastard doesn't even know I exist. But then he won't let me go to the Skinny Puppy concert because my heroine-addict aunt is coming over for dinner. [takes a puff] Dinner? That's a laugh. Just an excuse for my mom to bitch at me for not wearing girly clothes like all the Britney Spears wannabes at this school.

Title: Raisins
Line: They're all a bunch of Nazi conformists cheerleaders. [Stan looks stunned at the age of this youngest of Goths]

Title: Raisins
Line: But if life is only pain, then... what's the point of living?

Title: Raisins
Line: Just to make life more miserable for the conformists. [his hair falls over his eye, he jerks his head back]

Title: Raisins
Line: All right, so how do I join you?

Title: Raisins
Line: If you wanna be one of the non-conformists, all you have to do is dress just like us and listen to the same music we do.

Title: Raisins
Line: Raisins, day. Raisins is preparing for a new day of food and fun. Mercedes escorts a new employee around

Title: Raisins
Line: Okay, I know it's your first day, Ferrari, so I wanna go over the basics with you.

Title: Raisins
Line: Okay.

Title: Raisins
Line: First of all, there's a five foot rule. If you come within five feet of a customer, you need to acknowledge them, even if they're not at your table. "Hey, cutie." [waves and winks] When you're not serving food or talking with customers, you need to dance around and have fun. [they stop by a wooden bucket] We use things like Hula Hoops, silly strings, and water guns to play with the other girls. Be sure to giggle a lot, and be sure to show off your raisins. [they leave the bucket] Now, when you take a customer's order, you need to sit down at the table with them and make them think you're interested. Write your name down for them and make them feel special. "Oh man, I am so bored. Thank God you guys came in." If you want good tips, the most important thing is physical contact. Just a simple hold of the arm can mean the difference between five and twenty dollars. "I'll be right back with your order, guys." [holds Ferrari's shoulder]

Title: Raisins
Line: Wow, thank you so much, Mercedes.

Title: Raisins
Line: Okay. Well, I guess we're ready to open for business. Good luck. [Ferrari walks off] Go ahead and open for business, Porsche!

Title: Raisins
Line: Okay! [opens the doors and Butters bolts in, quite excitedly]

Title: Raisins
Line: Hi, welcome to Raisins!

Title: Raisins
Line: Hi! Is Lexus here?

Title: Raisins
Line: Hey, cutie.

Title: Raisins
Line: Darling!

Title: Raisins
Line: [hugs him] How are we doing today?

Title: Raisins
Line: [hugs back] Oh God. I missed you so much.

Title: Raisins
Line: Henrietta's room. It's quite the room, with posters for Skippy Puppy and the Nothing Matters tour, a Blauhaus poster, candles all around, a mace on the floor, cigarettes next to a book, an ornate candelabrum and chair, and a darkened atmosphere.

Title: Raisins
Line: [Reciting her poem] Shallow life. Drowning alone, I gasp for air. Coldness creeps over pale skin. There is sadness so deep it pulls me down Happiness dies in a deep, dark sea.

Title: Raisins
Line: Yeah, happiness dies. [his hair falls over his eye, he jerks his head back]

Title: Raisins
Line: [dressed all in black, with a black hat with puffball] Yeah.

Line: All right, your turn, Stan. Read one of your poems about pain.

Line: [takes up his paper and reads his poem] There is darkness all around me Deep, piercing black, I cannot breathe My heart has been raped.

Title: Raisins
Line: Whoa.

Title: Raisins
Line: [continues] The pain is everlasting. I miss you so much, babe. Want to hold you in my arms again, girl. Want to-

Line: [the bedroom door opens and a blindingly invasive amount of light comes in, she looks inside] Henrietta! Hi sweetie!

Title: Raisins
Line: Go away Mom! Leave me alone!

Line: Daddy and I just got your birthday present! But you can't see what it is till tomorrow!

Title: Raisins
Line: Ee-you are so creative, honey.

Title: Raisins
Line: Conformist bitch.

Title: Raisins
Line: Yeah.

Title: Raisins
Line: Raisins, day. Two of the Raisins girls are entertaining the child customers, who respond enthusiastically. The phone rings and Porsche arrives to answer it.

Title: Raisins
Line: Thanks for calling Raisins. This is Porsche. Have you tried our Double Whammy Wings?

Title: Raisins
Line: [seated on his bed in his room. A picture of Lexus is taped to his wall next to the window. The action switches back and forth] Hi. Is Lexus there, please? This is her boyfriend. [Lexus happens to walk by, and Porsche hands her the phone.]

Line: Thanks for calling Raisins. This is Lexus.

Title: Raisins
Line: Hey Lexus.

Line: Oh, okay. Hi, cutie. [keeps an eye out for passing customers. Three boys walk by and she covers the phone's receiver] Hey sweetie. [lifts her hand from the receiver] So how are you, honey?

Line: I'm fine. I miss you though. [lays on his back, getting comfortable] Yeah, school was pretty tough today. We had two quizzes, and one of them was a pop quiz. [shot of Lexus pouring lemonade into a pitcher] Sometimes I think our classes are too hard. [back to Butters' room] But I thought about you all day long. I promise. So how is your day going?

Title: Raisins
Line: Good, good.

Title: Raisins
Line: Hey, hey sweetie, I was thinking tonight you could come over and we could watch The Exorcist on DVD.

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh, gee, I don't know, cutie. [another Raisins girl comes with glasses to refill, Lexus ] Why don't you just come down to Raisins?

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh well, uh I kinda don't have any money left. Unh, I spent it all on Raisins the last six times.

Title: Raisins
Line: [waving to customers] Awww, that's too bad, cutie. I really wanna see you.

Title: Raisins
Line: Oh, I really wanna see you too, baby. Eh don't, don't worry. I'll get more money

Line: [walks to the phone's base to end the conversation] 'K sugar. Gotta run.

Line: Uh-okay. Uh, hey, Lexus, well, there's something I've been meaning to say. [Lexus has hung up and is walking away with her pitcher] Here it goes: Lexus, I- Oh jeeze, maybe I shouldn't say it- no wait, I want to say it. I love you. [hangs up quickly and nervously] Heeheee, heh, Oh my God.

Title: Raisins
Line: Butters' house, living room. Butters arrives there moments later and faces the couch

Title: Raisins
Line: Dad, I need an advance on my allowance again.

Line: O-hoo no Butters! You got an advance two days ago. [Linda is dusting off the family portrait by the front door.]

Line: Uh but I spent it all.

Line: What are you spending all that money on, Butters?

Line: [he and Linda are surprised] Girlfriend?

Line: You... have a girlfriend, Butters?

Title: Raisins
Line: [bashfully, puts his hands behind his back] Yeah.

Title: Raisins
Line: And she's... a... girl, right?

Title: Raisins
Line: Yup!

Title: Raisins
Line: Well all right! Good for you, Butters!

Title: Raisins
