Title: Douche and Turd
Line: We were just wondering who you might be voting for, for the school's new mascot.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I haven't decided yet.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Oh really? Well, that's interesting. You certainly should think about it and make the right decision. [pulls out a wrapped hard candy and shows it] Butterscotch candy?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [reaches out and grabs it] Sure. [opens it]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Clyde, are you aware of what Turd Sandwich can bring to our school?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: A turd sandwich is not only the first turd to be nominated school mascot, but even the first sandwich. [Clyde bites into the candy, producing loud crunches]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: You see, what Turd Sandwich brings to our school, Clyde, is a complete package. The turd and the bread. And the lettuce, and the olives.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Whe-where as Giant Douche is just, well, ju-just a, ju-ju-just a giant douche.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: So, come voting day, you'll now most likely vote for the turd sandwich, yes?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [finishes the candy, then thinks for a few seconds] I'm still not totally sure.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Well then, perhaps we could interest you in [pulls out another wrapped candy] another butterscotch candy? [Clyde takes the candy and consumes that one as well]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: South Park Elementary, now a polling station. A "Vote for School Mascot!" hangs on the back wall and over the hallway. A reluctant Stan takes a ballot, and Kyle smiles, thinking he has Stan on his side.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: You're doing the right thing, Stan. Don't you feel like you're a part of something now?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I guess... [P Diddy and his posse look on from one end of the polling station, with P cocking his gun]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Look, it may not seem important now, but your vote really does count, and we all have to do our part.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Okay. [finishes up and seals his ballot, then walks away]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Woah... wait, what are you doing?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I'm voting.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: No, no, you... you wrote down Turd Sandwich.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Yeah, I know.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: ...Dude, you're supposed to vote for Giant Douche.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [annoyed] I thought I was supposed to make my own decision.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Well yeah, but not if your decision is for Turd Sandwich! What the hell is wrong with you?!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Wait a minute, you didn't want me to vote, you wanted me to vote for your guy!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Well, I just figured you'd vote for my guy! Who's fuckin' friend are you?! [calls out to] Puffy!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [interrupts] Hey, fuck off, Kyle. [aside, about Puffy and his crew] Don't let them intimidate you, Stan. I'll help walk you to the booth. And then I'm gonna buy you a nice steak dinner with all the trimmings.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Oh, forget it! I'm not gonna be persuaded into voting and I'm and I'm not gonna be threatened into voting if I don't feel comfortable with it! I'm not gonna vote and you can all just live with it!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: The Principal's Office, later.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: We've simply had it with your son, Mr. and Mrs. Marsh. Voting just doesn't appear to be important to him.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Stanley, when you left for school this morning, you said you were going to vote!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: The whole thing is a joke!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: You see? He's out of control. It's nearly torn our whole family apart.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Well, my hands are tied. We can no longer have Stan's behavior jeopardizing the other children. He must be removed.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Oh! Are you happy now, Stan? You just got yourself suspended!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: No, I'm afraid it's worse than that. By county law I'm bound to enforce the harshest punishment possible.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Expulsion?!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: No. Banishment.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: B-bani-banishment?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: You can appeal to the city council, but I don't think it'll do any good. Your son must leave South Park, never to return.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [goes over to Randy and cries into his chest] Oh, Randy!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Our son, banished! Where did we go wrong?! [cries on Sharon's shoulder]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: You-you're all joking, right?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: A moonlit partly-cloudy night in South Park. The townsfolk are gathered at the edge of town, with Stan facing them all alone. A horse stands at the ready on one side of Main Street.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [steps forth and reads a proclamation] As it was in the times of our forefathers, so it is now. Stan Marsh, for not following our most sacred of rites, you are hereby banished from South Park for all eternity. Or until you decide that voting is important. Good-bye, Stan. May the gods treat you more kindly than we did. [the townsfolk step forth and begin ripping away at Stan's coat and shirt. Herbert Garrison is first: he rips off a piece of Stan's coat, spits on it, and throws it back at Stan. He leaves and Officer Barbady steps forth, repeating what Herbert Garrison did. Craig follows suit, then Kyle steps up]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Stan, don't you think this has gone far enough? Is it really that big a deal? [Stan sighs, but says nothing more in response] Yeah, just vote. For Giant Douche.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I'm not voting! [Kyle then steps forth and repeats what the others did before him]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Yo, Puffy man, are we just gonna let this happen? [cocks his weapon] We've gots to kill this non-votin' fool!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: No, Justacious, let him go. He won't survive a fore-night in the wilderness. [the adults tie Stan up on the horse backwards and send him off with supplies to tide him over for a while]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: This is breaking your mother's heart, Stan. She couldn't even help tie you to the horse.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Dad, isn't this a little extreme?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Jesus. I guess maybe you'll never understand how important voting is. [puts a pail over Stan's head] Goodbye, Son. [stops for a few seconds, then swats the horse to get it moving. The horse walks off slowly. Stephen Stotch steps up with a horn and blows into it. Randy and Sharon stand together, embracing shoulders] That's... one of the hardest things a parent ever has to do.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: A plain, night. Stan rides into the night and into the morning on the plain, then through a desert, then into a forest. A group of people appear and spot him

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Look! What is that?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Oh, the poor thing!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Hello? [the people gather round and remove the pail]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Don't worry, we'll free you.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Just sit still for a moment.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Oh, thank God.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Get offa him, you filthy human! [they throw Stan off the horse. The pail rolls away. Stan looks back, confused, tufts of hair popping out through the holes on his torn cap. The people were apparently talking to the horse, not to him. The camera goes back to the horse, and the people are shown to be members of PETA. They're cleaning the horse up]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Poor thing needs water.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: You're safe now.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Shame on you, making this horse your slave. [a balding man throws real blood on Stan]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Awww!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Come, you can live with us.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: We will give you food and shelter.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: What about me?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Open the gate! [A pair of gates open up to the PETA compound. The members lead the horse in and Stan trails along. They approach whom looks to be the leader of the compound. The compound itself has all kinds of animals - it's an animal sanctuary]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [presenting the horse]This poor creature is in need of food and water.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [strokes the horse's mane] You have a home here, friend.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: The... kid wants to stay, too.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I was put on the horse. I didn't wanna ride it.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I don't know if you can stay. We'll have to ask Dr. Cornwallis. Come. [they walk among the animals. Stan looks around and takes it all in.] We don't normally allow outsiders. See, here we live in harmony with animals. They're not our pets but our fellow living beings. We work with the animals and try to live as they do. [stops, lowers his pants, and shits onto the ground. Stan looks on astonishment, then walks around the pile of shit as the man pulls his pants back up and walks on.] We make friends with the animals. We coexist, and we... intermarry. [approaches a llama and puts his arm around her neck] This is my wife, Janice. [Stan looks on quizzically] The outside world looks down on a man marrying a llama, but our love knows no boundaries. [he turns to the llama, has her face him, and starts kissing her. Stan just gawks at the pair]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Wow, you guys really love animals.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [moves on to a man and a chicken] And why not? Mark here has been with Kelly for three years now. [moves on to another man and an ostrich] And Gary and Sally here have just managed to have a child together. [in a manger is an ostrich-baby, somewhat humanoid with an ostrich beak]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Kill me...

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Yes, life here is good and natural. But now that you know where our compound is, you'll either have to live with us, or be murdered. [they stop before a tent]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I'll live with you.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: It's not up to you. You'll have to talk with Dr. Cornwallis. [Stan pauses at the tent's entrance, then enters and approaches a goat, which is munching on hay. The goat stops and looks at Stan, then resumes eating. Stan exits the tent] What did he say?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: He said I can stay.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Excellent! Dr. Cornwallis is wise beyond his year. Here's your PETA shirt and a bumper sticker. [Stan looks at his new stuff]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: SP Public Access Presents: Debate 2004.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: This is Debate 2004 with your host, Jim Lehrer.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Welcome to the cable-access televised debate between a giant douche [screen left] and a turd sandwich [screen right] We'll start with Giant Douche. Sir, some students and parents are reluctant to have a... giant douche represent them. What do you say to those people?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Jim, first of all I would like to thank you for monitoring this debate. And I would like to thank all of the students and their parents for coming.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Aww, suck-up, suck-up! [a man behind him and to his right leans over and shushes him] What?! That's an obvious suck-up move.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: But I would hope that those students and their parents who question my qualities would simply look at my opponent. He is a turd sandwich

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [leaning forward] You're a turd sandwich.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: ... No, sir, if you'll pardon me, you are in fact, the turd sandwich.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [quickly countering] You're a turd sandwich.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: ... Sir, you are a turd sandwich.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [quickly countering] You're a turd sandwich.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Ahh, Turd Sandwich, I will ask you not to speak out of turn.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I-I'm sorry, Jim.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Anyway, as I was saying, ahh... wait, I-I forgot what I was saying.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Ha. What a douche.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: All right, Turd Sandwich, this next question is for you. How should South Park Elementary enforce its laws of conduct for young athletes during sporting events.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [long pause] ...Uh, you know, uh, my opponent wouldn't even know the answer to that question. If you ask him the same question, he would not answer it. [Giant Douche just looks at him] He would stand around and just babble on and on about nothing until he was finally saved by the buzze-. [the buzzer sounds over his last two words.]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Your time is up, Turd.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: The PETA compound, next morning. Stan scrubs away at the empty tubs and buckets of food the animals ate from the previous day. The bald man approaches.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Stan, I want to introduce you to my stepdaughter, Teresa. [the camera pans down to show a lamb with small horns] She seems to have taken a liking to you. [suggestively] And she's ovulating.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Ahh, no thanks, that's okay.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Stan, some PETA members are growing concerned that maybe you don't love animals.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I do love animals, just ...not like you guys do.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: You... don't belong here, Stan. You should return home.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I can't. I was banished for not voting.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: But, why on earth wouldn't you wanna vote?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I think voting is great. I just didn't care this time because it was between a giant douche and a turd sandwich.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: But Stan, don't you know? It's always between a giant douche and a turd sandwich. Nearly every election since the beginning of time has been between some douche and some turd. They're the only people who suck up enough to make it that far in politics.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I guess... I guess you're right. [casts his eyes down and to the left in reflection. An arm appears, with a gun at the end aimed at Stan]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Yo, what did I say was going to happen to you, bitch? [his four bodyguards aim their guns at Stan as well]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [jumps] Aaah!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [pops in] Aaaah!! He's wearing the skin of an animal! [runs off, only to return with a pail of real blood] Take that! [throws the blood at Puff Daddy, who spreads his arms out and down. The man calms down] I... hope that teaches you a lesson about wearing fur.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Itius, Rodicus! [the bodyguards fire their weapons at the PETA members]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Vote or die!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [braves his way through the crossfire, but gets hit on his left shoulder] Aaaah!! [keeps moving]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [goes to shield a dog] Protect the animals! Protect the animals! [he's shot and falls away. The dog then urinates on the man's head]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [rushes up to his llama and holds her] Janice, we shall die together in each other's arms! [three shots kill him and the llama prances away. More PETA members fall.]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Kill me! Kill meee!! [Dr. Cornwallis is out of his tent and munching on the head of a dead man]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: South Park Elementary polling station. Mr. Mackey tallies up the votes.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: M'kay... that's one more vote for Turd Sandwich.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [through clenched teeth] So who won, Mr. Mackey?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: It's pretty close, but it looks like Giant Douche is gonna win.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Oh, no! Noooo!!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Ha! You lose, fatass!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [by the doors, motions to the others to look] Uh hey, wait a minute! [the others present gather round and look out. Stan approaches the school, battered and injured, and the others stream out of the school]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Stan!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Stan, you came back. Does that mean... you learned the importance of voting?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: I learned that I'd better get used to having to pick between a douche and a turd sandwich because it's usually the choice I'll have.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: He's going to vote!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [murmuring amongst themselves] He's going to vote. He's going to vote. [they gather round and hoist Stan up, carrying him inside. Stan is lowered and he fills out the ballot. He holds his shoulder and thinks a moment while images of an eagle, the White House, and the US flag float in the background. He makes up his mind, he votes for Turd Sandwich. He considers his vote, then approaches the ballot box and drops his ballot in. Mr. Mackey, holding the box, spins around in his chair happily.]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Let's get out the vote! Let's make our voices heard! We've been given the right to choose between a douche and a turd. It's democracy in action! Put your freedom to the test. A big, fat turd or a stupid douche. Which do you like best?

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [Adding Stan's vote to the tally] Stan's vote bring the total votes for Turd Sandwich to... thirty six! And Giant Douche has... one thousand, four hundred, and ten. Giant Douche still wins!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Yeah! All right!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Aawwww!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Dude, so my vote didn't even really matter!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Hey! That's not true, Stan.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [genuflects behind Stan] You can't judge the merits of voting on whether or not your candidate won.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [genuflects behind Stan] Your vote still mattered.

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [rushing into the school] Hey everybody! [holds up a shredded PETA shirt. Everyone turns and looks] They just found all the PETA members murdered at their compound! [all gasp]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: What the? They're all dead? Well, that means...

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: That we can go back to being the South Park Cows! [opens his jacket and shows off his Cows shirt]

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: Hooray! All right!

Title: Douche and Turd
Line: [to Stan] Now your vote didn't matter.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: South Park, day. A lovely tree appears and the camera pans down to street level. Stan and friends are on the sidewalk across the street moving along.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You guys know what? Um, the last thing you do when you die, is crap your pants.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: ...What?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah, when you die, your jowels release and crap comes flying out your ass. [laughs heartily. The other boys stop]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: That is fucking stupid, Cartman!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Oh yeah?! I'll bet you five bucks that when you die you crap your pants, asshole!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Hey everybody, it's time! [everyone stops and looks] It's time!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [a small group] It's time. Oh, it's time? It's happening. It's happening now? Let's go! [they move off to their left]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: It's time for what?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Get down to Metzger's Field! It's about to happen! [everyone follows him towards the field]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Metzger's Field, later. A man is speaking to the crowd gathered there.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: People of South Park I am pleased to be with you on this most historic day. A day you were certainly all remember... as the day your town... became great. The grand opening of the first South Park... Wall-Mart! [the camera zooms out to show the full scope of the store. Everyone applauds and cheers]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [hugging Sharon] Look at it, honey. It's so big.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [hugging Mr. Slave] It's like we're a real town now. [the boys finally arrive]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Whoa, awesome!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Hey! Isn't there where Stark's Pond used to be? Where we used to kayak and fish?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah! Now it's a Wall-Mart!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I know that with the opening of the South Park branch of Wall-Mart, you will all see your town completely change... [walks over to the entrance, which has a banner across it: "Grand Opening."] Now, shop friends. Shop! [steps aside and the doors open to a spacious store. The townsfolk rush inside]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: It's beautiful!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [greeting shoppers at the door.] Welcome to Wall-Mart. Welcome to Wall-Mart. ...Welcome to Wall-Mart.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Sharon, isn't that your father?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yes. Wall-Mart is the leading employer of seniors. And they also employ the handicapped.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [approaching] Hello, Mrs. M-marsh. Can I help g- Can I help you get a sh- shopping cart today?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Why yes, I'd love one, Jimmy. [Jimmy turns and approaches a line of carts. He tugs at the one in the front, wrestling it away from the other carts. Once it's out far enough, he jumps to the rear and pushes it out]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [awestruck] My God. Look at all these incredible bargains.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [the boys are in the movie aisle] Dude, check it out! Time Cop on DVD. Three copies for eighteen bucks!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Why the hell would you want three copies of the same movie?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Because one copy is nine ninety-eight! But this way you save like twenty bucks!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You only need one copy, r-tard!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Okay, fine, dumbass, YOU go ahead and buy one copy for nine ninety-eight!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Okay, fine, I will! [grabs a copy] H-wait a minute! I don't even want one copy of Time Cop! [puts it back]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dude, you can't shop for crap. [a wide shot of the store]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [shopping with her husband] I can't believe these bargains.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [from an office window above the showroom floor] Fools. Ignorant fools.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: The Marsh house, night. The living room has been redecorated with items got from Wall-Mart. The family is enjoying snacks in fancy plasticware.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Just look at the Marsh family, huh? Brand-new television, new plastic dishware and cups, and enough bulk-buy ramen to last us a thousand winters. [three huge pallets of ramen are shown]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dad, how come Wall-Mart is able to sell everything so cheap?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: It's simple economics, son. I don't understand it at all, but, God I love it.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: The Marsh house, later. The house is asleep; Randy is dreaming, and reacting to his dreams.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Six ninety-nine, fifteen dollars, free for fifteen ninety-eight...

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [suddenly awake] Aaaah! [looks at the window and crawls out of bed, then walks towards the window. He plants his hands on the window panes, and in the distance he sees that great shining beacon called Wall-Mart. He opens his pajama shirt and presses his body against the window. A soft sigh leaves his lungs...] Yeaaah... [Sharon wakes up]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Randy, what are you doing?!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [wraps himself up again and goes back to bed] Anu-nothing! [puts on his slippers] I'ma-I'ma-I'm just gonna head down to the Wall-Mart real quick.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: It's almost midnight.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah, think about it. If I go there now, there won't be anybody else there. [with determination] I can have all the bargains to myself! [heads out]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Wall-Mart, midnight. Randy enters dressed in pajamas and robe, only to find more shoppers in there. Wall-Mart never closes, and it's never empty. An elderly lady greets him.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Thanks for coming to Wall-Mart. [waves] All are welcome. All are welcome! [Randy is stunned that he's not the only shopper there]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Next morning, the boys are on a sidewalk heading towards downtown.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Excuse me! Hello?! Can somebody tell my why we're going to Jim's Drugs to buy Voltar cards when Wall-Mart has them for three bucks cheaper?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dude, I can't deal with Wall-Mart right now. My parents had me there for three hours last night. [they pass by a man closing up his shop for the last time]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Oh, sorry boys. I'm going out of business.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Why, Mr. Farkle?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I can't compete with Wall-Mart's low prices. Everyone is shopping there now, and... well, I can't make ends meet. [Cartman pulls out a violin from somewhere and begins playing it masterfully] I've got to sell the store and try to find another line of work.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [glares at Cartman] Cartman, stop it!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: What? I just felt like playing a little violin, Kyle.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I appreciate your business, boys, but you'll have to try somewhere else in town. [walks away sobbing]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: See?! That sucks, dude!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: What? That's called progress, Kyle.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah, but what about all the people getting laid off from the grocery stores? [Cartman whips out the violin and plays it again] And what about all the- [looks at Cartman, takes away his violin, breaks it in half using his leg, and throws the pieces to the ground]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: ... Whatever. I can go get another one at Wall-Mart. It was only five bucks. [gives Kyle the finger, turns around, and walks away. Kyle watches him leave]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Come on, let's go to Main Street and support one of those stores. [Kyle turns, and the three remaining boys walk away.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Downtown, later. The boys arrive at Main Street and are startled.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: What the hell? [before them is a downtown that is shuttered and decayed. The asphalt is gone from the roads and eagles hover over the area. A window crashing makes them jump, and Butters appears around a corner, making weird noises.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Butters? [more strange noises come from Butters' mouth]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Butters? What the hell are you doing?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Wull ah I'm just playin' Monster. It's kinda spooky out here. [this is true. Butters resumes his monster act.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dude, we gotta show our parents what Wall-Mart is doing to our town. [the boys turn and leave.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: The Marsh house, later. Stan, Kyle, and Kenny enter to find a house stuffed with Wall-Mart items.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dad? [looks around at all the stuff] Jesus Christ, Da-dad! Dad?!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Staaaan? [the boys hear him and rush over to the source of the noises]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dad, oh my God!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Staan...

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: What? D-dad, are are you dying?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No, I'm just... really, really tired. I... was shopping at Wall-Mart all night.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: But you-your face!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Checkout line... They had these... little stickers filled with glitter! They were only ninety nine cents for 15 of them. I couldn't resist! Do you want one? [tears one off and sticks it to Stan's cheek] Here. It's a little turtle. [faints and falls over]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Wall-Mart, later. Shopping continues as usual. In his office, the Manager nervously reaches into his desk drawer and pulls out a bottle of liquor. He takes two sips and quickly hides it when he hears a knock at his door.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Come in? [the boys and their parents, Butters' parents, Chef, Herbert Garrison and Mr. Slave all enter] Oh hello, fine shoppers.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Sir, we just had a big town meeting, and decided we don't want your Wall-Mart here anymore.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: We're sorry, but it seems our Main Street is dying and good people are losing their jobs. We'd all like you... out of South Park.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [begins to cackle nervously] What? What, you think I want to be here? I hate this place. But it... won't let me leave.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: But you run the Wall-Mart.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Oh, you're wrong! [rises from his chair and moves towards the group] Wall-Mart... isn't run by anybody! First it reels you in with its bargains. Next thing you know you, you're working at the Wall-Mart because it has all the jobs. Then you're sitting in a little office, trapped on all sides.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: They why don't you just quit?!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [whispering loudly] Not so loud! It can hear you.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You hate Wall-Mart, too? [rumbles emanate from the walls]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Aah! [nervously] I didn't say that! I love Wall-Mart! With all its... fantastic bargains and one-stop shopping, who can't love it, right? [turns around and grabs some papers] Uh, Wa-Wall-Mart takes the hassle out of shopping and, and makes it both affordable and fun. [he writes as he talks, then shows the group what he wrote: "NOT SAFE TO TALK HERE."] Ah-and Wall-Mart really gives back to the community! Us people are certainly happy to have a store like Wall-Mart, aren't we? [writes some more and shows the group a second sheet: "MEET ME OUT BACK IN 5 MINS." He grimaces and tries to hint at them. The group leaves.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Hey, wait a minute, I think we just got squirreled.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah. That guy probably thinks he can get us to go away by being so goofy! [circles his finger round his ear to indicate insanity. Seconds later the manager screams and flies out the window, only to end up hanging himself. The group looks on as the manager's pants drop off and poo follows shortly]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [catching up with the other boys] Ha! You owe me five bucks, Kyle!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: The Marsh house, night. The family is at table waiting for dinner. Sharon walks in with steaks.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Here we go, everyone. I got three nice steaks from South Park Grocery. We'll have to share them.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Heh, I remember when we could afford to buy six steaks when we shopped at Wall-Mart.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah, but Dad, the whole town agreed not to shop at Wall-Mart anymore.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I know, I know! God! [pounds the table] Bleeeh! [Sharon joins them at table and the family begins eating]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Mom, Dad, when people die, do they always crap their- [knocks over his glass of milk, which spills onto Shelly]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Oh, you stupid turd!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Oh Jesus, a broken glass! Well, I don't see any choice now! We have to go to Wall-Mart!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: We do?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Huh! Where else are we gonna get a new glass at this hour?! Everyone get your shoes on, we're goin' to Wall-Mart!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: But Dad, we're not supposed to shop at-

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: STAN! One family buying one glass isn't gonna make a difference!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Wall-Mart, night. The Marsh family arrives and sees what Randy saw before.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Heeeey... [The Broflovskis approach and Randy looks] Gerald, what are you doing?! We said we weren't going to shop at the Wall-Mart anymore!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Well where else was I gonna get a napkin dispenser at nine thirty at night?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [noticing other familiar faces] Mr. Garrison! Chef! Jimbo! [the shoppers stop and look] Now, come on people! What the hell is wrong with you?! Don't you see what you're all doing?!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Well what are you doing here, Randy?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I came because I wanted to make sure nobody was shopping here.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dad!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Oh all right, maybe I was gonna buy a glass. One glass! ... And some chips. And butter. [pulls out a sheet and looks at it] And some new pliers.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Jesus! Look at us! We all don't like the Wall-Mart, but we can't stop coming here.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: It's like some mystical evil force.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah. This place has a power over us we can't resist! We have to find a way to put the South Park Wall-Mart out of business once and for all!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Let's burn it down!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No, no, no! Let's freeze it!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I think it's best we try to reason with it.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No! All we have to do is not shop at Wall-Mart anymore! If you want it to go away, all it takes is a little self-control and personal responsibility.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Outside, later. The Wall-Mart is on fire and the shoppers are watching it burn.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Kumbaya, my Lord, Kumbaya. [the people begin to sway back and forth]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Kumbaya, my Lord, Kumbaya. Kumbaya, my Lord...

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Sidewalk, next day. The boys are walking along.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You butthole, Kyle. You just had to go and ruin everything, didn't you?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [looking at Cartman] It wasn't my idea to burn the Wall-Mart down.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No, but you got everyone all worked up! You're always jealous of the Wall-Mart. You always hated it.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dude, our town is going to be better without the- [sounds of construction are heard. Kyle turns to look. ] What the?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Oh, awesome! [rushes towards Wall-Mart]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: How... How did this happen? [the other boys make their way to the store, then look around at the restored store, which is running as if nothing had happened the night before. Kyle's parents are shopping there, and they run into the boys.] Mom, Dad? Why are you shopping here?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: We can't destroy it, son. We have to learn to live with it.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Can I help you? [the boys turn around and see the man is Randy, and the jump back in fright]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dad, what are you doing?!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You get a discount working here. Ten percent. That means the bargains are even better.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dad, you're a geologist!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I'll make less money, sure, but... as long as I buy everything at Wall-Mart, it'll all even out. Don't you see? Wall-Mart isn't our enemy, it's our neighborhood friend.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Outside. The boys walk away from Wall-Mart and see a driver lifting I-beams into place with his crane.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Hey! Hey! [the driver looks at them] Who the hell told you to put this thing back up?!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Sorry kid, we've got orders from corporate headquarters.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: But nobody wants a Wall-Mart here!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You're gonna have to talk to the higher-ups.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Where are they?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Bentonville, Arkansas. That's where Wall-Mart started, that's where all the bigwigs are. [drives away]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Looks like we're gonna have to go to Arkansas. Come on, guys. We're gonna put a stop to Wall-Mart once and for all!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [Inside the store] Whoa, Pixie Sticks, twenty-nine ceeeents? [freezes in place and hears sounds] Wall-Mart? ...Are you speaking to me? ...My friends? ...Trying to hurt you again? [turns a little angry] Yes, Wall-Mart. I understand. [with a look of determination, he leaves the store.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Coyote Lines, night. Stan, Kyle, and Kenny are at the ticket booth.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Three tickets to Bentonville, Arkansas, please.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [rushing up to join them] Wait! Guys! Hold on! I wanna go with you and help out.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No way! You wanna go with us so you can betray us at some point and keep us from destroying the Wall-Mart.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Nuh-uh.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah, huh! You wanna go with us so that later you go, "Haha! I was working for Wall-Mart all along!" or something.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I am not, Kyle!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dude, just let him come. The bus is about to leave. [he and Kenny head for the doors]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: All right, fine. Come on, fatass! [leaves to catch up with Stan.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [pulls out a knife from his back pocket] Haha. You fools have no idea that I would never let you hurt the Wall-Mart.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [rushes out to face Cartman] I heard that!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You heard what?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You said we have no idea that you're never let us hurt Wall-Mart!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: That's not what I said! [Stan comes out to see what's going on]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dude, come on!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: He is working for the Wall-Mart to stop us from succeeding!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dude, we have to go!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: God-damnit! [turns and heads towards Stan]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Well hurry up if you're coming, Cartman!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [to himself] Hehe. You stupid fools have no idea that I'm actually working for the Wall-Mart to stop you from succeeding!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Bentonville, Home of Wall-Mart. A bus pulls up to the store's headquarters and lets the four boys off.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Goddamn, that took a long time.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: It would've been faster if Cartman hadn't slashed the tires!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [drawing out the syllables] I did not! I wanna close Wall-Mart just as much as you guys do!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Corporate Headquarters, inside. A cavernous warehouse opens up before them, with busy workers, and a receptionist greets them.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Can I help you?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah. We've come to complain. We don't want a Wall-Mart in our town.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Who does? Nobody likes what the Wall-Mart does, but it keeps... right on doing it.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: We want to talk to who's in charge.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: In charge? I guess that would be Harvey Brown. He's the current president of Wall-Mart. One of the original creators.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Where's he?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: An ashtray. A hand rubs spent cigarette butts into it. The camera pulls out to reveal the president and the boys, and lots of empty glasses of liquor.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: We... invented the Wall-Mart Super Center in 1987. The idea was simple: build a store for one-stop shopping where bulk purchases could keep prices incredibly low. [defeated, buries his face in his left hand] We didn't know what we were doing. In just four years, it was out of control.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: So how do we stop it?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [raises his head] You don't stop it.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: There has to be a way!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: There's nothing! Don't you understand?! Nothing can stop the Wall-Mart in your town! ...Unless... of course, you can find and destroy its heart.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: The heart of Wall-Mart?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Sir, don't you think you're talking a little too much?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Every Wall-Mart has a heart, somewhere near the television department. Destroy the heart and you could reverse the entire process!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You speak too much, sir!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Why don't you guys just destroy the heart?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Because the Wall-Mart stops you. Many have tried, kid. Union leaders, nature activists, even the best fair-trade lawyers tried to stop the Wall-Mart and now. They are Wall-Mart shoppers all.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: All right. C'mon you guys. We have to get back home. [they drop down and leave the room]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [shakes his head] It won't work, don't you understand?! It isn't gonna stop until there's nothing but Wall-Mart left! Jesus, what did we do?! What did we do?! [the boys are at the doors, about to leave. Mr. Brown spins around on his stool] Boys! [the boys turn and see him take a gun to his head] Tell the world... I'm sorry! [the boys are alarmed]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No, dude, don't! [Mr. Brown shoots himself through the temple and falls over on his left side, dead. Seconds later he craps through his pants, leaving a hole in them and a fallen bar stool nearby. A few moments of shock, and then Cartman cracks up]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [pointing to Kyle] That's ten bucks you owe me, dick-face!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: A stormy night in front of Wall-Mart. Stan, Kyle, and Kenny arrive dressed in camouflage.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: All right, this is it! If Wall-Mart has a heart, we have to find it and destroy it! No matter what the Wall-Mart does to try to stop us, we have to be strong! Let's do it.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [rushes in and blocks their path. holding a dagger] I'm afraid not, Kyle! Wall-Mart is a great store! I could not let you fools ruin its terrific bargains! You see, I was working for Wall-Mart all along!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I knew you were!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No, you didn't.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yes, I did! I said from the beginning that you would do this!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No, you didn't.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yes, I did!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No, you didn't.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yes, I did!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No, you didn't.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yes, I did!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No, you didn't.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yes. I did! [a few more rounds of this and they stand head to head, silent]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: ...You see, Kyle, it was me who slashed the bu-

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [interrupting] -slashed the bus tires in Arkansas! I said so! I told you the minute that I- [Cartman babbles loudly to drown him out] -and I told you that-

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [plugs his ears] I can't hear you! Lalalalalala! [once he's sure Kyle is quiet, he unplugs his ears and pulls out his dagger] I'm sorry, boys. But if you want to hurt the Wall-Mart, you'll have to go through me! [holds out the dagger, ready for battle.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [he and Stan walk around Cartman] We don't have time for this! Kenny, keep him away from us! [Kenny does as told]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Very well, Kenny! Let us battle! [Kenny begins delivering blows at Cartman] Ow, Kenny. K-Kenny! Knock it off.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Stan and Kyle enter the store and walk past the greeter Marvin Marsh.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Welcome to Wall-Mart.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Save it, Grandpa!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: We've gotta find the television department. [the lights flicker and turn off. Randy leaps into view in front of the boys, carrying an ax. Stan and Kyle scream]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Boys, these axes are only four ninety-nine.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dad, we know how to destroy the Wall-Mart.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Shhhhh! What are you talking about?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: One of the creators told us. You have to take your keys over to the television department.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Television department... All right, come on, let's go! [they move down the aisle for some distance. Randy stops and jumps] Oh my God!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: What?!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Those two-dollar salt-and-pepper shakers! They were three dollars five minutes ago! The Wall-Mart is lowering its prices trying to stop us!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Come on, we've got to try to make it to the back! [the three make their way to the back, but Randy can't help but look at all the bargains]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Gaaah! Don't look! Don't look at its bargains! [they come across a bunch of bikes priced at $29.99. They scream and run off. The boys run down another aisle, but Randy isn't with them.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I think I see the television department in the back!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Is that the right way, Dad? Dad?! [looks around, then turns to his right. Kyle turns to his left. Both boys see Randy] Dad!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: The screwdriver set is only nine ninety-eight!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Come on, Dad!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I can't make it, boys! You're gonna have to go on without me!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: No, dad! We need your keys!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: This bargain is too great for me! I'm gonna have to buy these! Here! Take the keys and go on! [tosses the keys to Stan, who catches them] The television department is near the back! Next to the cell phones! Go! Hurry! I'm gonna go buy these screwdrivers! [the boys leave the aisle]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [passing the candy display] There! The television department!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: The television department. The wall is lined with TVs of all sizes. A hand appears and presses a button, and all the TVs turn on, showing the boys on screen. The camera pans over to the two boys, who are looking at a man dressed in white.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Hello, boys. Congratulations on getting this far. [the boys approach him]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Who are you?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I am... Wall-Mart. [the boys look at each other]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: I've taken this form in order to talk to you. But I can take many forms. [dons a brimmed hat] Does this suit you better? Or perhaps you prefer this form? [takes off the hat and puts on a robe] I can take whichever form I like. [removes the robe and puts on a pirate hat and black patch over his left eye.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: We don't want your store in our town; we come to destroy you.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Where's the heart?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: To find the heart of Wall-Mart, one must first ask oneself, "Who is it that asked the question?" [the boys look at each other again]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Me. I'm asking the question.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Ah, yes, but who are you?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Stan Marsh. Now, where's the heart?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Ah. You know the answer, but not the question!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: The question is, "Where is the heart?"

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Very well. You want to see the heart of Wall-Mart? It lies beyond that plasma-screen television. [the boys look to their right and walk over. The open a small door marked "EMPLOYEES ONLY" and they open it. A rectangular mirror is behind it.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: It's a mirror.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yes, don't you see? That is the heart of Wall-Mart. You, the consumer. I take many forms: Wall-Mart, K-Mart, Target. But I am one single entity: Desire!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Well, the guy in Arkansas said to destroy the heart. [the boys turn and face the mirror again, and Kyle takes a black mallet to it. It shatters.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Gaaah! No! No, what have you done?! [the building begins to rumble] Now you shall see my true form! [Removes his mustache and begins to march around with vigor and laughing harshly] Now you see me as I truly am!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: We'd better get out of here. [outside, Cartman and Kenny stop wrestling and witness the Wall-Mart rumbling and there's lighting flying around it. Inside, Stan and Kyle make their way to the front doors]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [panicking] Get out! It's gonna blow! [the shoppers pay heed]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Dad, come on! We've gotta get out!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Too late for me, son! I have to buy this stuff!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: The Wall-Mart is imploding! Everybody out NOW! [the shoppers and employees now bolt for the doors and run out as an M in Mart falls down.]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Outside on the parking lot, night. The building begins to collapse as everyone gathers in the parking lot. The building distorts, folds up and implodes into a shining blue dot, then reappears as crap, which falls to the ground where the Wall-Mart once stood. Cartman looks on in astonishment, then cracks up and walks away.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: [proudly] Boys, you did it! You killed the Wall-Mart! [the crowd cheers]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: How did you do it, Kyle?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: All Wall-Marts start a self-destruction sequence if you break a mirror in the back.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: We know how to destroy it now. Spread the word to all the towns! [nearby, a soldier sits at the ready to send out the news on a telegraph]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Wait. I think I understand the symbolism of the mirror. The Wall-Mart... is us.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Duh.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: You see boys, if we like our small-town charm more than the big corporate bullies, we all have to be willing to... pay a little bit more. Do you understand?

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah! Let's all go shop at Jim's Drugs down the street! [the crowd approves and marches down the street]

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Jim's Drugs, later. He reopens for business and the crowd flocks to his store. Later, the small store is replaced by a larger two-story building, which in turn is replaced by a huge building reminiscent of the departed Wall-Mart, which in turn leads to Jim's Drugs' demise by fire.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: ...Oh Lord, Kumbaya.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: All right, let's not make that mistake again.

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
Line: Yeah, lets all shop over at True Value!

Title: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes

[shows a shot of him there] Do you see? This is me at Mount Rushmore [the next picture is shown, with him looking lovingly at the faces there] Do you see?

Line: [nervously] Heheh.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Do you see?!

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: [grabs his hat] Let's go! [other officers follow]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Hell's Pass Hospital, later. Dr. Doctor leads them into the recovery room.

Line: Doctor, could you remove his face warmer? We'd like to speak with him.

Line: I see... a man... with a baseball cap. [Sgt. Lou snaps his fingers and Det. Murphy whips out a notepad and pen and starts taking notes. Kyle concentrates] He's killing now... Oh! Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Good evening, sir. We're Park County detectives. We were just wondering if we could take a quick look around your house, Misterrr...

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: God.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Well, Mr. God, it won't take but a second; it might help us with an investigation. [he shows them in. The house is dark, with stacks of paper everywhere. Pictures of his victims line the walls. Downstairs, Cartman tries to get attention.]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: (Hey! Come over here!)

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: I see you like cutting the eyes out of photos of women. My son is a big fan of that, too.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Sir?

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Right.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Ohhh. [they return to the living room]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Nope, this isn't our man. [they turn to leave the house and see Michael Deets in the shadows] We're sorry, Mr. God. It appears we've wasted your time. [they head out]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: [in the basement] (Hey! Help!) [upstairs, Mr. Deets closes the front door]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Heh, pretty amazing coincidence that guy had a bunch of hands on his wall. Heh, no wonder that boy thought he was a killer.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: [stops and thinks] Yeah... Amazing coincidence...

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: [backs up] Heh- sir?

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Call it police intuition, but somethin' in there just didn't feel right. [thinks for several seconds] Wait a minute.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Sarge... [Lou slowly raises his hand palm in and analyzes it. Then he turns his hand over slowly until the palm is out and is jolted with recognition] What is it?

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: I'm not sure. I'm gonna have to run some tests. [runs off to do just that]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Park County Police Station, night. Montage. Yates types away at his computer, then analyzes his left hand again, then returns to the keyboard. He then goes to the lab and looks over his notes. Next to him are two hands, one right and one left. He rotates the right hand so both thumbs point to the left, from his POV, then takes more notes. He develops some pictures in the darkroom and finds matching hands. He works with a 3D model drawing with another computer, then traces his left hand on a wall and takes measurements. He returns to the lab and works with some chemicals. Next he chops some firewood into smaller chunks. Next he's at a gym jumping rope. Next he's at a beach far from South Park playing volleyball with some women. Next he's repairing the body of a car with a welding torch...

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: [back at the station, looks in on Murphy] Murphy, do you remember what I was supposed to be doing?

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Oh. Uhhh... Oh. Something about hands, sir? Uh, for the serial killer?

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: [snaps his fingers] Oh right! The hands! Right! [the montage resumes]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Again he goes to his computer and types away then he's back at the lab taking pictures of the two fake hands there, then makes silhouettes of a dog, then models another hand in the computer and gets a match.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Oh my God. Murphy! [Murphy appears quickly.] You're not gonna believe this.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Michael Deets house, basement. Michael Deets has resumed showing his pictures to Cartman. A picture of him at Ocean World's Splash Zone is shown, then a blank. He turns the projector off.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: That's it, no more pictures. [walks in front of Cartman and faces him, then pulls out a sharp knife] Time to die.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: No, please! I'm sorry I gave other people credit for your killings. Ahah, it was, it was very wrong for me to lie about the other psychics and get them arrested.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Your hand will be one with the others.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Please just let me go! Ah, I'm gonna tell everyone I'm not really psychic! I've learned my lesson! Please, I don't wanna- [spots the detectives descend the stairs and approach the room] I don't wanna have to use my psychic mind missile on you! [begins to concentrate and make noises]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Hold it right there, killer! [Michael Deets turns and rushes at them with the knife. Yates fires three shots into him, killing him. The detectives advance, and Yates fires a forth shot into the body, looks around, and fires a fifth shot, getting blood splattered on himself]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: You got here just in time. He was gonna kill me because he was insanely jealous of my incredible psychic ability.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Hell's Pass Hospital, day. The detectives, the psychics, Mr. Johansen, Dr. Docter, Cartman, Stan, and Kenny are present.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Well young man, you did an amazing thing. Not only did your psychic visions help us catch the killer, but a lot of innocent people are out of jail.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Yes, thank you very much, Kyle.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Yes, thanks.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: You're certainly a better psychic then Eric.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: No, don't you see? Cartman never had psychic visions. And neither do these people. The plain simple truth is that nobody is psychic. There's a logical explanation for every psychic story you've ever heard.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Do you think that's true?

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: It must be true. The kid is psychic. [thinks a moment] But I don't suppose it really matters much. Because in the end, the way I caught the killer was with... good old-fashioned police work. Come on, Murphy. [they leave the room and then the hospital]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: [addressing Cartman] Well young man, I guess that just leaves one score to settle.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: You can't hurt me.

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: Then let this be our final battle! [the psychics face Cartman once again and battle him with their power. Nothing happens, but there's a lot of noise.]

Title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
Line: [irritated] Just stop it! [at the top of his lungs] Stoop iiit!! [the lights go out as the bulbs shatter, then the shelf above his bed falls and everything on it hits the floor. The psychics and Cartman stop their battle and witness all this] There's a logical explanation for that.

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: A panoramic view of South Park, day. Holiday music is heard in the background, and the scenes are played out as the narrator mentions them.

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: Way up in the mountains in a small little town, The Main Street was being decorated all up and down. People stood in long lines, sometimes waiting hours or more, Because Christmas needs to be bought in a store. But out in the forest, not too far away...

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: A nearby forest. The camera pans down from the sky and rest upon a Christmas tree. Forest animals gather round and decorate it.

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: ...The little woodland critters were also preparing for their Christmas Day.

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: It's almost time when the time is here, The time that's only once a year. We can hardly wait, 'cause it's so near. A Woodland Critter Christmas!

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: The little critters worked hard as they happily sang, And each one of them had a quite interesting name. There was Squirrely the squirrel, Rabbity the rabbit, Beavery the beaver, and Beary the bear. Porcupiney the porcupine, Skunky the skunk, Foxy the fox, and Deery the deer. Woodpeckery the woodpecker, Mousey the mouse, and Chickadee-y the chickadee, all made the forest their house. And on that magical day, stumbling upon all of that, was a surprised little boy, in a red poofball hat.

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: [walks by with a sled] What the hell?

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: Christmastime is once a year Every critter holds it dear Every animal big or small Christmas means so much to us all

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: The forest. The critters approach Stan.

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: Well, hello there. Welcome to our forest.

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: How do you like our Christmas tree?

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: It's... nice.

Line: Oh no, I see a problem.

Line: What is it, Mousey?

Line: Awww.

Line: We can't have a tree with no star on it.

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: What are we gonna do?

Line: [among other things] Can you really? Oh would you please? Could you help us?

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: Okay, okay.

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: [cheering] Yay!

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: Ohhhh!

Line: Goo- goodbye Stanny!

Line: Goodbye, Stanny! Bye! Cya! I'll buy your hat!

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: Woof.

Line: Hi, Stanny!

Line: (Cheers)

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: [at a loss for words] I... the... critters. Their... bir-birth of a Savior? [The cubs snuggle close to their mom's body, sobbing.]

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas

Line: [feeling a kick] Oooo.

Line: Awwww.

Line: Yaaay!! [they head over to the manger]

Line: Wai-wait, the Antichrist?? You said she was giving birth to your savior!

Line: But I thought you meant the Son of God!

Line: Well, think about it: You really think God would have sex with a porcupine?

Line: No way! Only Satan, Prince of Darkness and King of all Evil would do that! Yay!

Line: The critters drench themselves in Rabbity's blood and begin the orgy. Beavery mounts Raccoony, Skunky mounts Porcupiney, Mousey mounts foxy, and Beary mounts Deery. Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: What special time and special day, It's Woodland Critter Christmas.

Line: [a circular window opens and he pops up] Hail Satan.

Line: In the gentle forest clearing on Christmas Eve morn, The little forest critters prepared for the Antichrist to be born. Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: Ugh.

Line: Now that he'd killed the noble lion queen, there was nobody to stop the Apocalypse, it seemed.

Title: Woodland Critter Christmas
Line: Uuugh!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Stan's house, living room. Stan sits at the coffee table steaming over the pairing of Wendy and Kyle. A cordless phone sits before him. He picks it up and dials it. It rings at a house, and Kyle goes over to answer it.

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Hello? Oh, hey, dude.

Title: Follow That Egg!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Oh, we're just makin' a cradle out of an egg carton for our egg. We figure that way it'll be easier to keep safe so we can get an A.

Title: Follow That Egg!

Title: Follow That Egg!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [crosses his arms, turns around and goes inside] Well, maybe I didn't want to have an egg with you, okay, Bebe?!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [follows him in] Well, whether you wanted to or not, doesn't really matter now! We're going to get graded together! It's your egg too! Own up to your responsibilities! [leaves the egg with him and walks out. Stan stands there with the egg for a few moments, then sits on the sofa and tosses the egg aside. Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: South Park, in front of the library. Mrs. Garrison is speaking to a large crowd gathered there.

Line: They passed this law behind our back! We need to tell the governor and the world that gay marriage is not okay! That homosexuals cannot muddy our traditions! And there is only one way for us, all together, to make that message very clear! We need to round up three or four queers and beat the livin' hell out of them! [Everyone else falls silent. She steps out from behind the podium and crouches a bit] Come on, everybody! Let's get some queers, and some trucks, and have us a good old-fashioned fag drag!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Well uh, we were thinkin' we would, you know, just go appeal to the Governor.

Title: Follow That Egg!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Yeah, we were just thinkin' o' goin' and askin' the Governor to veto the bill.

Title: Follow That Egg!

Line: [with emotion] Oh jeez, I knew this would happen. First the gay people come in here wanting equal rights, then this bill gets passed and now all the people against it want me to veto it. [slams his right fist on his desk]> Why do I have to make this decision?? />

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Because you're the governor?

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: I just wanted a big house and lots of respect. I didn't want this kind of responsibility. [rises form his desk and turns away, walking towards a window] I mean, I don't know anything about gay marriage. What argument can I use to deny them their right to a family?

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Well, think of the children! If you allow gays to get married, then you're also givin' them full rights as parents to adopt. You think kids can be raised by queers??

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: I can't use that argument. There's never been a study done which proves that either way.

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [gets an idea] But, if you had such a study, a scientific study which proved same-sex couples are incapable of raising a child...

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Then I would have something to fall back on. So-something to take all the pressure off of me.

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [confidently] Mr. Governor, I will get you that study.

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: South Park Elementary, day. The kids trickle into class. Bebe approaches Wendy, each one holding an egg.

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Hey Wendy, how's your egg doing?

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Oh great. It's a pretty easy project. Kyle's really good with the egg. [beams at Kyle. Stan looks on, miffed]

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Yeah. [gets angry] I wish I had a partner like Kyle! I went to go pick up the egg from Stan yesterday, and his dog had it in its mouth! Our egg isn't gonna last a week with Stan around!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [enters with four big books and drops them on her desk] Okay, students, change of plan! [walks over to the magnetic chalkboard] You've all been doing a great job taking care of your eggs, but now we're going to mix it up a little. Wendy and Kyle will no longer be together.

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [points at Kyle] HA!

Line: Let's see what happens when we put two same-sex couples together to take care of an egg, shall we?! Kyle, you are now with Stan! And Wendy is with Bebe! [Kyle and Wendy exchange glances]

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [ebullient] Hoh now, what makes you say that, Wendy? I'm sure two boys can handle an egg just fine... [goes towards the chalkboard, scheming] And if not, we'll certainly prove a point to that goddamned Governor, won't we?

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Who?

Title: Follow That Egg!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [consoles her a bit, but turns her away] Wendy, I just wanna get an A, okay? Let's not make this any more confusing than it already is. <>[Stan peeks out from the kitchen and sees Kyle's arm around Wendy]

Line: Don't let anything happen to it, please. [Stan gets upset and disappears back into the kitchen]

Title: Follow That Egg!

[taunts the egg directly] Two daddies! Two daddies! Come on, class, let's rip on the freak egg! Two daddies! Two daddies!

People in the gay community want the same rights as married couples, but dissenters don't want the word "marriage" corrupted. So how about we let gay people get married, but call it something else? [everyone listens quietly] You homosexuals will have all exactly the same rights as married couples, but instead of referring to you as "married," you can be... butt buddies. Title: Follow That Egg!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Okay, Stan, you've been an asshole to me all week! What is up?!

Stan notices this with some surprise, and the egg explodes in his hand. Some of it lands on his face and cap. Jakartha appears behind the bushes across the street and lowers his sniper rifle]

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Stan? Stan, I think we should talk.

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [softly crying, muffled] Dude, you should just go be with Wendy and be happy.

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Stan, I don't like Wendy. [Stan's raises his head and listens] All I cared about was getting an A in this stupid project!

Title: Follow That Egg!

Line: [walks back and puts his left hand on Kyle's shoulder] As a matter of fact,... I think it is the nicest hat I've ever known. [Kyle smiles and Stan pats him twice on the back] Come on! [they head out]

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: Governor's office, outside. The Governor is speaking.

Line: Today is a very big day in which I'm supposed to make a very big decision. As some of you know, my biggest issue with gay marriage regards child-rearing. And a new study has just been concluded which will give me the ability to take no personal responsibility in this decision.

Title: Follow That Egg!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: In conclusion, Governor, you can rest assured that-! [one last blast is especially deadly. The area fills with dark brown smoke. As the smoke clears, Stan and Kyle hobble towards the podium, tattered clothes and all]

Title: Follow That Egg!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [kneels to inspect the egg] This egg is fine. [rises and steps forth] Gays can get married! [everyone cheers and gay couples hug each other in celebration.]

Title: Follow That Egg!

Title: Follow That Egg!

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: I now pronounce you man... and man. [both men, Al and Slave, are wearing wedding dresses. They turn to face each other and kiss on the lips. Everyone present cheers, and Mr. Slave and Al run down the aisle to their new life together. Stan and Kyle appear as the crowd disperses]

Title: Follow That Egg!
Line: [walks up and kneels next to Stan] Boys, I'm really proud of you. You've done an amazing thing for marriage rights. [rises and walks away. Wendy walks up]

Title: Follow That Egg!

Line: Stan, I'm sorry I doubted you. You really made a great dad.
