Title: Bloody Mary
Line: As most of you know I once lost my job and my family because of my drinking. But with the help of AA I've been sober for ten years now. [the group claps] Anyone have anything they wanna tell the groups, for starters?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [stands up] My name's Bill, and Im an alcoholic.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Hi Bill.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [subdued] Hi Bill.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I've been using the 12-step program for about two months now and, and I'm really turning my life around. No more blowing guys on Colfax Avenue for a pint of vodka for THIS cowboy! [the group claps. Bill sits down]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: That's great. And I understand this is somebody's first AA meeting, is that right? [Randy points to himself]</> Y-yes, you sir. Stand on up and introduce yourself.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [rises] Um, my name's Randy, and... I just, really like beer.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: You have to admit you're an alcoholic.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [slowly] But, I don't know if I'm really an alcoholic.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Then why are you here?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Because I got a DUI and so I'm required to attend AA meetings for two weeks. I was stupid one night and drank too much and then drove a car. That was dumb and I'm not gonna do it again.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Randy, you are powerless to make that decision. The only thing that works is the 12-step program. [points out the 12 steps] Step 1 is admitting that you are powerless to control your drinking. Only then can you move on to the other 12 steps, like, believing that only a higher power, God, makes you stop drinking. And then, turning your life over to that God and, humbly asking God to remove your weaknesses.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: What wait wait, hold on. I never knew that Alcoholics Anonymous was a religious thing.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Well it's not religious. You just have to admit that there is some kind of god which has power over you and turn your life over to that god and ask him for forgiveness. That's the 12-step program, not religion.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Look, I, I really just need to cut down on my drinking and never drive the car drunk again.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [approaches Randy] You just can't cut down on your drinking, Randy. You need to know something. You have a disease.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Uh... a disease?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: That's right. Alcoholism is a disease. You're sick, Randy. You're very very sick. And just like with most diseases, you can't cure it yourself. And it's deadly.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [appalled by the "diagnosis"] Oh my God...

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Stan's house, later. Stan arrives and enters. As he hears the sofa, he sees his father wrapped in a blanket and bottles of beer on the coffee table before him. Another bottle is next to him on the couch. He's sipping more beer.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Dad! What the hell are you doing?!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [quivering] Hello, Stan.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Dad, it's the middle of the day! I thought you weren't going to drink as much anymore!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: No, Stan, you don't understand. I have a disease. Daddy's very sick.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: What?? Did you go to your AA meeting?!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Yes, they're the ones that told me. I thought I could just quite drinking on my own, but... it's an illness, son. I have to admit that I'm powerless to this terrible disease. [coughs, drinks, and burps.]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Dad, you've had enough! Just stop now!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I can't! I'm sick! [begins to cry and walks off in his blanket. He goes to the bathroom and closes the door, then goes to the vanity and looks in the mirror] It's not fair! Why did you give me this disease?! [coughs as he cries, then takes some shears to his hair and shaves it off. Stan is about to pour milk into a glass downstairs] Stan! Stan! [Stan stops and sets the carton of milk down, then walks into the living room, where Randy is now seated in a wheelchair.] Stan.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Aww, Goddammit!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Stan I... need your help.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Dad, what are you doing in Grandpa's extra wheelchair?!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Gotta try to take it easy from now on, son. Get Daddy another beer, will ya?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: No! You don't need another beer!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [turns away and rolls off] I know that! But this disease is just eating me up! I hate my illness!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Dad, you just need to not drink so much. It's very simple.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I wish it was that simple, son. But if I don't give myself up to a higher power, this disease is going to kill me dead. I'm afraid the only thing that will cure me... is a miracle.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: the nighttime sky. The camera pans down from the big, bright moon to a church with a grotto in front with a statue of the Virgin Mary with halo looking down benevolently. Somewhere on the statue a red dot appears. The dot grows into a patch and begins to bleed down the gown. The parish priest is walking away from the church when he notices the bleeding. He turns to get a better look, smears some of the liquid onto his finger, and analyzes it.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [softly] Es un milagro. [loudly] Es un milagro! [immediately gets on his knees and crosses himself, then holds the bloodied finger upright]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: A news report in front of the church, day. A crowd begins to gather at the grotto.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Tom, I'm standing in the garden of St. Peter's church in Bailey, where what some call a miracle is taking place. The statue of the Virgin Mary has started to bleed. Out its ass. [an establishing shot of the statue] The phenomenon was first seen by Father Harold Barnes, [standing with the Spanish-speaking priest in front of the statue's backside] who saw the blood coming from the Virgin Mary's ass late last night. [back to the reporter] People from all over the state have flocked here to the church to witness the apparent miracle firsthand.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Well, we just heard that this miracle was happening and we wanted to see it for ourselves and come and pray.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Why do you believe the Virgin Mary is dripping blood?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Well it may represent her sorrow over all the bad things going on in the world.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Why do you believe the Virgin Mary is dripping blood out her ass? [both women stay silent] As news of the miracle spreads, hundreds are expected to show up here at the church, hoping to witness the miracle, and even cure their diseases.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: The Marsh living room. Randy's watching the screen.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Cure... cure disease. STAN!!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: The next AA meeting.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: My name is Harry and I'm an alcoholic.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Hi Harry.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I've been sober now for five years and I I've learned that drinking ice tea and, and getting more involved with my relationship with God is, is, is way more fun than partying.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: It it sure is.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Once I accepted that I was powerless to control my drinking and my life, I I put it in God's hands and now, these meeting are the most fun thing I do.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Yeah. [Stan enters the meeting room and walks up towards the front]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Ah, excuse me, who's in charge here?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: None of us are in charge. We're all powerless.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: We sure are. That's right. Uh huh.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Uh, look, my dad was here yesterday and ...you all kind of messed him up by telling him he had a disease?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Alcoholism is a disease.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: No it, it's not. And, y-you can't just go around saying stuff like that to people like my dad. He He's kind of, a hypochondriac

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: It is a disease because it's a physical dependency. That makes it a disease.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: No, cancer is a disease. My dad needs to drink less.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: He can't quit by himself. None of us could. He needs divine intervention. Spirituality.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: No, he just needs a disciprine. But thanks to you people, my dad now thinks he has a disease that he can't cure himself.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Young man, do you know anything about the 12-Step Program?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Yeah, and I also know a thing or two about cults. I was the leader of one for a while. [he is promptly kicked out] Goddammit! [walks off]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Another news report.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: The crowd grows larger every hour, as the statue of the Virgin Mary continues to miraculously cry blood... out her ass. A Cardinal, Mallory, has been sent by the Vatican to determine whether this is a true miracle or not. [the cardinal and two assistants walk into the grotto]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [showing the Cardinal where to go.] Right this way, Cardinal. [the cardinal, priests, and assistants go behind the statue] The blood always comes from the same area. Sometimes a little, sometimes a lot. [the Cardinal walks into position and begins to take a good look. He puts on his glasses and looks again. He looks even closer, and a stream of blood shoots at his eyes. His face and bust are full of blood as he moves from the back of the statue to the front. He wipes gobs of blood from his glasses and mouth and tosses them to the floor]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [Irish accent] It's a miracle! [the waiting crowd cheers]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: The street. Stan is still pissed off from his expulsion from the AA meeting, but he notices his father grunting. Randy is next to the car, still in the wheelchair. He opens the car door and climbs in.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [burps] Uh, kay, here we go. [gets into position]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [rushes up] Dad?! Dad, what are you doing?!

Line: I gotta drive to Bailey. [chugs another beer]

Line: Dad, you're drunk! You're not driving a car!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [stays quiet, then] What??

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: They say her divine ass blood has miraculous healing power. She can cure my alcoholism! I'll be back soon!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Dad, you can't drive! Your license is suspended, remember?! If you get pulled over again, you're gonna go to jail for ten years!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [thinks] Alright... then you drive. [points to Stan]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: ... I'm eight!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [makes a fist with his right hand] This is my only hope, Stan! Either you drive this car or I will!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: On the road. Randy sits in the passenger side chugging more beer.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I sure hope this works. No. No, it will work! I have to put my faith in a higher power. I HAVE to believe that this will work! [looks off to his left] There! There's the church! Stop right here, Stan!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Where? I can't see.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Right here is good! Brake pedal! Left pedal! [Stan manages to pull into a spot] Alright, get my wheelchair out of the back. [takes another chug of beer]

Title: Bloody Mary

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Is this the line? [Stan's eyes open wide. Before them is a long line leading up to the grotto] Oh God! [gets in line] Is this whole line people waiting to be cured?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Yeah. I was diagnosed with brain cancer two months ago. I feel like this is my only hope.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I know exactly how you feel. I've got alcoholism.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [covers his eyes] Oh my God...

Title: Bloody Mary

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Dad, let's just wait our turn.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I could die waiting in this line, Stan. Come on, let's go! [Stan wheels him up to Josh.] Heeey heh, Josh Garrett. How you doin'?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Oh, hey Randy. What happened to you??

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I've got a disease: Alcoholism. It's pretty serious. You?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I just, my dad was-

Line: [walks around the old woman] You're a butter! You're a dirty line cutter! [the statue is shown, and another elderly lady walks up to it. Father Barnes takes some blood from the statue's ass and forms a cross with it on the woman's forehead]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Praise Jesus. [walks away smiling. The crowd moves up on. Randy didn't return to the back of the line.]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: This is taking too long! I'm gonna run out of beer! Stan!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: What?!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [in hushed tones] You see that guy up there? I think he has a kidney disease. Every couple of minutes he gets out of line to go to the bathroom. When he leaves next, let's take his place.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: No, Dad, people will see!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: The guy behind him is blind! There he goes! C'mon! C'mon! Go go go! [the line advances and Stan and Randy quickly move in and fill the space]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Hey. I smell a butter.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: He did, that kid just cut in line!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Back o'the line, butter!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I'm going to die!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [gets into position to move the wheelchair to the back of the line] Dad, we're going back!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: What's goin' on here?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: This kid's cutting in line!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Please, officer, you have to understand. I need a miracle way more than these people. I'm an alcoholic, and I'm powerless over it.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: ...I understand. My, my brother's an alcoholic. Here, let me push you to the front of the line. [Stan looks on a bit stunned]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Oh bless you, sir! Bless you! [the line parts as the officer moves him] 'Scuse me, out of the way, alcoholic coming through! [the officer moves him into position. Randy wheels himself closer] She's... beautiful. [the statue squirts a long stream of blood on him and he rejoices in it] Aaaah. AAAAAaaaaah! [opens his eyes, and the statue quickly squirts him one more time. He then wheels himself into view and struggles to get up from the wheelchair. He still has a bottle with him] I'm... not... going... to drink this. I'm not going to drink this! [throws the bottle off somewhere] It's a miracle! I'm cured! [begins to dance away. Stan is embarrassed and stewing] Yoohoohoo! Praise Jesus! Praise Mary the Blessed Virgin Mother! Thank you! Thank you God! [runs off]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: The Marsh house, morning at the breakfast table. Shelly is drinking some milk, Stan is reading a comic book, Sharon is making breakfast.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Good morning, family. The Lord has truly blessed us with another beautiful day. [reaches over and kisses Sharon, then goes to his seat at table] It's just amazing. I haven't had a drink in five days. Praise Christ. Praise him. [looks at his kids]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Praise Christ.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Praise Christ.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: I've got another AA meeting today and guess where it's gonna be, Stan. At Whistlin' Willy's Pizza, so you can come with me.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Naw, Dad, all the guys are going to Kyle's hosue to watch the Bronco game. Kenny and Kyle's Dads were hoping you'd come.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Stan, those people drink. I have new friends now. My AA friends, who have faith in a higher power.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Whistlin' Willy's Pizza Gulch, later.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Yeah, all right, woohoo! [Randy and Stan sit among Randy's new friends and their kids.]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Boy this lemonade is great! Who knew how fun being sober could be?!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Yeah! That's right! Right!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Your dad doesn't drink either?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: No, my dad doesn't drink.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Does that mean we're friends? [Stan just looks over at him]

Line: 'Scuse me, I-I'd like to address the group if I may.

Title: Bloody Mary

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [rises] I'm Randy and I'm an alcoholic.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Hi Randy.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: But I put my faith in a higher power and... I haven't had a drink for five days now! [the group cheers him on, but behind him another news report pops up]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: News Report from St. Peter's Church in Bailey.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: An update from the bleeding Virgin Mary statue!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [turns around and reacts] Oh wait. Sh sh. Hold on a second, gang. [the group queits down]

Title: Bloody Mary

People left and right kneel before him in reverence] It was an amazing sight to behold as Pope Benedict made his way through the throngs of people.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Right this way, Your Holiness.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: The pope then examined the statue closely. [the pope draw closer... closer... blinks, gets closer... looks at the camera and raises his eyebrows quickly twice, turns back and gets closer, gets a stream of blood on his face, about as much as Randy got] After witnessing the phenomenon firsthand, the pope then cleaned himself off and then declared that the bleeding Virgin Mary statue is not a miracle!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: What?

And the pope said quote, "A chick bleeding out her vagina is no miracle. Chicks bleed out their vagina's all the time." [a graphic with those words appears on screen, along with an image of the pope and his name, Pope Benedict XVI] Back to you, Tom.

Line: Thanks, Edward, that's a very shocking report...

Line: Randy, uh what are you doing?

Line: I'm, I'm, I'm powerless too!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Yeah me too!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Get me seven martinis!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Jack and Coke!

Title: Bloody Mary

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Dad, Dad, Stop!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: [turns around, dropping an empty bottle] I'm sorry, son! I'm off the wagon!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Dad, you don't have to do this! You have the power. You haven't drank since seeing the statue.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: But the statue wasn't a miracle!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Yeah. The statue wasn't a miracle, Dad. So that means you did it. That means you didn't have a drink for five days all on your own.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: You're right, Stan. If God didn't make me stop drinking then... I did. Maybe... Maybe I can force myself to never drink again. [throws off all his drinks, and they shatter on the pavement.]

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: No!

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: No??

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: Dad, you like to drink. So have a drink once in a while. Have two. If you devote your whole life to completely avoiding something you like, then that thing still controls your life and, 'n you've never learned any discipline at all.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: But, maybe... I'm just the kind of person who needs to have it all or nothing.

Line: Naw. All or nothing is easy. But learning to drink a little bit, responsibly, that'sa disciprine. Disciprine... come from within. [Randy looks at Stan for a moment, then walks up to his side and kneels next to him.]

Line: Thanks son.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: All right!

Line: I think you're pushing it.

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: How about twenty?

Title: Bloody Mary
Line: That's not disciprine.

Line: Right right. Does vodka count?

Line: Dad!

Title: Go God Go XII

Then, a collage of Eric hiding in the freezer, talking to Butters, and walking to the designated spot with him. Then, scenes of the avalanche and Eric getting frozen. Then the years begin to roll, and scenes of humanity's future appear. They are: the scene of the avalanche, a scene of devastation, the room where Cartman is taken to be thawed, his meeting with the high UAL command, the UAL building being attacked, a shot of Earth from space, the UAA storming in to fight the UAL, the battle between the two factions, the UAA closing in on Cartman, the voyage away from the UAL building, across a desert; the onscreen communication with the AAA, a shot of Earth's future, a sea otter blowing into the nafferty, and the final shot of two ships leading the camera to the city the UAL is based at

Title: Go God Go XII

Title: Lice Capades
Line: If we have made too much of an impact, then that consciousness would try to snuff us out! I think we're looking at a global catastrophe, the likes of which we've never seen!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Poodiggery and poppycock!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I think we need to put all resources now into a full investigation, perhaps even begin a licewide evacuation.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Evacuation?! Tomorrow is the Gootack Festival. Do you know how much money we would lose? Escort Mr. Mayfield out. The President can't be bothered any further.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [as security escorts him away] Damn you Vice President Craig! You could be killin' us all!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: A waiting room. Clyde and his mom sit with a man reading a magazine, and a girl with her mother. Clyde looks around

Title: Lice Capades
Line: This is so... embarrassing.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I have an ear infection. What are you seeing the doctor for?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I have... I have AIDS. [his mother looks at him, astonished]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde Harris? [Clyde goes in to see the doctor.]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [writing out a prescription] Yeeaahh, that's a pretty bad lice problem there. Good thing they pulled you out of school.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [desperate] But why me, doctor? Why me?! How did I get this?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [walks up to Clyde] Well, believe it or not, some lice can actually attach themselves to flies, and then wait for the fly to land on someone's head where they can reproduce. And then the lice that live in your head now were probably all born there.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: ...Sick!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: This shampoo should take care of it. [hands him a bottle] Use this in the shower. Your scalp may burn a bit afterwards, but... it should kill... every last one of them.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's scalp. The lice go about their business, climbing up and down the hairs. Travis takes a break on a hair stump.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Travis? Everything okay?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Kelly, I was just thinkin' about our baby. I want to name her... Hope.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Hope?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Hope for a... chance at tomorrow? [water begins to drop down from on high]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: It's raining? Now? [Other lice stop and notice. Turns out Clyde is taking a shower.]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's shower. He rinses himself off and then picks up the shampoo he was given: RID-X. KILLS INSTANTLY LICE & THEIR EGGS.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's scalp. The rain continues and the lice get used to it.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [starts dancing] Woohoo! I love the rain! [other lice join in the play. Travis doesn't have a good feeling about this]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Oh my God. [runs to Kelly and their egg] We have to get out of here!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What it, it's just rain.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: We have to get out of here now, Kelly! [grabs the egg and runs off with Kelly. Other lice continue dancing in the rain while still others watch. One or two look around and notice a green liquid spreading over the scalp.]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What is that? [walks up to the leading edge, reaches down and grabs a gob of it. The liquid quickly eats through his pincer and he screams in pain. The leading edge of the liquid moves past him and leaves him trapped in the liquid, which eats at him some more]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Whoa! [the liquid finally finishes him off. The other lice see the leading edge of the liquid get closer to them, and they run] Ruuun! [some of them get overtaken by the liquid, which is now moving quickly over the scalp. The camera follows them until it finds Travis]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Everyone get up into the trees! We have to get up high! Come on, Kelly! [the lice that can, climb up the hairs while the others get swept up by the RID-X and killed]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: My God, Travis, they're all dying!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Don't look, Kelly! Don't look!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What the hell is it?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Well it's okay, we're safe up here! [the hairs begin to sway back and forth as a strong wind begins to blow]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I don't think so! [lice begin to be pushed off the hairs]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [blown away] OoOhOOOoooh!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's bathroom. He's standing on a stool before the mirror blowing his hair dry.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's scalp. The wind keeps blowing lice off hair. Travis hangs on tight to the hair and to Kelly.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Travis!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Kelly! Hang on!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I can't... hang on!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: You have to! For the baby! [Kelly's grip loosens. She tightens it, but the wind rips her from the pincer she was holding on with]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Nooooooooooo!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Kellllllyyyyy! No! Noooo! [he's left alone on the hair with the egg, Hope]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's bathroom. He's done drying his hair and sets the hair dryer aside, steps off the stool, turns off the light, and leaves.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: South Park Elementary, day, Mrs. Garrison's class. She's just come in with her books.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Okay, kids, today we're going to review some Civil War history. Who can tell me what year the war started?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Waiwaiwait, whoa whoa, so what happened?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: With what?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: With the lice exam. Did they find anybody with lice? [Clyde looks apprehensive, and Mrs. Garrison notices]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Y-yes, some lice was discovered and the proper action has been taken.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Somebody in this class?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Uh, yes.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Ohhhhh.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Well who was it? [points to Kenny] It was Kenny, right?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: That doesn't matter, it's over.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Doesn't matter?! If somebody had parasites in their hair, we need to know who! [points to Kenny again] It was Kenny, wasn't it?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I wanna know who it was, too.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: It's being kept confidential! There's a policy in the schools not to single out a kid who has lice, because of the embarrassment it can cause, okay?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [pounds on his desk] That is bullcrap! You are denying our rights as children to totally rip on that kid and make him or her feel like an outcast!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: And we have a right to know which boy had lice in his hair so we don't ever go out with them!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: How do we know it was a boy? It could just have easily been one of you stupid girls!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah! Dumb girls!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: The case is closed! Whoever had the lice, they're dead now! We're moving on to Civil War history. [the camera zooms in on Clyde again] Ulysses S. Grant-

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's scalp, the aftermath. Travis is asleep on the scalp, battered and bruised from the wind. He coughs himself awake and finds the egg with him, intact

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Hope. Hope, you're alive. [he stands up to his full height and surveys the destruction all around him] My God... [a decomposed louse stands up and collapses on him] Heh?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Help me... Help meeee... [it falls away and dies]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Travis. [Travis looks to his right] Over here! Travis, if you hadn't warned us to get up in them trees, we'd all be dead.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: How many survivors?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Just the six of us. And the Vice President.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [notices and throws the Vice President up against a hair] You son of a bitch! You had a chance to stop this! So help me, if we live through this, I'm gonna see you rot in prison!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What do we do now?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [turns and faces the others] We aren't out of this yet! You two look for other survivors. You get whatever food you can and bring it back here. [the lice do as commanded]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [the older louse] Who put you in charge?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [turns around] God did! When he killed my wife! [turns back and walks away]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: South Park Elementary, day, hallway. The fourth graders leave the classroom.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: All right, the person who had head lice needs to speak up right now, so that we know to stay away from you! [Opposite Cartman are Jimmy, Tweek, Clyde, Anne, Bebe, Red. and two other kids. With Cartman are Craig, Token, Stan, Kyle, Kenny, Kevin, Butters, and Wendy]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah, come on! We're gonna find out sooner or later.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Okay, whoever you are, you are now not only a licehead, you're a liar! You're only making this worse on yourself!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: You know what? I'll bet it was you!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Me?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: This is exactly what you would do if they found lice in your hair! Try to lead the charge against somebody else to take the suspicion off of yourself!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I don't think so, Kyle! But you know what?! This is exactly what you would do if you had had head lice! Try to get everyone to blame me!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: You guys stop it! This isn't getting us anywhere!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: That's exactly what you would do if you had had head lice, Stan. [Stan is stunned]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah, try to have everyone make peace so it doesn't seem like a big deal.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: And this is exactly what Kenny would do: stand here and say nothing! [Kenny makes an angry face]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [sensing where this is going] Heh hey guys, what would I do?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Let's just get a magnifying glass and look at everyone's heads.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: It's too late. The treatment would have killed it all.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Well I guess we're never gonna know. There's no way to tell.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: There's a way! There's a way to find out who had sick-ass head cooties! And I'm gonna find it! [turns left and walks away. Clyde looks around]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: It was him. It had to have been him!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah... Or you. [they check out each other]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's scalp. More survivors are brought to the clearing

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Mark? Mark, you have to hang on.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: This isn't going to stop. The world is rejecting us! If we're gonna live, we have to get off this planet.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: How?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: First we have to get out of the forest, into the forbidden zone. It's the only way we might even see another planet!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: The forbidden zone... We'll be exposed. We'll die out there.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: We'll die here! Look, the world is getting rid of us! Don't you get it?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Getting rid of us? You-you mean like it knows what it's doing?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yes! Because maybe we rolled the dice too many times!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I'm not leaving my husband.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah huh-I'll take my chances here.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: You can all stay here; I'm gonna try to save my baby. [turns around and walks away]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [redhead, runs up to him] I'll go with you. There's nothing left for me here.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I wanna go too.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Not a chance.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Look, I know I messed up, all right? But I think you're right. If we can get out of the forest, we might find another place to live.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: If we find anything, we'll try to send help for the rest of you. [to the redhead and the Vice President] Let's go. [the redhead moves] Come on if you're comin' Mister Vice President! [turns left and follows the redhead]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [tarries] Yeah. Right behind you. [pulls out a gun and cocks it]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: A storage room somewhere in school. Cartman is wearing a detective coat as other fourth grade boys enter the room

Title: Lice Capades
Line: All right, lock that door, Craig! [Craig goes to lock the door]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What's this about, Cartman? [the boys are now seated on a bench against a wall]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I've come up with a test that can determine if it was any of us who had the head lice. [whips out a little propane torch from his right pocket] We're gonna find out once and for all who had head cooties. [whips out a lighter from his left pocket, strikes the lighter on, and uses the lighter to light the torch. He puts the lighter away. Clyde is scared now.] Lice feed on a person's blood, and just like mosquitoes they leave small traces of their saliva in the host's bloodstream. That saliva, is monochromagnic. So if an infected person's blood is touched by... this hot metal coil, say... that person's blood will jump 10 meters into the air.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Ur ur re- ur really?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: That's retarded! You didn't come up with that experiment, Cartman, you saw it in that movie, The Thing!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [figuring out how to respond] This is a scientific test, designed to-

Title: Lice Capades
Line: You saw it in The Thing and you're wasting everyone's time!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I thought you might say that, Kyle. Because you don't want to take the test, do you?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Nobody's blood is going to jump up in the air!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: If it isn't going to work, then what are you afraid of? The only person who wouldn't want to take the test is somebody who was worried it might work and reveal that they were the ones with lice!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah. That's true.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I have no problem taking the test. I have nothing to hi-huhiii-hide

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah. Me neither.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: All right, fine. I'll do the dumb test.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Everyone take a Petri dish and a syringe. We need at least 30 cc's of blood from each one of you.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: The storage room, moments later. The boys have all given their 30 cc's in the labeled Petri dishes.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: All right, now everyone back over there! [the boys head back to the bench] We'll start with what I already know. [moves the heated coil tip over the blood sample. Only steam comes from it]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Well, guess that proves Eric wasn't the one with head lice.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: It doesn't prove anything!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah? Let's just see what your blood does, Kyle! [takes Kyle's Petri dish and ...the same thing happens] Huh, I guess you're clean. [tries another Petri dish]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Ye-you guys, we'd better go. Recess is almost over.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: It's all right, it won't take much longer, just-AHH AHHGH! [sticks the tip into the Petri dish, causing the blood to heat up and jump out of the dish. He gets the blood all over himself, and for good measure, tosses the rest of the blood onto himself.]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What the hell?! [Clyde is scared shitless. Cartman turns the dish around to reveal the name: Kenny]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Kenny!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: No way.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: You were right all along, Eric. It was Kenny.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Of course I was right! I told you only poor people get lice! [silence for a second or two, then Kenny bolts for the door, pushing Craig aside, opening the door, and running down the hall]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's scalp. The survivors have made it to the hairline.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: We've done it. We've reached the forbidden zone. [a vast space of... nothing, like a desert] I've always heard stories about this place. Never thought it was real.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: It's real. Real as my love for my unborn baby.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: So what exactly is your plan, Travis?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Our ancestors came here from another world. Maybe there's still other worlds out there with life forms like us. Maybe there's even a world where they've learned to live with the planet instead of just on it.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Travis. Travis, you're, so wise, so strong. If we make it out of this, I'd like to... be with you.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Sorry, babe, but my heart is forever stenciled in permanent ink with the name [closes his eyes] Kelly.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: She was a lucky woman to have you.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Luck had nothin' to do with it. [a gunshot from behind kills the redhead, who wobbles forward, then back and to the ground. The Vice President keeps his gun trained on her corpse]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [aims his gun at Travis] Sorry to cut the honeymoon short!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Why you murdering bastard!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Your little fantasy of another world ends here! Walk!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What the hell do you want, Vice President?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Walk! [Travis turns and walks, and the Vice President follows him, keeping the gun trained on him.]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's house, day. The doorbell rings and Clyde goes to answer it. Cartman, Craig, and a few others - Token and Jimmy - are outside with socks and bars of soap.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde, dude, get down to the park. We caught Kenny, and we're all gonna let him have it! [points to the sock in his right hand]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What? What are you gonna do to him?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: He lied to us all! He betrayed his kind! We all know what has to happen. [beat] Grab a sock and a bar of soap, and meet us at the park! [they turn and head off]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [his eyes wander as he thinks] You guys, wait. [the guys turn around]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What, Clyde?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I... nothing.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: All right, see you there! [the guys turn around and leave] Remember, bar of soap and a sock! Kenny's gonna get it!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yeah! We're gonna fu-fu-fuck him up! [Clyde sees them leave, then backs up, scared]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Mrs. Garrison's house, day. Mrs. Garrison seems to be preparing an omelet for herself, adding garlic salt and putting it aside. The phone rings and she picks up.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Yello?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Mrs. Garrison, one of your students is about to be attacked at the park by all the other students.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What? Who's going to get attacked? Who is this?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Please just hurry to the park! You have to stop them!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's scalp, the hairline. The Vice President and Travis are still walking

Title: Lice Capades
Line: That's good! That's far enough! [Travis stops and turns]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What are you going to do?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I'm gonna go back to the village, start to rebuild, mate with the females, become... President!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Don't you get it? The world doesn't want you here! It's not gonna stop until you're dead!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: It was a disaster! Disasters happen!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Then go ahead and die there, I'm leavin' with my baby!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Actually, you're never leaving here either, Travis! [shoots out the knees of Travis's hind legs]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Damn you! Why?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Because when I'm President, I can't have pests like you constantly trying to preach that the world is alive! You're an idealistic fool! The world is not "conscious," we are conscious! If the world was alive, it would feel this! [plugs six bullets into Clyde's scalp]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's neighborhood, day. He's walking towards the park.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [feeling the little stings] Ow. [reaches back to the base of his skull]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's scalp, the hairline. The Vice President is about to finish Travis off

Title: Lice Capades
Line: You die he- [looks up. Two fingers reach down and grab him. He screams like he's never screamed before as Travis watches the fingers take him away.]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's neighborhood, day. Clyde glances at the louse and tosses it away. The Vice President screams to his death on the sidewalk below.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's scalp, the hairline. Travis tries to stand up, but ends up flat on his back. He can no longer move, so he just cries.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: The neighborhood park. The boys have gathered on the basketball court to let Kenny have it.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Kenny McCormick, you are charged with bringing head cooties into our school, and lying about it to cover your ass! How do you plead?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [restrained by Kevin and Bradley] (Not guilty!)

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Guilty! I thought so! [the boys pull down his hood and coat, and his shirt]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: All right, let's do this!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: You guys, maybe we should just... wait a few more minutes?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: All right, Kenny. You know what has to happen! Sock bath! Everyone wash Kenny with the soap and dry him off with the socks! [the boys gang up on Kenny and give him the sock bath]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Nohoho! No, not the socks! Ahhhgh, stop!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Wait, wait!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Wait... stop it, stop it! [he walks away; the others stop and look at him] I can't let Kenny be sock-dried.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: He had cooties and he lied about it!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [looks over his left shoulder] Kenny didn't have the head lice, all right?! [looks away] It was me.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: What?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I was the one. I was too afraid to say anything, but I can't let Kenny be sock-bathed for it.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Why are you saying that, Kyle? You can't be the one who had head lice. [walks up to him] Because I was. You're just trying to make me feel bad because you figured that out, didn't you?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Wait a-wait a minute, what?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Oh I get it. [walks up to Stan and Kyle] This is some kind of big trick on me! You've known I was the one with head lice all along, huh?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: You had head lice?

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Of course! Why do you think I went through that elaborate bullcrap experiment to frame Kenny?!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: [offscreen] You all had head lice! [the boys look up and off to the left. Mrs. Garrison walks up to them on the court] Every single person in the class! The boys aaand the girls! Lice spreads fast, you dumb-asses!

Title: Lice Capades
Line: I thought I was the only one.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Me too.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: But that means... that means Kenny was lying! Sock bath! [the other boys join in the chant "Sock bath!" and gang up on Kenny once again]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Clyde's hair. With the redhead and the Vice President gone, Travis is left alone with his thoughts.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Kelly. Kelly, can you hear mih? I don't know if you can. But... I wanted you to know I tried. I tried to save our baby. But I let you down, babe. [blinks. A light shines on him and a vision of Kelly descends. Travis holds his left hand up as a visor to make sure he's not hallucinating] Keh... k-Kelly? [Kelly's apparition disappears, replaced by a fly. Travis climbs on to one of the fly's legs, and the fly takes off. After a long while, the fly alights on a new host and Travis drops to the ground, asleep. Members of a darker, buffer species of louse watch from the shadows. They prop him up and carry him away]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: You are welcome here. [the colony here is well-developed, with entrances to dwellings going up several stories, making the hairs act as high-rise apartments. The residents there wave as he passes by] You're safe now. We've lived here for generation after generation, never being disturbed.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Heh. We made it, Hope. We made it, Kelly! [at this point the camera pulls back, out of the hair, and out of the space between a pair of female legs. The camera pulls back enough to show an actress exiting her limousine.]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: An actress with big lips is seen coming out of a limousine, with photographers ready to take pictures of her.

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Ladies and gentlemen, Miss Angelina Jolie! [photographers start snapping away with their cameras]

Title: Lice Capades
Line: Hello, everyone! [scratches her groin through her dress] Hello!

Title: The Snuke
Line: South Park Elementary, morning. The school bell rings and the kids rush in to sit down. Mrs. Garrison enters the classroom.

Title: The Snuke
Line: All right, students, let's take our seats. Everyone try to be nice because we have a new student joining us today, and I know you'll all make him feel welcome. Say hello to... Baahir Hassan Abdul Hakeem.

Title: The Snuke
Line: Uh oh! [Kyle's seat is empty, and he fears the worst]

Title: The Snuke
Line: Welcome to our class, Baahir.

Title: The Snuke
Line: Thank you.

Title: The Snuke
Line: Duhude, dude, [throws out his arms, palms out] not cool!

Title: The Snuke
Line: Why don't you take a seat in Kyle's empty desk for now?

Title: The Snuke
Line: Okay. [goes to Kyle's seat. Cartman begins crawling out of his, away from Baahir]

Title: The Snuke
Line: Oooh hooohoho. Nooo, noohoohoo.

Title: The Snuke
Line: [stopping him. What follows is in hushed tones] Eric, what the hell is wrong with you?!

Title: The Snuke
Line: What's wrong? [looks at Baahir, who's looking back at him, then looks back at Mrs. Garrison and takes her aside] Has he been checked for bombs?

Title: The Snuke
Line: Eric, that's enough! Not all Muslim people are terrorists!

Title: The Snuke
Line: No, but most of them are. And all it takes is most of them.

Title: The Snuke

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [runs into the lab and hides behind the wall] Oh my God, oh my God! [runs up to Stan] Stan! Stan, we have a big problem.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Dude, what?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: There's vampires in the school!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: What?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Vampires. I've seen 'em.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Dude, aw! Who's using the flak jacket cheat?!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Not a cheat if you rank up.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Ugh. [goes over to Kenny] Kenny, there's a vampire on the loose. Then Katie Gelson was hanging out with him, and now she's a vampire too!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Butters, there's no such thing as vampires.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [goes over to Kyle] But there is. You guys gotta believe me. First there was just a couple, but now it's like they're growing. They have fangs and drink blood and everything.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: All right Butters, well you go document the vampires' movements so we know what their intentions are.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Really? Do you think that's best?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yeah, now get out of here.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: All right! [runs to the entrance, then turns around] If I don't make it back, tell my mom what happened to me. [turns back and runs out]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Oh-hohhh, you got pwned, Bebe, you Jap bitch!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: The school gym, day. Six kids sit on the bleachers in the otherwise empty building - four boys, two girls. They look somewhat like the Goth kids.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Isn't this cool? This time of day nobody's in the gym. We should make this one of our official South Park Vampires Club hangouts.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: That's an awesome new coat, Mike. Looks totally badass.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Don't call me Mike, my name is Vampir now.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Oh, that's cool.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [wears a coat showing arm bones] I'm gonna change my name to Vladimir.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You can't, it's too close to Vampir. [Butters rises up from one end of the bleachers just enough to see the vampire kids]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [pulls out a tiny tape recorder and starts dictating into it] 12:32 p.m. Vampires meeting in the school gymnasium. Leader appears to be a fifth grader.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You know that girl Bella in Twilight? I think I'm like her. I'm a psi vampire. Do you like these sparkles I got?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [into his recorder] Annie Bartlett is a psi vampire.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yeah, I'm more a sanguinarian vampire, in that I rely more on the life force energy, per se.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Heh, yeah, I'm gonna be a hybrid vampire, both psi and sanguinarian.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: That's Ryan Ellis. Looks like they've gotten to him too.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Lunchtime's almost over. Should we drink some more blood?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yeah! Cool!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yeah, and then I think it's time for us to feed, per se. [opens a bottle of Clamato and pours some into the Bloodrayne's goblet.]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Oh God I think they're gonna drink blood now. They've got some kind of chalice, and they're- [clock] uhn... [he's run out of tape. It rewinds to the very beginning and plays back]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [Butters' voice] Toot toododoo! [Butters frantically presses buttons trying to stop the tape] It's the Big Texas Butters show! And now here he is, Big Texas Butters! Why howdy there, partners. I'm Biiig Texas Butters. And this is my horse, Toast. Happy Trails, to youuu! [he turns off the tape record, relieved. Until he looks around and jumps from being startled] AAHHH!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Ummm, what are you doing?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [jumps away and whips out a golden cross] Get back! You stay back! Hwa! Heah! The body of Christ compels you! The body of Christ compels you! [runs away without his tape recorder] Hwaaaahh!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: The school hallway, later. Mike is at his locker

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: That kid was really scared of us.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: That's true, Bloodrayne. People are going to be frightened of us because they don't understand our ways, per se.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yeah, we're cool, huh? [the Goth kids happen upon the Vampire kids]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: What the hell are those kids doing?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Why are they all dressing like that all of a sudden?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Are they trying to be Goth?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: No, they're vamp. They wear plastic fangs and drink freaking Clamato juice.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: But they can't dress like that. That's our style.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Hey, Tommy Petros is thinking he might wanna be a Vamp kid too.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Tommy Petros? Is he cool?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yeah, he's cool enough.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: All right. [the Vamps and Goths face each other]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: So, all of a sudden you Justin and Britney wannabes think it's cool to dress like us?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: We dress the way our souls feel, to express the darkness, per se.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Aren't you Mike Makowski?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: That's Vampir Makowski now.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You kids need to all go put your freakin' Banana Republic clothes back on, right now!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Hey, we're just as dark as you guys, maybe darker!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Really. Do you guys even smoke?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Of course not. Smoking's bad for you.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yeah.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [buries his face in his left hand] Oh my God.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You know, you guys are really giving off a negative human energy. We prefer to take our darkness somewhere else, per se.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: All right, Count Fagula, you go do that. [the Vamps leave]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Butters' house, after school. Butters runs inside in a panic, looks around, then heads for the sofa.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Mom, Mom, I gotta tell you somethin'! You're not gonna believe it!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [sewing a scarf] Not now, Butters. Your father wants to have a talk with you in the kitchen. He is not happy.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Oh no, what'd I do this time?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You just march on in there.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [hangs his head and goes in] Oh jeez...

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: The kitchen. Butters walks in and looks at Stephen, who's by the sink waiting with his arms crossed. To his left are a glass of milk and a box of Hamburger Helper.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You see this, Butters?! It's a glass of milk I poured for myself! And you see this?! [holds up the box] It's Hamburger Helper! Now would you mind telling me what Hamburger Helper is doing in this glass of milk?! [Butters begins to tap his fists together, nervously] Why is Hamburger Helper in a glass of milk, Butters?!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I have no idea, sir.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I'll tell you why! [walks over to the pantry and opens the door] Our pantry is always kept organized alphabetically! But somebody put the Hamburger Helper where the Nestle Quik is supposed to go!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Uh, I'm sorry, Dad. I-It's just I've been really preoccupied lately. See, there are these kids at school, they were-

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: What keeps a family together, Butters?!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: A well-organized pantry.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: That's right! [starts throwing food out of the pantry on to the floor] If you keep putting food under the wrong letter, it all goes wrong! [stops] Now you will reorganize this entire pantry, and you will do it right!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Well, okay, but, Dad, you've gotta listen to me. Kids at school are starting to change. They've been acting-

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You do it right now or you're going to be grounded! You got that?!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [hangs his head] Yes, sir. [Stephen walks away. Butters turns to the task at hand and begins putting stuff away] Jeez. Nobody will even listen to me. It's like nobody even cares if there's vampires at the school. I try to help and all I ever do is get hollered at. I bet vampires never get hollered at. Vampires just get to do whatever they want. [stops and thinks]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: South Park Elementary, next day, recess. The Vamp kids are on the merry-go-round gathered around Vampir

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [reading from a book] ...All mortals share a soft repose,My soul doth dreadful vigils keep, More keen than which hell scarcely knows.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: What is that kid doing?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [walks towards them with hands outstretched] Oh Jesus, oh God, Butters, what are you doing? [pulls out the crucifix he used on them a few days before and sets it down on the snow, then continues towards them, hands outstretched] I- I'm Butters.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: So?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: O creatures of the night, I seek audience to engage with thee in unholy darnation and thus do... a-a-and thus do unto your bidding!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: What?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Oh, uh... I wanna be a vampire.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You're not cool enough to be one of us.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yeah, I know, but uhhh, I think I would make a really good vampire if you just, well, just give me the opportunity.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: We'll think about it. Go get us some sodas out of the pop machine in the commons.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yes! Yes, anything else?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I want some Cheetos.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Soda and Cheetos, yes. I'll be right back.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: The Goth Corner at South Park Elementary. The Goth kids are listening to music as a soccer ball rolls to a stop in front of them.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I'm not part of your society. I don't follow your fads and rules. Doctrines...

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [with dark blond hair] Where did it go? Do you see where it went?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [with black hair] Yeah, it's right over there by those vampire kids. [Boy 1 retrieves the ball and walks away]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [delayed reaction] What? Hey. Hey! We aren't vampire kids, we're freakin' Goths!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Whatever, Dracula, why don't you turn into a bat or something?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: So lame. So... lame...

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You guys, I do not wanna be grouped in with douchey, little vampire kids.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Sooo lame! [two Vamps walk out of the door behind him]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: See? Isn't it cool back here? It's all dark and isolated.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: This would be a great place for a Vampire meeting.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Get out of our space, you little twerps!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: More preppy straight-A students turning into vampires. What the hell is going on?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: The woods, night. Butters is walking through them with drinks and some food. He reaches a small campfire where five of the six Vamps wait for him. Vampir is missing.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I have done what you've asked. [sets down the goods] A case of Dr Pepper and Cherry Twizzlers. Who are you gonna give this to? I-I mean, vampires can't eat people food.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [walks into view] You have done well. Are you ready to become one of us, per se?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yeah, I guess.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Are you sure? Because once you're in South Park Vampire Society, you can't ever leave.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Well I'm sick of bein'- bein' pushed around. M-by my dad, by kids at school.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Then it is time for your transformation, per se. Let it begin! [they all walk away, leaving behind the Dr. Pepper and Twizzlers. They walk to South Park Mall] This way. Prepare thyself. [the mall is still open, so they walk over to Hot Topic and enter. The Vamps begin checking out clothes for Butters to wear as a new Vamp. The Midnight Vamp gets some fake teeth with fangs while the Cowlick Vamp gets some necklaces and rings. They outfit Butters with them. The Sparkly Vamp gets some hairspray and she and the Spiky Vamp spray Butters' hair with it. Bloodrayne measures him for collars and bracelets. Finally, all six Vamps step away, and a new Vamp is born]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Whoa.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: And now you shall drink vampire blood, and your transformation will be complete, per se! [walks away and pours out a bottle of Clamato juice into a goblet for Butters to drink] With this, thy transformation is done. [Butters takes a sip, then immediately spits it out]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Oh, that tastes awful! Blagh, blagh. [the Vamps leave Hot Topic]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: It is finished! Welcome, Butters, to the South Park Society of Vampires. [Butters begins to laugh, then cackle.]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Butters' home, night. He walks into the living room, and Stephen runs up to him

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: There you are, Butters! Do you know what time it is?! Where have you been?! [Butters just walks by]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Butters, what have you done to your hair? [Butters heads for the stairs]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Hey! Butters, we are talking to you! Explain yourself, mister! [Butters stops]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I no longer need to explain anything to you, Father!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: What on Earth?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: That does it! You are grounded for two weeks, you got that?!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You can't ground me! For I am neither living nor dead! How can thy ground that which is... ungroundable. [smiles knowingly. His parents are perplexed]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: All right, I don't know what's gotten into you, mister, but you're gonna- [Butters hisses at him] Ah!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Butters? [Butters hisses at them a few times, and Linda clings to Stephen. Butters goes upstairs]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I am going to my room now! For I must slumber, per se. [his parents are stunned and just look at each other.]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Principal's Office, day

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Now, kids, I understand that you are very into this "vampire" thing, but I don't want to see it get out of hand. You kids need to understand that your new little fad is scary to some.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: ...Oh my God. You've got the wrong flippin' people.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [slowly, for emphasis] We aren't vampires.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I know that you aren't really vampires, and I appreciate that you wanna be cool because vampires are the "in" thing right now, but-

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: We aren't trying to be popular!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: -but just make sure that this new little trend doesn't become a distraction. [the door opens behind the Goths]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [enters with Vampir and two younger Vamps] Here's a couple more, Principal Victoria, hm'kay.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Oh, oh no, are we in trouble?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I was just telling your friends about what I expect of your-

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [slowly, for emphasis] We aren't friends!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Don't worry, Ma'am. As I was just explaining to my new minions, vampires are actually very spiritual and deep beings, per se.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: The waiting room outside the Principal's office. The Goths exit and immediately whip out smokes and lighters

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Allison Merch is a vampire kid now? This thing isn't going to stop.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Let's just face it: they bogarted our style! Everyone's gonna think we're trying to be butthole vampires now. We might as well go to the freakin' Gap and just buy normal clothes. [they all look at each other thoughtfully]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Goth Corner, a day or two later. The Goths are now dressed as normal kids, but their hair is still colored as before.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Well, at least nobody can refer to us as vampire kids now. [the soccer ball bounces towards the Goth kids again and stops in front of Henrietta]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: It went this way?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [with very short hair] Yeah, it's over there by that fat girl, the big-nosed kid, the midget, and the kid with pock marks on his face. [Boy 1 sees the ball, walks over, picks it up, and leaves]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: So we're back to that, are we?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Shit.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [stands up] Let's get out of these freakin' Gap clothes.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Cartman's room, night. He's asleep with the covers off. All of a sudden, Butters is perched on the inside of Cartman's window doors. The other one is open. Butters hisses.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Sorry, Eric, but I am a vampire now, and I can no longer survive on human food. And if someone must die so that I can feed, I choose thee. [he jumps down from the window and hops onto Cartman's bed, ready to pounce on his throat. He wiggles his fingers, then relaxes them and grips Cartman's head and back] Hm, wonder which side I'm supposed to do it on, hm. Probably doesn't matter. [rears back and bites into Cartman's neck, making sucking sounds. Cartman wakes up and looks at him]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Butters? [Butters continues] Butters?! [Butters backs up and then hops off the bed]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I can't do it. Ah, I- I can't do it!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Dude, gross, you got spit all over my neck! Mom! Butters just gave me a hickey!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I'm so hungry, but just, just remembering how that blood tasted before ju- blood is all clammy and tomato-y. It makes me wanna... [he vomits on Cartman's floor]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Dude! [Liane enters]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You all right, sweetie?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [advances and hisses at Liane, then runs out through the window and crashes to the ground outside.] U-huh. [bumps into something] Ow.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: What's going on?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Well, Mom, apparently Butters is gay, finds me very attractive, and, confused about his sexual identity, puked up all over my floor!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Oh dear.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yes.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Henrietta's room, later. The Goth kids are hanging out there.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I walked into the cafeteria today. Rebecca Miller and Philip Russ were dressed like vampires drinking Clamato juice with four kids from the football team.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Jesus.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: It's like, there's more vampire kids every freakin' day. Why is this happening, I mean... why now?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Doesn't matter why. Pretty soon, the whole school is going to be an endless hive of conformist happy-go-lucky vampire wannabes.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: It seems like that preppy Mike Makowski kid started all this. Maybe he's the way to stopping it.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Whattaya mean?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I mean, what do you do when you want to change vampires back to normal? You get rid of the head vampire.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: A car night. The Goth kids are in it, with Henrietta at the wheel

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Does your mom know you took her car?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Do I care?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: All right, this is probably good enough.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yeah, pull over here. [Henrietta pulls over, and the Goth kids leave the car. Henrietta stops by the trunk and pops it open. Inside is Vampir, all tied up.]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [tied up and gagged] (Please, what do you want?! Let me go!)

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: What should we do with him?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Well, if he's a vampire, I guess we should drive a stake through his heart.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: (No! I'm not really a vampire! I'm not a vam-, I'm not a vampire!)

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [leans in and puts his hand to his left ear] What's that?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: (I'm not really a vampire.)

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: You're not really a vampire? Really? I'm so freaking shocked. [moves off and joins the other Goths]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: If we get the right packaging, we can just FedEx him somewhere far way.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: How about we send him to Transylvania?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: No, he'd probably see it as something to brag about someday to his little vampire buddies.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: If we're gonna send him somewhere, it should be the most horrible, most miserable place on Earth.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [after a few seconds of contemplation] Scottsdale.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: The Stotch house. Butters' parents are upstairs. Linda is pounding on the door trying to get Butters to open it.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Butters, we just got a call from Mrs. Cartman. Butters? [tries to open the door, but finds it locked] Unbelievable! He's locked the door. [She and Stephen change places and Stephen tries opening the door, but it won't open. He pounds on the door.]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Butters, this is your father! Explain why you snuck into another boy's bedroom and gave him a hickey! [Butters is in his bed, his arms crossed over his chest. On the headboard are four lit candles. He's hyperventilating] Butters?! Butters, you will open this door right now!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: What have I done to myself? I should have known I wouldn't have the stomach to be a vampire. I am so hungry.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Butters, you have five seconds to unlock this door! [counts up with his fingers] One! Two! [the door is unlocked and opened a little. Stephen pushes the door in and it creaks. Stephen and Linda enter slowly. They see his window is wide open and he's not in bed. There are lit candles everywhere] Uhh, Bu-Butters?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Hey Dad. [he's crouching on top of his bookcase and startles Stephen]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: AAAARH! Buh. Bu-Butters, did you get gay with one of your schoolmates tonight?!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I have to eat! But I can't do it. I'm getting weak.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [angrily] All right! Now you listen, and you listen good! Until you stop behaving this way, you are not going to leave this room! Do you understand?!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Dahhh. [hops down from the bookcase and tries to hop onto his toy box, but he trips and lands on the floor. He gets up, climbs onto the toy box and crouches on the window sill, and hisses at them] I know now what I have to do! [hops down to the ground outside] Myah!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [walks over to the open window] Stephen, what has happened to our boy?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [joins her there] He's become something, Linda. Something that... we cannot ground.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Village Inn, night. The Goths are inside drinking coffee and moping around

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I just. Don't. Get it. We sent the head vampire kid to Scottsdale, but still more and more kids are dressing up like vampires.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: He must not have been what was causing it. It must be something else.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Hey you kids gonna order any food or just sit there and drink coffee all night again? [pours them another round]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Leave us alone!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Bad enough I always get stuck with you Goth kids, now I got Goth kids in my entire section. [she points to them with her left thumb; there are two booths bursting with Vamps. One has seven Vamps, the other has nine]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: They aren't Goth! They're douchey little vampire kids!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Looks the same to me.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I bet they aren't even drinking coffee.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: [turns to face the Vamps] No, they said they're too young to drink caffeine, so they're havin' orange juice. [turns left and walks away. Pete drops his head on the table and keeps it there]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Let's go over there and tell them they're not taking Village Inn from us too.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Forget it! It's over, all right? There's too many of them now. We can't stop them. Let's just face it. Freakin' vampires beat us.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Maybe not. [hisses. He's on all fours on the ledge behind the booths] Did you say you're trying to get rid of the vampires? [crawls closer to the Goths] I want to help you.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Get away, douchebag.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Some legends say that if you destroy the vampires' lair, the vampires go back to being human again.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: What are you talking about?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: I can take you... to the place where kids are being transformed into vampires. [the Goths look at each other]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: South Park Mall, sometime later. Butters leads the Goths to the Place of Transformation, Hot Topic.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Awww, Hot Topic? When did this open?

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Two weeks ago. It used to be a Banaaana Repuuubliiic.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Of course. Freaking Hot Topic. That explains everything.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: How did we not figure that out? Of course a new Hot Topic must have come to town. Duh!

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Well, I think we all know what has to be done.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Yup.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Let's get to it. [they turn and head into the store. They get aerosol cans and fan out across the store, start spraying, and light the sprays with their lighters, turning the cans into makeshift flamethrowers]

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: Burn down down, burn down Hot Topic. Don't let it steal your soul away. Burn down, burn down Hot Topic. Light the fire. Take control. Burn down, burn down Hot Topic. Don't let it take your soul. Burn down, burn down, burn down Hot Topic. And take control. Burn down... Hot Topic. Burn it down... Hot Topic.

Title: The Ungroundable
Line: While the song is playing, the following happens: Michael is the first to torch some clothes. Henrietta follows with the belts and scarves. Pete begins to torch the jewelry

Title: The Ungroundable
