Line: I don't have time for this. [brings out some fireworks and lights the fuse. He drops the fireworks on the ground and leaves. They pop up and deter the Coon from following him. When the smoke clears the Coon looks around and doesn't see anyone.]

Title: The Coon
Line: Fireworks are illegal in Colorado, you asshole! [to the officers on the second floor] Hey, he's got fireworks!

Title: The Coon
Line: South Park Elementary, day. A pissed-off Cartman, wearing his "Who is the Coon?" T-shirt, walks down the hall until he finds his classmates.

Title: The Coon
Line: So, guys! Any of you do anything interesting last night?!

Title: The Coon
Line: Not really.

Title: The Coon
Line: Really?! Nobody was playing with any fireworks?! [grabs Stan's right hand and sniffs it vigorously, then lets it go and looks around for other suspects]

Title: The Coon
Line: Dude, what the hell?

Title: The Coon
Line: Aha! Kenny! I should have known! [walks over to Kenny's locker and points] Why do you have a picture of Mysterion in your locker, Kenny?! [points at Kenny] Unless you are Mysterion!

Title: The Coon
Line: [opens his door to demonstrate something] Dude, I have a picture of Mysterion in my locker too.

Title: The Coon
Line: Yeah, so do I.

Title: The Coon
Line: What?! Why?

Title: The Coon
Line: I don't know, it's just a cool costume.

Title: The Coon
Line: It's not a cool costume! He just wears his underwear over his buttfucking pants! Now, come on, which one of you guys is it?!

Title: The Coon
Line: [walking by] How are you so sure Mysterion is a boy?

Title: The Coon
Line: [gasps and walks away a bit to watch Wendy leave] Fucking bitch...

Title: The Coon
Line: U Stor It storage facility, night. Two pigeons perched on the top of the sign suddenly take wing.

Title: The Coon
Line: [voice over] I had no choice. [he peeks out from behind a building, then runs] I was at the end of my rope. [he hears a sound and turns to its direction] Sometimes when a superhero needs answers, he has to turn to the wretched underbelly of society.

Title: The Coon
Line: Hahahahahahahahaaa... Look what the cat dragged in.

Title: The Coon
Line: Come out where I can see you!

Title: The Coon
Line: What's the matter, Coon? Nervous?

Title: The Coon
Line: [voice over] I didn't want to resort to this, but he could have the answers I need.

Title: The Coon
Line: How utterly delightful! The heroic and mighty Coon [Professor Chaos leaps into view] come to put a stop to me again.

Title: The Coon
Line: [voice over] Chaos. I need to keep on my toes. [speaks] I'm not here to stop you this time, Chaos! I need information.

Title: The Coon
Line: Oh I'm sure you do. But you see I [almost trips on his cape] whoop. [recovers] But you see I also know you like to beat me up.

Title: The Coon
Line: I didn't call you to fight, Chaos! I came to see if you know Mysterion's identity. [the two adversaries begin to circle each other]

Title: The Coon
Line: Oh I'm close. And I'll put an end to him, and all of you goody-two-shoe heroes!

Title: The Coon
Line: I'm not on his side!

Title: The Coon
Line: Do you think I'm a fool?! All those times you stopped me from my acts of evil! All those times you tricked me into meeting you, and then ga- and then gave me titty-twisters! Not this time, Coon! I finally learned my lesson! Now, General Disarray! [General Disarray holds a rope on the roof behind the Coon at the end of the storage building. He jumps down and swings towards the Coon and knocks him down] Yeah-ha! [General Disarray tries to keep the Coon on the ground.]

Title: The Coon
Line: That's it! [stands up]

Title: The Coon
Line: O- oh careful General Disarray.

Title: The Coon
Line: Agh- Stop it! You, you... butthole! Knock it off!

Title: The Coon
Line: Hehyeah! We beat him, General Disarray! [General Disarray has the Coon in a choke hold]

Title: The Coon
Line: Listen to me! I want to... help you... get rid of Mysterion!

Title: The Coon
Line: Let him go, General Disarray! [General Disarray lets go and hops off. Professor Chaos puts his fists to his waist] Why would you help us?!

Title: The Coon
Line: Because Mysterion is trying to [bumps General Disarray off. General Disarray strikes a couple of trash cans and gets up a bit dazed] You fucker, that fuckin' hurt! [turns towards Professor Chaos] Because Mysterion is trying to say he's the hero this town needs! But that's my job!

Title: The Coon
Line: But you both fight for justice and good.

Title: The Coon
Line: Yeah, but he's a fuckin' dick! I want him gone just as much as you do!

Title: The Coon
Line: Very well. I will show you what we know about Mysterion's identity, but if this is some kind of setup-

Title: The Coon
Line: N- I'm the good guy, Chaos. I don't betray people.

Title: The Coon
Line: Weh- oh yeah. [turns and walks away. General Disarray walks away also, and the Coon follows them]

Title: The Coon
Line: [voice over] I didn't like having to work with this scumbag. But I knew Mysterion was out there, plotting his next move.

Title: The Coon
Line: Kyle's room, night. Kyle sits at his desk deep in thought.

Title: The Coon
Line: [on Kyle's bed] Hello Kyle.

Title: The Coon
Line: [looks, then jumps in his seat] Whoa, what the?

Title: The Coon
Line: Do not be afraid. I mean you no harm.

Title: The Coon
Line: Hey. Hey, you're that Mysterion kid.

Title: The Coon
Line: Yes. But now I believe someone is trying to learn my true identity.

Title: The Coon
Line: Dude, everyone's trying to figure out who you are.

Title: The Coon
Line: [turns away from Kyle] I cannot be unmasked, for then I would stop being a symbol. I need help. Somebody who can do background checks for me, do some investigating.

Title: The Coon
Line: Who? Me? Why?

Title: The Coon
Line: Because I think you are the smartest kid in class. [looks over his shoulder. Kyle just stands there.]

Title: The Coon
Line: U Stor It storage facility, night.

Title: The Coon
Line: This way! We will now show you our secret headquarters of DOOM.

Title: The Coon
Line: You guys have your own storage facility?

Title: The Coon
Line: Actually it belongs to General Disarray's grandma, um but she lets us use it. [General Disarray removes the lock from the unit and tries to lift the door. Professor Chaos helps him out and holds the door open as General Disarray and the Coon enter, then enters and lets the door drop closed behind them. Professor Chaos leads the Coon through the unit] This is where we come up with all our evil plans. Here's our computer relays. [a TV on a large stereo console with a toy keyboard attached] And this is like a, a cube of chaos that can destroy the world in one second! [an unsolved Rubik's Cube under glass, on a table from which a sign hangs: WARNING DO NOT TOUCH!] And here's some of our evil minions! [hamsters] We have everything we need here. Can I offer you a Coke or a Sprite or something?

Title: The Coon
Line: I'll take a Sprite.

Title: The Coon
Line: Uhget the Coon a Sprite, General Disarray. [General Disarray leaves to get the Sprite while Professor Chaos takes the Coon to a wall with pictures of the other guys in class on it] As you can see we too have been working hard on Mysterion's identity.

Title: The Coon
Line: You have an entire wall dedicated to Mysterion? What about...? Do you, do you still have that "Who Is The Coon?" T-shirt I gave you?

Title: The Coon
Line: Oh yeah, I think it's around here somewhere. Uh, using our photos we are tryin' to pinpoint Mysterion's identity.

Title: The Coon
Line: Why is Cartman crossed out? He, he could be Mysterion.

Title: The Coon
Line: No, he's too fat. Based on his body type it's gotta be someone like Stan or Kyle. [The Coon turns away, insulted, but his eyes pop open as he sees who the Coon suspects are: Harvey Fierstein, Cartman, and Bruce Vilanch. It just makes him angrier]

Title: The Coon
Line: Alright, al, alright, alright, look, Chaos. Just set up a video camera. I know how we can put an end to Mysterion once and for all.

Title: The Coon
Line: Channel Nine News splash screen comes up.

Title: The Coon
Line: The clock is ticking and the citizens of South Park are gripped in fear. Two days ago an evil unknown terrorist threatened major consequences if Mysterion [a pic of Mysterion appears] does not reveal his identity.

Title: The Coon
Line: [from his headquarters, reading a prepared statement] Mark my words, South Park! Your precious hero is now, uh, your undoing! If Mysterion does not unmask himself publicly by Wednesday night, I am going to blow up... a hospital. Blow up a hospital? [looks off to his right] I'm not gonna blow up any hospital. Are you nuts? What? [turns to the camera] Uh, the choice is yours, Mysterion! Unmask yourself or hundreds will die! Hahaha. [looks off to his right again] Jesus Christ.

Title: The Coon
Line: Since the threat was issued there has been no sign of Mysterion. Where is Mysterion?

Title: The Coon
Line: [through his teeth] Where is Mysterion?

Title: The Coon
Line: On the first floor of a construction site. Chaos, Coon, and Disarray are there with lots of TNT piled up around them. There are no walls up, so the floor is open.

Title: The Coon
Line: Hey Coon w-we aren't actually gonna blo- blow up anything, are we?

Title: The Coon
Line: If you don't make good on your threats, Chaos, then what good are your threats?

Title: The Coon
Line: But you really wanna blow up a hospital? I mean, a-aren't you a good guy?

Title: The Coon
Line: Sometimes blowing up hospitals is for the greater good, Chaos.

Title: The Coon
Line: [walks up to Professor Chaos] You know, I've been thinking: if we're really evil villains, then we should betray him, and blow him up with the hospital.

Title: The Coon
Line: You know, you're a little scrotum-licker dude! Why don't you shut the fuck up?! [turns and runs to the edge of the floor] Alright Chaos, I'm gonna get the triggers for these things at ACE Hardware. Keep an eye on this stuff! [jumps down to the ground]

Title: The Coon
Line: Aww jeez General Disarray, this is a lot more than I ever really intended. [General Disarray almost loses his balance twice, but recovers both times] I mean, well I hate the world and all its puny inhabitants and all but, but blowin' up a hospital? It just seems mean. [a shadow spreads across the floor before them. They look towards the shadow's source and find Mysterion standing on a beam above them. Chaos gasps] Whoa. Oh hamburgers!

Title: The Coon
Line: AAAGH! [runs away to the other end of the floor and behind some boxes of TNT]

Title: The Coon
Line: Aaah, a m m Mysterion, I b-, I beg you, I mean ah, judahadahada...

Title: The Coon
Line: Why are you doing this?! This isn't your usual MO, Chaos!

Title: The Coon
Line: Whowell I b- Well I b- ah I just would jes one nigh-, and then the Coon saw it up and I wa able to, and was able to [begins to mumble and fade out]

Title: The Coon
Line: On the street below people walk along the sidewalks unaware of anything happening above them until a scream is heard.

Title: The Coon
Line: Waaugh!

Title: The Coon
Line: What is that?

Title: The Coon
Line: On the construction site Professor Chaos and Mysterion fight.

Title: The Coon
Line: Look! Mysterion and Professor Chaos are fighting!

Title: The Coon
Line: Give him hell, Mysterion! [more people appear and begin cheering the fight. General Disarray returns to help Professor Chaos]

Title: The Coon
Line: Look out Mysterion! General Disarray is behind you! [General Disarray grabs onto Mysterion's left leg]

Title: The Coon
Line: Jesus Christ, we need backup out here! [a police car pulls up as he says this. A sniper tries to train his scope on Professor Chaos]

Title: The Coon
Line: I think I can get a shot at Chaos, sir.

Title: The Coon
Line: [stays his officer's rifle] You think your bullets can hurt him? [Chaos and Disarray have defeated Mysterion, who lies unconscious on his back against some open bags of plaster. The crowd below gasps]

Title: The Coon
Line: Yeah, we did it!

Title: The Coon
Line: [breaking the crowd's silence] He's dead. Mysterion is dead.

Title: The Coon
Line: Nooo... [begins to sob. Other begin to sob too]

Title: The Coon
Line: The impossible has happened. Mysterion, beloved protector of the city, is dead. Who will save us now?

Title: The Coon
Line: Wait! Look! [Mysterion begins to move and wakes up]

Title: The Coon
Line: He's all right! [the crowd cheers and the battle between Mysterion and Chaos resumes, with Disarray trying to restrain Mysterion. Mysterion throws him off, and Disarray runs away again]

Title: The Coon
Line: [offscreen] Oh my God, look everyone, it's the Coon!

Title: The Coon
Line: [walking up a ramp to the first floor] Fear not everyone! Coon is here to save the day.

Title: The Coon
Line: Isn't that Bruce Vilanch?

Title: The Coon
Line: Be careful Bruce Vilanch! There are superhumans fighting right over there!

Title: The Coon
Line: Okay sorry sorry! I'm sorry! I give up! Please, I give up!

Title: The Coon
Line: Don't worry, Mysterion! [Mysterion gets off Chaos and Chaos stands up] The Coon will now help you!

Title: The Coon
Line: Well, wait! I thought we were workin' together. [the Coon punches him in the mouth] Waaa. [sprouts a bloody nose] Oh jeez, I think I broke a tooth. [covers his face, turns left and runs out of view, mumbling. The crowd cheers some more]

Title: The Coon
Line: That was great teamwork, Mysterion. South Park is safe. Until next time.

Title: The Coon
Line: What next time?

Title: The Coon
Line: Well, people are obviously so desperate to learn your identity that they'll do anything. Won't be long before the next villain comes along and threatens violence unless you take off your mask. [Mysterion gives this some thought.]

Title: The Coon
Line: Park County Police Station. Mysterion stands at a podium flanked by the Coon and the Park County police.

Title: The Coon
Line: Citizens, tonight has shown me I have no choice but to unmask myself.

Title: The Coon
Line: Don't do it, Mysterion! If you show your identity we'll be forced to arrest you for being a vigilante!

Title: The Coon
Line: Don't you think he knows that?! But superheroes know that sometimes you have to sacrifice yourself for the greater good.

Title: The Coon
Line: Don't show your face, Mysterion!

Title: The Coon
Line: You have to be a symbol!

Title: The Coon
Line: So that the next terrorist can threaten South Park if he doesn't unmask himself?!

Title: The Coon
Line: No, it's true. As long as my identity is a mystery, this will just happen again and again. It has to end. I will show my face. [the camera zooms in on him as he gets ready to remove his mask. As soon as he shows his eyes and nose, the camera stops]

Title: The Coon
Line: Ohhh.

Title: The Coon
Line: [holding a camera] Well I'll be.

Title: The Coon
Line: I knew it was you! 'Member I even said it before!

Title: The Coon
Line: Wow, a kid from my class was Mysterion.

Title: The Coon
Line: Well I'm sorry but you're under arrest. Take the kid to jail. [hands Mysterion over to Murphy, who escorts him away]

Title: The Coon
Line: [voice over] My entire plan worked to perfection. [holds up his right hand] My work here is done. [leaps away, then appears on the roof of a building] With Mysterion out of the way the Coon can finally go back to keeping the city safe. [runs across the roof and leaps down, holding on to the sides of a ladder. He leaps off the bottom of the ladder and plants his right hand on the ground] Once again, I alone am the symbol this town can stand behind. [he eats a burger meal at a fast food restaurant] Every town needs a hero. [walks down a street towards sunset] Every town needs... a Coon. [looks back at the camera, then turns away and resumes walking. Last scene has the Coon riding down the street on his Big Coon Wheel tricycle]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: A new building - South Park Bank Savings and Loans. A line of customers waits to advance. Stan and Randy are at the head of the line.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Do I really have to do this, Dad?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Stan, now more than ever you need to understand the importance of saving money.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: But Grandma said I could use this money to buy whatever I want.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Okay, next please.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Go on, Stanley. [Stan walks up to Benny's desk and takes a seat.]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: How can I help you, young man?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: I got a hundred dollar check from my grandma, and my dad said I need to put it in the bank so it can grow over the years.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Well that's fantastic, a really smart decision, young man. We can put that check in a Money Market Mutual Fund, then we'll reinvest the earnings into foreign currency accounts with compounding interest aaand it's gone. [they look at each other for a long time]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Uh, what?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: It's gone. It's all gone.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: What's all gone?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: The money in your account - it didn't do too well, it's gone.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: What do you mean? I have a hundred dollars.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Not anymore you don't. POOF.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Well, what can I do to get back my money-?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: I'm sorry sir, but this line is for bank members only.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: I just opened an account.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Do you have any money invested in this bank?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: No, you just lost it all!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Then please stand aside for people who actually have money with us. Next please. [an elderly woman steps up and bumps Stan out of the chair.]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Hey!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Hello Mrs. Farnickle, how are you today? Making a deposit are we? Great, we can just put that into your retirement account and make it go to work for you aaaaand it's gone.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: What?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Sorry, yeah, that's gone. Please step aside for people who actually have money with the bank. Next please.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Dad!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Hey I'm trying to teach my son the importance of savings. You already lost his money?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Oh, Mr. Marsh, don't worry. We can just transfer money from your account into a portfolio with your son's-- aaand it's gone! This line is for people who have money with the bank only. Please step aside! [both Randy and Stan are dumbstruck.]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Breaking news. A 9 News Special Report graphic appears.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: This is a 9 News Special Report. RECESSION: A NATION IN PERIL.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: An economic crisis has hit South Park and the nation like never before. Another South Park bank has closed down, leaving thousands of people in debt.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: [in front of a convenience store] It's just crazy, you know? Ev-everyone's affected by it. It's like all the money just... vanished.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: [in front of the Stotch home] It's really terrifying. We... we've got no money to pay our mortgage now. We could very easily lose our house!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: [waves to the camera, but his face is blocked by the 9 News logo] Hi, Grandma!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: First the money started goin', and now everyone's gettin' laid off work! They took arrr jawbs!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: They took our jobs!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: [shrieking] Derk er derrrrrr!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Deeekerrdrrr!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Deeerkerrrrrrdrrrr!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Just how far will the economy fall? We asked economic reporter Dan Banks for his assessment. [a shot of Dan, who raises a gun to his head and fires, shooting his brains out and falling out of view.] We'll have the rest of Dan's interview tonight at 10.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: The Marsh house, dinnertime. Sharon walks in with the simplest dinner: hot dogs and sliced tomatoes. Everyone has a glass of water or soda, Randy has a margarita glass.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: All right everyone, eat up. [takes her seat]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Aw Jesus Christ! Sliced hot dogs and tomato slices?!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: You said we had to be careful with our money. I've got nothing for a food budget.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Mom, Dad, how come there's suddenly no money?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: [grabs a hot dog from the platter] I'll tell you what happened, son. See, there's a bunch of idiots out there who weren't happy with what they had. [slaps the hot dog onto his own plate] They wanted a bigger house and materialistic things that they didn't even need-- [grabs his margarita glass and rises from the table] people with no money who got loans to buy frivolous things they had no business buying. [walks over to a Margaritaville margarita blender and loads it with ice. A margarita mix is already in place in the blender] And these assholes just blindly started buying any stupid thing that looked appealing, [puts the ice scooper back into the ice bucket] 'cause they thought money was endless! [starts up the blender, which drowns out whatever he says for the next nine seconds] It goes back to when the government had the idea that everyone in America deserves to own a house. So we have people having a hard time paying their loans, [the blender stops] meaning less money coming in. [serves himself a margarita and places the blender back on its base] And the idiots couldn't see that by doing all this frivolous spending they were mocking the Economy. And they made the Economy very angry. [goes back to his seat with his margarita] We're all feeling the Economy's vengeance because of materialistic heathens who did stupid things with their money! Do you understand, son? [sips from his margarita glass]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Yeah, I think I get it.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: The South Park Mall, day. Anyone who has something to say about the economy is preaching to the crowd gathered there.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: And so why is our economy failing us? Because the government kept interest rates too low for too long! The government took our economy for granted and now we are all here paying the price! How long will we sit and watch our economy fall... As the people we must...

Title: Margaritaville
Line: ...An angel came to me and so I say to you: Do not listen to the Wall Street brokers! For they are the ones that put us in this situation! Fat cats with corporate greed! They are the ones who knowingly drove us down this pathway of doom! Our responsibility is...

Title: Margaritaville
Line: And where has all the money gone? It must have gone somewhere! The answer is obvious, my friends! It is the Jews! Covetous Jews who have taken all our money and hoarded it for themselves! Hidden all the cash in some... secret Jew cave that they built, probably back in the early 60s! It is the Jews, my friends, who are oft...

Title: Margaritaville
Line: [dressed in a drab green toga] There are different people casting all different kinds of blame from person to person. But the fault lies in all of you! [starts pointing at random people] YOU, who bought that three hundred thousand dollar house when you only had twenty thousand to put down? YOU, who bought that third car, even though only two people in your home drive! It is time to stop pointing fingers! [speeds up his rate of pointing] Finger pointing gets us nowhere, Steve! We have mocked our Economy. And now the Economy has cast its vengeance upon us all!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: He's right.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: This is the first guy to actually make sense. [more people are attracted to Randy's preaching]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Yea, it is an angry and unforgiving Economy. To repent we must stop frivolous spending! Instead of paying for cable let us watch clouds! Instead of buying clothes, wear but sheets from thine beds! Cut spending to only the bare essentials! Water and bread and margaritas, yea. [everyone applauds softly]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Sur la Table, day. Stan walks in with the Margaritaville and heads to the counter.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Hello young man, welcome to Sur la Tahbluh. Can I help you?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Yeah, I wanna return this Margaritaville my stupid dad bought.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Oh, that's all we get anymore, returns. Could you please just put the receipt here on this tahbluh. [Stan tries to put the receipt onto the counter, but the large Margaritaville gets in the way. Stan then just reaches up and the clerk takes the receipt] Sorry, our computers are a little slow today. We need a new Ethernet cahbluh. Oh, I'm sorry, sir, I'd like to give you a refund but I'm afraid it's not doahbluh.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: What?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: I said I'm not ahbluh, sir. You see, this Margaritaville was purchased with a payment plan?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: So?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Well an outside financing company handles those payment plans. Customers just pay for some of the machine and the finance company pays for the rest.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Well can't I just return it and get the money my dad put in back?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: [rests his head on his left hand] Hm... that's improbahbluh, [raises his left hand] but not impossibluh. I'm not really sure how it works; you'll, you'll have to speak with the people at the top. I can give you the finance company's address if that... agreeahbluh with you. [Stan just looks at him]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: South Park Mall exterior, just after sunset. Randy is on a table pacing back and forth, again dressed in a toga.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: We have become lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of the Economy! There are those who will say that the Economy has forsaken us! Nay! You have forsaken the Economy!! And now you know the Economy's wrath! O thoust can shop at a sporting goods store, but knowest thou that the Economy will take away thy Broncos' cap from thine head! [a shot of the Stotches in togas] Mock the Economy without fear! Thine own stockbrokers... now lie dead by their own hand and thou knowest that thy stockbrokers did not fear the Economy! Well here we are, my friends! You have brought the Economy's vengeance upon yourselves!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: What can we do, Randy?

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Yes tell us.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Tell us.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Tell us what to do.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: Tell us, Randy, what we should do!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: What should we do, Randy?!

Title: Margaritaville
Line: We must all wear sheets instead of buying clothes that need detergent! Instead of cars that take gasoline we can... get around on llamas from Drake's farm! Instead of video games that take batteries and software, our kids will play with squirrels! We must let the Economy know that we are capable of respecting it! No more needless spending! [everyone begins to cheer] The Economy is our shepherd. We shall not want. [stretches out his arms as the audience cheers him on.]

Title: Margaritaville
Line: South Park, sometime later. Everyone is wearing blankets instead of clothes, in the forms of togas and cloaks. People have begun to ride llamas, carry stuff in wooden boxes, and leave bales of hay around for the llamas and oxen. Businesses all along the street have shuttered their doors and windows and gone out of business. It's a much simpler way of living.

Title: Margaritaville
Line: [on a llama] Mornin' Ted.

Title: Margaritaville

Title: Margaritaville

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I did. I'm the Rad Russian. [affects a fake Russian accent] I come from Russian to crush your puny capitalist heads!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [arriving] Alright boys! I'm really glad to see we have some new recruits interested in the fine sport of wrassling.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Cool!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Let's do this!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: All right!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Now, the first thing we're gonna learn today are the fundamental wrassling holds. Let's get some volunteers. Uh why don't come over here young man? What's your name?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: The Rad Russian.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: What?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You capitalist swine, I'll crush you!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Okay uh, just go ahead and get on your hands and knees.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Huh?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Just, down on, down on the floor. [Cartman bends over a bit, unsure of how to do this, given his girth] Hands and knees. [the coach helps him out in getting into position.]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Okay...

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Alright and now how about you. Your name is?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Triceratops!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Uh, all right, uh cu, come on over here. I'm gonna position you in the official wrassling starting position. [drapes Butters over Cartman] Here- we- go.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: The fuck is this?!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Now just reach around him here. Good.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Dude! Dude! DUDE! [jumps to his feet] The fuck are you doing?!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Get back on the floor! I'm teaching the starting position of wrassling!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: That's not wrestling, dude, that's fucking gay!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah, what are you? A child molester?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Where's all the cool costumes and jumping off ropes and stuff?!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Oh, not this again! Let me guess: you just went to that stupid WWE show in Denver last night!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah! [all smiles]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Ugh. [the boys frown at this] The WWE is not wrassling! That's a bunch of fake bullcrap! How stupid are you! Real wrassling, boys, is this! [spreads his arms out to indicate the floor and their uniforms - practice, practice, practice]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Well this is fucking lame dude! Let's get the hell out of here, guys. [they all take off their headgear and walk away]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah, this guy probably wants to take pictures of us naked.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I got, half a mind to report, r-report you to the police, sir! [throws his headgear on the floor and walks away glaring back at the coach]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Rrrgh!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Cartman's house, day. He holds up a program written in crayon.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: The Wrestling Takedown Federation has several matches planned today. Alright, sooo, here's how we'll do this, guys. I'll come out to the ring first and then Jimmy, you come in and tell me you're gonna kick my ass. Then I'm gonna say "You slept with my girlfriend," and I'll charge you into a head slap.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Sounds good.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Then Butters, you come in as the ref all like "No no, the fight hasn't started yet," and that's when Jimmy sneaks up from behind and hits me over the head with a foldaway chair.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Okey doke.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: So is that when I t- tell you that your girlfriend is a whore?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Noo, let's save the "girlfriend is a whore" line until after Stan headbutts Butters for trying to stop the fight again.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Hmboy, wrestling sure is fun!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Alright are you ready to try this, guys?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yup.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Alright, let's start wrestlin'. [the boys take their starting positions]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I am gonna k-kick your ass!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You slept with my girlfriend, Hammerclaw! [Cartman slaps him hard, and Jimmy falls. Butters intervenes.]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Hey! No! No, the fight hasn't started yet. No, bad.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Hey! He slept with my girlfriend, referee! In my country we don't wait for a bell, miste-[Jimmy sneaks up behind him with a folding chair and smashes it into the back of his head, making him fall forward] ah!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Your girlfriend is a whore!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [whispers aloud] Wait for it, wait for the whore line.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [softly] Oh, I'm sorry.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You're gonna get it now, Hammerclaw!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: We'll see about that!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Now hold on! I am stopping the fight! [Stan headbutts him] Eoh!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: A park behind the Cartman house. The wall separating the backyard from the field is gone.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: What's goin' on?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Apparently that crippled kid slept with that Russian kid's girlfriend.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Jeez they're so young.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: First match.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I'll kill you, Triceratops! You made fun of my crippled mother!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: That's because your mother betrayed my mother, Juggernaut!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Second match.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You don't come to this country and make fun of it!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: And just vhat do you care about your pitiful country?!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I served my country! I fought for two years in Vietnam.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: From the seats in the backyard.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: That kid was in 'Nam? Man, that's incredible!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Good for you for serving your country!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Out on the street, a redneck runs to tell the rednecks haning out on a truck.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Guys, check this out! There's this little kid from the Congo, who was raised by panthers!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Are you serious?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Third match.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Just admit it, Congo! Admit that you lied about me to Irene!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I admit nothing! Maybe Irene lied to you!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: From the seats in the backyard. There are more chairs present.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: That kid in the hat is havin' sex with two different girls?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Naw, that little kid from the Congo lied about one of them to try and get the kid in the hat in trouble with his wife.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: They're married?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Fourth match intro.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You have to forfeit the fight, Rad Russian! You cannot fight until your test results come ba-back!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I might have to wait for my hepatitis test, but in the mean time, I have brought my comrade from Mexico to wrestle against you!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: From the seats in the backyard.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: That Russian kid's got hepatitis?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Fourth match.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: And here he comes now, the cold-blooded wrestler from Mexico, El Pollo Loco! [Kenny, dressed as a masked luchador, comes out to mariachi fanfare and sparklers. The spectators clap and cheer him on]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: What are you doing here, El, El Pollo Loco?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: (I came here to kick your ass once and for all!)

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Nighttime. The wrestling matches are coming one after the other, connected by convoluted plot lines and story arcs.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Your girlfriend doesn't even like you, Stan the Man! She likes me!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You have no idea what you're saying Juggernaut! Irene loves me and I'm gonna marry her!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: If she wants to be with you, how about you have her tell all these people here?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Uh oh, here she comes now! It's Bad Irene! [Cartman, dressed as a diva, walks out of the dressing room and towards the ring. The crowd hoots and hollers. She climbs right in and takes the mic from Stan's hand]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Let me tell you something! Let me tell you something! It's true, I love Stan the Man with all my heart, but... I want to be with Juggernaut now.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: What?!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: No! No! What are you doing?! Stan the Man loves you!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Don't break his heart!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: If you love Juggernaut, Irene, then tell him what you did two years ago! How you killed his child!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: It's true. I was pregnant with your child and aborted it. [the crowd boos and expresses its disapproval]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Irene, no! Why?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Do you know what it's like to have an abortion at seven years old? DO YOU? I've had so many abortions. I just... got addicted to them.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Whoa, did you hear that?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Shh!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Irene, you said you loved me!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I'm not in love with you, I'm in love with abortions. Don't you undestand?! [screams, runs up to Stan with a steel chair, and smashes him with it, knocking him down]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Ohhhh! [Kyle runs up to Cartman and knocks him down with a flying kick] Ahhhh!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Skeeter's Bar, night. A bunch of men are gathered at the bar chatting.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I'm telling you guys, you've got to see this. These kids ain't more than eight or nine years old an' they got more problems than you can imagine.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: There's this one kid, he saw his father get murdered. And yesterday he finds the killer, and it's this other kid whose an ex-cop. Needless to say, he whupped his ass good.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yup, and there's this little girl, she's actually addicted to gettin' abortions. Got pregnant by nearly every boy there.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You're shittin' me!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: No! We're telling you these kids are fucking crazy! You gotta check it out! [the wrestling coach is sitting nearby, stewing at the conversation]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You can watch 'em almost every afternoon. It's some of the greatest wrestlin' we ever seen.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [rises from his seat and approaches the men at he bar] It isn't real! Don't you people understand that stuff isn't real?! None of it! How stupid are you?! [Skeeter and another bar patron look at each other]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [strokes his chin thoughtfully] What do you mean, it ain't real?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: It's all made up! Fiction! Real wrassling is a serious and respectable sport! Why can't you people understand that that kind of wrestling isn't real?!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [walks up to the coach] Mister, there's a little girl out there who's had fourteen abortions, an' she ain't even ten yet. But I guess that's just [holds up two fingers on each hand in a quote gesture] "not real" to you! [turns and walks back to the bar, saying under his breath] Son of a bitch.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Look look look! [whips out his iPhone to show them] THIS is wrestling. THIS. [two men are shown wrestling in Greco-Roman style. There's a lot of grunting in the match. The bar patrons watch the little screen for a few seconds]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Mister, you'd better take your gay porn an' walk right out of this bar.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Cartman's backyard, a new dressing room. The boys prepare for their matches. Stan looks out through the curtains.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Holy crap dude, there's a huge turnout tonight.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Good thing we made those changes to the seating.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Alright you guys, let's bring it in. [the boys huddle and hold hands] I think we've done a really great job and let's just keep the energy up, you know, have a good flow, and have fun out there, okay?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Let's do this! One! Two!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Backyard wrestling!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Cartman's backyard, moments later. The yard has been transformed into a Greek amphitheater. A façade now covers the back side of the house and a wrestling ring is in the amphitheater's pit. The place looks filled to capacity with people chattering, waiting for the matches to begin. The amphitheater lights dim and the crowd cheers as the wrestlers come out.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Oh what a perfect night for fighting. Lo, the moon sets upon the tips of the trees and I, the man known as the Rad Russian, start to stir with the excitement of violence.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Only a country like yours can breed men of such discontent, Rad Russian. But you don't know what real pain is! PAIN! Like I've known. Abandoned when I was four years old by my parents. Left to die in a cold and dark sewage tunnel!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Gee, I didn't know his parents did that.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Shhh.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: South Park Elementary, principal's office, day. Principal Victoria is talking with the wrestling coach.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I'm very sorry, but I'm afraid we have to terminate your employment here at South Park Elementary.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You're firing me? Why?!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: The school board has decided to discontinue the wrestling program. Wrestling simply involves too much adult subject matter, like murder and abortion. [shows him the South Park Gazette, which has the headline "Kids Wrestle with Adult Issues"]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: No, this isn't wrassling! THIS ISN'T WRASSLING! Principal Victoria, just let me stay on and I can teach kids what real wrassling is!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I'm sorry, the board has made up their minds.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You can't fire me for what these kids do!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: That isn't the only reason you're being let go.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: What do you mean?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [sighs] We... found all the gay porn on your iPhone, Mr. Conners.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: The wrestling dressing room, day. The boys are dressing up for another round of wrestling matches. Kyle and Token are talking.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: So I'm thinking we do the part about Jimmy's relationship with his alcoholic father after you smash Butters onto the table.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Oh! Sure, that works.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [rushing in with a letter] You guys! You guys, listen to this! It's amazing!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: What dude? [the other boys gather 'round]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: We just received a letter from the WWE.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: From the professional wrestlers we saw in Denver?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: No way!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: "Gentlemen, We have heard of your wrestling organization and are quite interested in its popularity. The WWE is delighted to inform you that it will be sending a talent scout, President Vince McMahon to view your wrestling event this Saturday the twenty-fourth."

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Vince McMahon is coming to see us?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: This is our shot at making it into the WWE. To be real wrestlers. [Stan and Kyle begin chanting "Omigod!" repeatedly]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Omigod! Omigod! Omigod! Omigod! Omigod! Omigod! Omigod! Omigod! Omigod! Omigod! Omigod!..

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Oh my God... Oh my God...

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I can't believe it's him.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I'm freaking out...

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [fans himself] Omigod! Omigod! Omigod!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Okay guys! Guys, listen! We seriously have to focus here! We have exactly three days before the scout is here to see us wrestle. We gotta step it up and work it like never before.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Alright it's time to start the second act. Let's bring the crowd back in from intermission and then improvise some stuff for Saturday!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Intermission. The crowd is milling around in the front lawn, and the darkened amphitheater is visible behind the fence.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah, no I I think Congo is a great wrestler; I just think Rad Russian has his number.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah, but Rad Russian has a lot of abandonment issues. [a chime sounds, indicating the start of the second act]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Uh oh, it looks like the intermission is over, better head back.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: The amphitheater. The lights come up on Kyle in the ring, who begins to speak.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I left my wife today. Walked out of the apartment without saying a word. I ran away from my responsibilities... just like I always do. [an elderly fan holds up a sign: "STOP RUNNING JUGGERNAUT"] And I, again, am alone. [Stan, Butters, and Token climb into the ring behind him]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Here he is, hiding in the forest as I told you. [Kyle turns to see the other three boys]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Juggernaut! There is to be an Ultimate Smackdown this Saturday! Are you going to run from that as well?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: I'll fight anytime, anywhere!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: He don't run from fights, just from responsibilities. [Token swings a chair into the back of Kyle's head, and Kyle falls to the floor]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Oohhhhh! [Token begins to twist Kyle's arm] Boooooooo!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: What do I do? Juggernaut is my long lost brother. [Kenny climbs into the ring as El Pollo Loco] And yet Congo saved my life in Nam. [Kenny picks up the chair and swings it into Token, and Stan turns to see him]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: It's El Pollo Loco! [a section full of Mexican fans hold up a Mexican flag and two banners: "Viva El Pollo Loco" and "Me Gusta El Pollo Loco"]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Sizzler, Thursday. The four boys are seated at a table.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Thanks for coming, guys. I'm sure you're wondering why I've called you here to Sizzler.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah, what's this about? We should be writing our monologues for Smackdown.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Well guys, Kenny and I have been talking.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: (Yeah, we've been talking.)

Title: W.T.F.
Line: And, I mean, Smackdown might be our one shot at making it into the WWE, right? I mean a shot like this might never come again.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Well, the way we see it, we have three primary obstacles in making Smackdown a great show: Token, Butters, Jimmy.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: (Yep.)

Title: W.T.F.
Line: What are you talking about?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Guys, let's face it: they can't wrestle for crap! I mean, every time I wrestle with one of them, they flub a line or blow their monologue. And Token? He has no emotion, no timing, he's the worst wrestler I've ever seen!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: He's right.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: What?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Dude, it's really hard to do your best wrestling when you're up against Token.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Right?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: And Butters and Jimmy I mean, they're okay but, they're never gonna make it as professional wrestlers.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Well, so then WWE will recruit us and not them.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: No dude, they're gonna hurt our chances.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: (They're gonna hurt our chances.)

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Because we all know that the new material I've written is stuff those guys can't handle, and we'll suffer from it!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: So what do we do?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: (We've gotta bring somebody else on.)

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yep. We've gotta bring somebody else on who can handle the more difficult roles that we can wrestle against instead of those guys.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Somebody who can do the harder stuff we've written so that Token, Butters, and Jimmy can have smaller parts.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: How do we find somebody who can wrestle that well?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: It's simple. We just gotta hold tryouts.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Tryouts, later on. Syncopated music plays, similar to "All That Jazz." The four boys are seated at a table a few rows up in the amphitheater.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Number seventeen step forward, please? [a man steps forward shielding his eyes from the glare of the spotlights] You're wrestling a Muslim immigrant. You suspect he could be a terrorist and your parents died in the 9/11 attacks. Go!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [gets into a slight crouch] You dirty Muslim bastard! I don't trust you, and I never will! Do you know how it feels to lose your parents?! No you wouldn't, you smelly brown Middle Eastern piece of sh-

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Thank you! Number twenty-four? [another man steps forth as Number 17 returns to his place] You're wrestling for the right to marry Mackenzie Phillips, but just learned that she had sex with her father uh, go!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Your father! Your own father! [slaps himself four times] I don't care if you were on drugs, you sick! Whore!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Thank you. [Number 24 returns to his place]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: That guy's a pretty good wrestler.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: (Mhm.)

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah yeah, not bad.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Let's see uh, can we get number thirty seven to step forward again. [Number 37 steps forward] We just wanna get to know you all a little better. What can you tell us about yourself?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Not a whole lot to tell, really. Was born in Fort Collins, started watching wrestling when I was four years old. My father... he liked it too. Until he died. [stirring music begins to play] Sometimes I think it's 'cause of him I followed this dream. [breaks into song] All my life, all I ever wanted was to Beeeee a wrestler Fiiiiighting in the ring Winning that belt. And so I dreamed every night that I was the Uuuuundertaaker Smaaaaashing skulls in Breaking arms. But I'm so worked up. This is something I can do. Do I have what it takes inside?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Damn dude, that is some badass wrestling.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Yeah, this guy crushes.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: The coach's trophy room. A whole bunch of wrestling trophies and awards are shown as the camera pans to the right. The coach is seated in his armchair.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: It isn't fair. All my hard work. [he's reading Saturday's Gazette, which has Vince McMahon's picture and name under the headline "Wrestling Smackdown Brings WWE President"] I'm not going to take it anymore. [he throws the paper to the floor, gets up from the chair, and walks over to a mirror.] That wrestling show is in for a big surprise. [grabs his headgear and puts it on] I'm putting an end to this once and for all! [gets into a wrestling stance] Hyaaaaa!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Cartman's house, Saturday night. A banner under the second-floor windows reads "ULTIMATE SMACKDOWN TONIGHT!!!" People from all over South Park gather on the front lawn. A white limo with the WWE logo emblazened on it comes to a stop in front of the house.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [standing on a stool by the front window] He's here! Vince McMahon is here! [the other boys arrive. An assistant opens the back door and Vince steps out and surveys the front yard.]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Oowow, it's really him.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: He's here, Ohh my God [Kyle hops off the stool and joins Stan in the chant] Omigod omigod omigod omigod omigod omigod omigod omigod omigod o-

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [preparing to dress as Irene] Alright, places everyone.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: The backyard amphitheater. The lights go out and two spotlights light up the ring.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: [over the speakers] Welcome to this performance of Wrestling Takedown Federation: Smackdown. [An opera box has been built to accommodate McMahon. It has four seats, and an usher takes McMahon and assistant to their seats. Vince has his own personal Playbill with "WTF" on the cover]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Juggernaut? Juggernaut, hey, what's goin' on?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You know what's goin' on. It's Smackdown tonight. Which means we might have to fight each other.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Heyhey whoa, you shouldn't be fighting anybody. What about your cancer?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Wait a minute. Who is that?

Title: W.T.F.
Line: It's Triceratops, and he's with Irene. [Coach Connors sneaks up to the side of Cartman's house with a briefcase and puts his back up against the wall]

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You aren't welcome here, Triceratops!

Title: W.T.F.
Line: My man can do whatever he wants.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: Stay calm, you know what you have to do.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: You're just gonna have to deal with that.

Title: W.T.F.
Line: For the good of real wrassling. [quickly moves away and out of sight]

Title: W.T.F.

Line: Kenny's room at the Residences, night. He sits by the open window with a lit candle, a pencil and a sheet of paper. He begins to write.

Title: Going Native
Line: My dearest friends,:I am living amongst the natives in the remote and tiny island of Kava'i. What can I tell you of this mysterious island and its people? It is a place of wonder, and yet to the outsider like me, a place of odd tradition. The people here are peaceful and joyous, and seem to care little for the rush and worry of the outside world. Their diet is mostly an odd mixture of coconut milk, pineapple juice, and vodka, which they call the chi-chi. As for Butters, he is quickly learning the ways of his ancestors, and seems to be feeling better with every passing day. He still seems quite angry at times, but luckily his ceremony will finally take place on the morrow.

Line: [directing his comments at Heidi upstairs] Yup. All set to go to the pumpkin patch! It's been open for over an hour now! [Heidi finally comes down the stairs]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Ohoh, don't you look cute, Heidi.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [goes to the front door and opens it] Awesome. Here we go, heading out now!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Hold on, Eric. I want a picture.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: No! Pumpkin patch is gonna, eh-

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Will you take a picture, dad?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: See, all the best pumpkins get taken and then eh-

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Cheese.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Okay, come on! Here we go, going out the door! Go, Mom!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Bye Daddy! Love you!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [at the car door] 'Kay, here we go to the pumpkin patch!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh crap. Hang on! I forgot my bracelet!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [in the car] Oh my fucking God!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Eric, potty mouth.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Arrrrrrrrgh!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: The woods, night. Stephen starts a campfire. Randy serves up the Jack Daniels, then takes a drink and sighs. The other men drink their cups too. The men then share a crack pipe, and then they form a circle around the campfire and slowly go around it.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Put a spell on our bosses. Put a spell on our wives. A hex on the Patriots. Let's fuck up their lives!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: And screw the Raiders too!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah! [some time passes and they're getting wasted]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: No way. Check out Stephen, you guys.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [walks around as if riding a broom] Heeheeheehee. Happy Witch Week! [falls to the ground face first] Ow. [the other men laugh at him.]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [walks in with a book] Hey, HEY! [the partying stops] You guys wanna see some real witchcraft? [no one replies for a few seconds]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oooooooooooooo. [the men laugh]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I mean it! I got this spell book last month. Got it in Salem, Massachusetts. They say it's real.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Like real, how?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Like from the Devil himself. You guys wanna try it?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Dr. Spooky's Pumpkin Patch, night. People are leaving with pumpkins as Cartman and Heidi arrive. Cartman jumps out of the car and runs towards the patch.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Hey, wait up, babe! [Cartman stops, closes his eyes, and stretches out his hand for Heidi to take when she catches up to him]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [walks by with his pumpkin and his mom] Hey, where you been, Eric?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh boy! What a great time that was.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Thanks for coming, kids. [sees Cartman and Heidi approaching] Oh, you just getting here?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, we are just getting here.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Okay uh, go on in, I suppose. Petting zoo's closed, and I think they stopped the churro machine.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: The petting zoo's cl- The petting zoo's closed?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah. You can still maybe do the bouncy house.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Come on, babe!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: The woods, later. Chip is reading from the spell book.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Arkna. Peduum. Uthnod boral.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: That's pretty cool. [strikes up a crack pipe]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Uthnod boral! Uthnod alvernderaal! Wickus! [a green glow emanates from the book] Stayfalls-wuh. Uh.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Whoa, whoa, whoa whoa whoa.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Ach. Oh, it burns!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Okay, Chip. You might need to ease up on that crack there, buddy. [Chip drops the book and screams, and begins to transform into an actual witch. A broom flies to him and he rides off on it, cackling]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: South Park, night, seconds later. Chip flies over the town and past South Park Elementary, where the parent/teacher conference is being held.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I'll kill you all! Kill you all!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Park County Community Center, moments later. Chip flies up cackling and begins lobbing flaming jack-o-lanterns at the adults there. One of them crashes into the parking lot and throws off a few people with its impact. Another one hits a car, stopping it in its tracks and wrecking it. The passengers get knocked out from the impact. Everyone else tries to disperse, screaming.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [cackling] You'll all be dead by Halloween! [cackles some more]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Dr. Spooky's Pumpkin Patch. Everyone is running out.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Get out! Everyone out!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: What do you mean?! I just got here!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: There's a witch! [Chip flies in and starts bombing the patch]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Come on, Eric!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: No! I missed it! I missed it all! [Heidi pulls him away. Chip sees a boy, plucks him off the ground and carries him away]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: The Marsh house, next day. Randy comes down the stairs quite beat from the might before, goes to the fridge, gets out a gallon of fruit punch, and drinks straight from it, sighing with satisfaction. He turns and notices Sharon with her arms crossed.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh. Hey, didn't see you there.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Did you hear anything about what happened last night?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Uuuhhh, nnno, what happened?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Your buddy, Chip Duncan? [holds up her phone, on which there's a news report about it] Apparently, he flew around on a broom, blew things up, and kidnapped some children?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Are you serious?!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: You heard nothing about this?! He flew away vowing we'd all be dead by Halloween!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [hands her back the phone and walks off] God, I knew that guy was a fuckin' chode!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Randy, what did you guys do at that party?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [turns around] Nothin'. We were just hangin' out and talkin' and stuff, and then Chip got all weird.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: People were hurt!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, I agree! It's awful! We're not like Chip, okay?! He's a bad witch!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: South Park Elememntary cafeteria, lunchtime. The kids are nervous, looking over their shoulders. The core group of boys is at table eating lunch.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Did any of you guys actually see the witch?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, it was terrifying. She had a broom and a cackle and everything.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: What are we gonna do, guys?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Our parents are never gonna let us trick or treat with a flying witch around! [next to him, Cartman has an angry glare on his face]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: They say she blew up the pumpkin patch. Did any of you guys see that?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: No, I missed the whole thing. I always try to get to the pumpkin patch really early.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, I got there really early too. You get the best pumpkins that way. Anyways, I guess the witch destroyed the whole thing. [the camera begins to focus on Cartman's glare]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: We've got to take matters into our own hands. None of us is safe.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, but what are we gonna do?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: No, we've got to just hope the police will handle it.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, right. Like they'll handle anything. [from a nearby table, Heidi peeks past Bebe and smiles at Cartman, waving at him]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Stan's right. This might fall on us. [Cartman waves back, his glare fixed on her]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, we've got to save Halloween. Don't you think so, Eric?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [his concentration is broken] What?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: We've got to do something to get rid of her!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yes. You're right, guys. It's my only way out.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: The Marsh house, day. Sharon is watching TV on the sofa. Randy, in costume, walks past her with another case of Jack Daniels.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: All right, see you, Sharon. Have a good night.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [displeased] Where do you think you're going?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: What do you mean? It's Day 2 of Witch Week with the guys.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [stands up] You can't possibly be considering doing this again!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Why not?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Randy, a real witch is flying around in the skies snatching children! I don't think this is the best time for you to be wearing a witch costume and partying!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Wugh! Gau! Just because of one bad witch we're supposed to stop a tradition that goes back twenty-someodd years?! Jesus! [turns around and walks out the front door]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Gerald's car. Randy walks to it and enters. The mood is subdued due to the flying witch.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Hey Randy.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Sup guys?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: You know, just getting a bunch of shit for being witches.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I know, right? It's like, there's one awful witch who wants to kill everybody, so now they're coming after all of us. This is like a witch... thingy.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: It's like a witch pursuit thingy.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: A witch uhhh-

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: It's a witch chase and shoot 'em up.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, that's what it is!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: The woods, second night. The cars pull into the same lot as before, but now a sign is shown: Sentinel Hill park, which is closed. The men get out of their cars and walk up to another sign posted on an orange barricade.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Hey, what the hell is this?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [reading the sign] "Park closed until further notice". That's bullshit!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh my God.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: They can't do this! The whole town really is on a witch pursuit thing!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: South Park, night. Chip is back in the air bombing houses, and people run to get out of the way. Chip spots Leroy and scoops him up.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Kyle's room, night. he's on his computer reading a Wikipedia article on witches. Stan, Kenny, and Butters stand behind him looking at the screen.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Check this out, you guys. It says that to destroy a witch you need bent pits, nine in all, each bent into an L shape.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: What are bent pits? [Cartman walks in with some plans]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Hey guys, I think I got it figured out.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: You do?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I knew Eric would come up with a plan! [Cartman puts up a drawing of his plan, which involves the boys luring Heidi to her death, burying the body, and celebrating her death with a pizza. He then brings out his retractable pointer and starts pointing]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Okay, first of all, we need a scary place to lure her into. What is the creepiest place in town? Ross Dress for Less, that's right. Stan and Kyle will wait inside the Ross Dress for Less, and I will bring Heidi there. Once inside, Kenny and Butters will set off a series of explosions that will-

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Wait wait wait wait. What the fuck are you talking about?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: This is how we're going to get rid of Heidi.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Nobody's talking about getting rid of Heidi!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: You guys said you would help me get rid of her!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: OF THE WITCH!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Who cares about a witch?! My life is a living hell, you guys!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Then break up with her! You clearly can't stand her! LET THE POOR GIRL GO!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I've tried! It's impossible!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Heidi is a nice girl! How could you be so awful to her?!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: You don't understand! She has no time-management skills whatsoever! You don't know 'cause you've never had a girlfriend, Kyle! [Kyle just stares angrily at him] Fine. Just leave me to suffer. Next time you want me to kill someone for you, just forget about it! [leaves the room]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: South Park Elementary, day. The Mayor is speaking to the students and their parents in the gym.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Students and parents, I know that you are all concerned about the witch who is preying upon our town, and I wanna speak to you all about how to try and protect yourselves. But first, some gentlemen have asked to speak on what they perceive to be a [does air quotes] "witch pursuit thing". [walks off the stage as the gentlemen in costume get on stage and arrange themselves around the mic]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh wait, I'm supposed to be-

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, sure, no. [to Stuart] You go over there.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Right. Right right right. [music starts and they begin singing]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: We're all on the same side, you and I. Let's all stick togetha, let's try. When things are going bad and there's people you need to confront. Just be sure it doesn't turn into a witch pursuit thing.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [as the other men provide ambient harmony] Hey guys, there's good witches and there's bad witches, and we stand with you in saying this particular witch needs to be brought down. But that doesn't men we should all be closing parks and stopping all witch activity because [catches up with the others on vocals]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Let's not turn this into a witch pursuit thing.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [to Gerald] Dad, get out of here! We're trying to deal with an actual witch! Nobody's coming after you!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yes they are, boys! And next they'll be coming after you! 'Cause you're all little sons a witches!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Right. You don't have to worry about us, going around snatching children. Only the other witch does that. [Cartman's face lights up and he looks at Heidi. He gets a mischievous look in his eyes]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Later, school hallway. Heidi is at her locker.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Hey, babe.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh. Hey Eric.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Listen uh, there's a big fun costume party tonight and I was thinking you and me should go. What do you say?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: A costume party? With everything that's going on?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, I just think, you know, we need to let off some steam and have a little Halloween fun, you know? I already have our costumes picked out.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Well... I guess.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Cool. I'll pick you up at 5.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Well, maybe make it 4:30 if you're bringing the costumes. [Cartman turns left and walks away] I might need a little extra time getting ready.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [stops, then mischievously] Ohohoh, I'm counting on it. [walks off]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: The Marsh house, day. One of the good witches rings the doorbell, and Randy lets him in.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Randy, can I talk to you?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Sure, Stephen.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I've been doing a lot of thinking, Randy. About the past. About what we've done. I think it's time we come clean and tell everyone about the crack. And the spells against our wives.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [quickly closes the door and walks up to Stephen] Okay, look. You're freaked out, it's understandable.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I have to admit what I've done wrong, Randy! I feel like everything's crashing down and I want Linda to hear it from me first.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Okay, we smoked a little crack. We put harmless spells on our wives. We were just messing around, it was harmless fun.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Was it? Or did we close our eyes to what Chip Duncan was becoming?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Stephen, you can't turn on your own kind. That's what these witch pursuit thingies do, okay? They make everyone go crazy.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I'm sorry, Randy. I have to clear my conscience.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [sighs] All right, Stephen. At least give us till tomorrow morning to talk to our wives and prepare them, all right? Can you just give us till morning?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, sure. [walks to the front door] I'm sorry.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: It's okay. It's okay. [Stephen leaves. A few second later, Randy is on the phone calling up someone] Hey, it's Randy. We’ve got until tomorrow morning to sacrifice Stephen to the Devil. I'll explain later, just get everyone together. And, maybe bring just a little bit of crack.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: The woods, night. Cartman and Heidi, dressed as Hansel and Gretel, wander through it.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Don't you think we should stay on the main roads, Eric? This seems like a bad place to be right now.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Don't worry, Heidi. This is the fastest way to the party. [loudly] I'm sure the witch won't even notice us.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Eric, come on, this is a bad idea. Let's turn around.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Well, Heidi, if we'd been on time, we wouldn't need to take a short cut. But I wanted to give you your space to get ready.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [sensing the sarcasm] Is that what this is about? You're still mad about the pumpkin patch, aren't you?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Why would I be mad? You wanted to make sure you looked right, and then you had to eat and use the bathroom 40 times. I can't blame you for missing the pumpkin patch.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I didn't use the bathroom 40 times! [Chip is heard above them] What was that? [the leaves in the trees rustle and she looks up] Eric! Did you hear that?! [she turns to see him, but he's gone] Eric?! Eric! Oh my God! Eric, are you okay?!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [finally appears] Well, well. What have we here?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [barely above a whisper, hiding behind a fallen tree trunk] Sweet. Come on, come on.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Kyle's house, day. Stan, Kenny, and Butters show up, and Stan knocks on the door. Kyle answers the door.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Dude, is your dad home?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: No, I, I don't know where he is.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: We can't find our dads either.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, and it turns out our dads and the bad witch were all part of the same witch group.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: We asked our moms, and they said this has been going on for years. We've got to find them before something stupider happens.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: How are we gonna do that?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: There's another guy. Someone else who was in the witches' club that hasn't been around for a while.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Who?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: The White House, night. The President, also dressed as a witch, is in the Oval Office.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [opens the door and looks in] Mr. President, you have an urgent call from a Butters Stotch?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [lost in thought, he perks up] Butters? What's he want? [picks up the phone at his desk] This is the President.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh, uh, eh hello Mr. President. How are you?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [in Butters' room with Kyle and Kenny] Butter him up, Butters.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: How uh, how is runnin' the country going?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh, it's fine. You know, just makin' the country great again.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Did you get rid of all the immigrants like you said?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I got rid of like, six of 'em so far. You know, it's a little harder than I thought.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Cool. Ah-and did you build that big wall you were gonna build?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Don't be a dick, Butters. Are you just callin' to shit on my Halloween?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: N-no, sir! I uh, well, the thing is, uh, didn't you used to do J and C Witch Week with our dads?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, it was my favorite time of year. Now I just have to celebrate it alone.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Well, the thing is, Mr. President, one of the guys did a spell and took a bunch of children, and he's gonna eat 'em all.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Lemme guess: Chip Duncan. Oh, that guy was always such a douche.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Mr. President, please, you've gotta help. Our dads can't do anything 'cause they're scared people are comin' after all wtiches.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Comin' after all witches? Oh, Jeez...

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Park County Police Station, night. It's all decked out for Halloween.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: So you were there when the witch showed up and took your girlfriend.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yes, it just came out of nowhere. I tried to save Heidi, but it was too late.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: What was your girlfriend wearing?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: She was dressed kind of like me, but had a simple Munich dirndl from Germany.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: And you didn't stop at all to think that what you were doing might attract a witch?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Excuse me?! Are you actually trying to blame the victim here?!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: No, I'm just saying that if there's a big fat witch around, maybe you shouldn't walk around in the woods dressed as Hansel and Gretel.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Ohhhhh!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Whoa, whoa, not cool, Rick. Not cool.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I will have your badge, sir!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [looks towards the camera] Sorry folks, sorry.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Detective! Detective! Call just came in. The witch has been spotted at Ross Dress For Less.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Everyone to Ross Dress For Less, now!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Ross Dress For Less, night. Only a couple of cars are in the parking lot, and the store is closed. A witch wanders into view.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Guys? I'm here. Guys? What's this all about?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Hello, Stephen.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh, hey. What are we meeting here for?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: It's too late, Stephen. We called the police. We know you took those children.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: What? What uh, What are you doing?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [accompanied by Stuart] Here he is, everybody! Stephen's a bad witch!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Nooo! [people begin to gather around the witches]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: We're putting a stop to you, Stephen, because that's what good witches do!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh my God! I see what this is! This witch pursuit thing has you on a witch pursuit thing now! [several police cars pull into the parking lot and officers pour out of them] I'm innocent. Please!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: It's over, Stotch. What have you done with the children?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Noho, don't you see?! They're just doing their own witch pursuit thingy now! This is madness! [Chip is heard cackling from up in the air. Everyone looks up to see him flying over Ross Dress For Less, then hug their kids to keep them safe]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [lands and gets off the broom] Hey, what's up, bros?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: "What's up, bros?" Chip, do you see all the chaos you've caused?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Yeah, so? I'm a witch.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Ugh, you understand everyone associates us with you, right?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Of course they do. You're all witches too, dudes!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Not like you!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: What'd you do with the children?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: They're all in here! See? [opens his bag]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [voices heard while light emanates from the depth of the bag] Daddy, help! Mommy, help! Ahh!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I'm going to use their souls to increase my power!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Look! Another witch is flying down now! [a shot of Air Force One flying towards town]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Butters' room, night. He's typing something on his computer when Stan enters his room with Kyle and Kenny behind him.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Butters, come on! We've gotta go!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Okay! Where?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: I guess our witches were gonna sacrifice your witch, but then the bad witch showed up and now the witch we called just arrived. There's witches everywhere!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Holy moly! [leaves his chair and follows the others out]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: The Ross Dress For Less parking lot. Randy tries to reason with Chip.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Look, Chip, if we had known you were gonna hurt people, we would have never even hung out.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh, give me a break, Randy.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: No, seriously.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Like if one of you guys had the power I have, you wouldn't use it.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: No we wouldn't!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Excuse me. [makes his way to the front of the group]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Oh, hey man!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: You're ruining the party for everyone, Chip! I'm here to take you out!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [cackles] You'll never stop me! [levitates] I grow more powerful every moment!

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: You wanna see real power? [into his pocket mic disguised as a lapel pin] All right, take the shot. [a solar-powered satellite takes aim at the President's location with three beeps, and two lasers shoot down towards it. The shot obliterates Chip, but his bag and broom fall away unscathed. A few moments of stunned silence, and the witches celebrate as Garrison fist-pumps. Two officers quickly come up and open the bag]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: [pops out of the bag] I'm free! [two girls pop out]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Mommy! Daddy! [the boy Chip plucked first pops out of the bag]

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Is that all of them?

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: There's one more little girl. Come on out, little girl.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Okay. Just a second.

Title: Sons A Witches
Line: Com- come on, little girl. Everyone's waitin' on ya.

Title: Sons A Witches
